jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Netherlands.

This is a fully remote opportunity for a senior engineer who can take ownership of complex software projects from concept through launch. You will contribute across the full technology stack, building new product capabilities while maintaining a strong focus on quality and automated testing. The role combines hands-on development with technical ownership, architectural thinking, and continuous exploration of new technologies. You will work closely with a distributed engineering team to shape technical solutions, coding standards, and development practices. The environment values autonomy, curiosity, attention to detail, and a strong sense of ownership. You will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a growing SaaS product while working with a modern cloud-based technology stack.

Accountabilities

Deliver senior-level implementation of new product features across the full technology stack.
Own projects from technical conceptualization through implementation, testing, launch, and continuous improvement.
Design and implement reliable, maintainable, and scalable software solutions.
Build comprehensive test automation for new development, including unit and integration testing.
Solve complex technical challenges while balancing product requirements, engineering quality, and maintainability.
Research, evaluate, propose, test, and implement new technologies, techniques, and development approaches.
Collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders on technical design, coding standards, development practices, and best practices.
Contribute to maintaining a high-quality engineering environment with minimal technical debt.
Continuously improve development processes, tooling, and engineering practices.
Take ownership of technical decisions and proactively identify opportunities to improve the product and engineering experience.

Requirements

7+ years of full-stack software development experience, with strong expertise in C# and .NET/Core, ideally within SaaS products.
Strong experience with modern frontend JavaScript frameworks.
Strong hands-on experience developing and integrating Web APIs.
Advanced SQL skills, with SQL Server experience preferred.
Strong knowledge of Test-Driven Development and automated testing, including both unit and integration testing.
Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud.
Azure DevOps experience is a plus.
Strong ability to build intuitive, reliable, and maintainable software.
Ownership mindset with a track record of following through on commitments and taking responsibility for technical outcomes.
Comfortable working independently in a small-team environment while actively collaborating with others.
Curious and proactive approach to learning, experimentation, and adopting new technologies.
Willingness to ask questions, challenge assumptions, learn from mistakes, and continuously improve.
Strong attention to detail and a commitment to engineering excellence.
Self-driven approach with the ability to use sound judgment and seek alignment when needed.
Currently based and legally authorized to work within a European country in the CET, EET, or WET time zones.

Benefits

Annual compensation of $75,000–$85,000 USD, depending on experience and qualifications.
Fully remote work within Europe.
Flexible working schedule.
Competitive benefits package and paid time off.
Creative and collaborative working environment.
Direct exposure to leadership across different departments.
Significant ownership and the opportunity to make a visible impact on the product and customer experience.
Structured engineering onboarding designed to support rapid learning and integration.
Choice of PC or Mac hardware.
Opportunity to work with modern platforms, frameworks, development tools, and engineering standards.
Near-zero technical debt environment.
Modern technology stack including Azure, .NET 8.x, C# 12, Ember.js 5.7, Bootstrap 5.x, Selenium, Entity Framework 8.x, SQL Server 2022, and Azure DevOps.
Collaboration within an international, distributed engineering team spanning more than 20 countries.
Remote-first environment designed to support asynchronous collaboration across time zones.

How Jobgether Works

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

jobs.title: Software Engineer/ Architect
jobs.description:
De functie

Eekels | TBI is voor de locatie Kolham op zoek naar een Software Engineer/Architect. Als Software Engineer/Architect ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp, de standaardisatie en automatisering van software architectuur en modules binnen onze ‘Configure to Order’ (CTO) productfilosofie. Je ontwikkelt modulaire en schaalbare softwareoplossingen die perfect aansluiten op onze elektrische modules. In deze functie zorg jij ervoor dat onze software architectuur en softwarestandaarden worden geoptimaliseerd en geborgd binnen het CTO-proces. Je werkt aan de ontwikkeling van gestandaardiseerde modulaire oplossingen, waardoor configuratie eenvoudiger wordt en onze klanten een flexibel productaanbod krijgen. In deze functie werk je nauw samen met de Product Manager, productie en andere disciplines van het ontwikkelteam om technische haalbaarheid en efficiënt produceren op elkaar af te stemmen. Je assisteert af en toe op de productielocatie om ontwerpen te bespreken en implementaties te begeleiden. In jouw rol rapporteer je direct aan de Product Manager.

Wat wordt er van jou verwacht?

Ontwikkelen en beheren van modulaire software architectuur en ontwerpen die passen binnen de CTO-filosofie;
Afstemmen van softwarecomponenten met elektrotechnische engineers voor een geïntegreerd en configureerbaar productportfolio;
Definiëren en documenteren van standaard software modules om productconfiguratie, producttestbaarheid en productie-efficiëntie te verbeteren;
Definiëren en realiseren van automatische softwareparametrisatie op basis van de klantspecifieke functionaliteit en de geleverde configuratie;
Uitvoeren van productontwikkelingstrajecten, waarbij je softwareontwerpen borgt binnen de productlevenscyclus;
Ondersteunen van de productie (productiefaciliteit Galati, Roemenië) bij de implementatie van nieuwe softwarestandaarden en verbeteringen in het product;
Het ontwikkelen van software t.b.v. geautomatiseerd testen van product modules tijdens productie;
Borgen van informatie en ontwerpen in Plastic SCM en andere version control methodieken om productbeheer en samenwerking binnen het team te optimaliseren.

Werkomgeving

De business unit Products, gevestigd in Kolham, opereert onder de merknaam Corvia. Corvia is het nieuwe merk van Eekels Technology. Wij zetten ons in voor slimmere en duurzame voortstuwingsoplossingen voor de maritieme sector. Met onze belangrijkste innovatie, het Modular Propulsion Platform (MPP), bieden we scheepseigenaren een flexibel, toekomstbestendig systeem dat de transitie naar emissievrije scheepvaart ondersteunt.

Ervaring

Herken je jezelf in dit profiel?

Aantoonbaar hbo werk- en denkniveau en opleiding op het gebied van Technische informatica of Elektrotechniek;
Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in softwareontwerp, productontwikkeling en/of CTO-omgevingen;
Kennis van en ervaring met C#, .NET, CODESYS en industriële netwerken;
Ervaring in de maritieme sector is een pré;
Affiniteit met technische producten, industrieel ontwerp, standaardisatie en automatisering van softwareontwerp;
Communicatief vaardig, werkt gemakkelijk samen en neemt binnen het team de rol van technisch kartrekker op zich;
Proactieve werkwijze en een goed analytisch vermogen;
Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.

Wat wij bieden

Bij Eekels Technology bieden we een breed scala aan aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Cao: de cao Technisch Installatiebedrijf is op jou van toepassing.
Aantrekkelijk salaris: passend bij jouw functie, kennis en ervaring.
Een ruim aantal vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen en 13 adv-dagen op fulltime basis (afhankelijk van jouw leeftijd wordt dit aangevuld met extra seniorendagen).
Aantrekkelijke vergoedingen en regelingen: waaronder een bovengemiddelde reis- en overurenvergoeding en thuiswerkregeling.
Winstdelingsregeling: deel mee in het succes van ons bedrijf en ook onze winst!
Collectieve pensioenregeling: via het “Pensioenfonds Metaal en Techniek”.
Stimuleren van jouw gezondheid: door onze jaarlijkse (sport)activiteitenkalender.
Fiscale voordelen: voor de aanschaf van een fiets of een fitnessabonnement.
Jouw vakmanschap: door onze leercultuur blijf jij scherp binnen jouw vakgebied en verbreed jij jouw kennis.
Actieve personeelsvereniging: het hele jaar door diverse georganiseerde (sport) activiteiten met collega’s (meestal ook voor jouw eventuele partner of kind(eren)!).
Plezierige werkomgeving: met een goede werksfeer en collega’s waar je blij van wordt.
Interessante projecten: werken aan prestigieuze, technische projecten en producten met een duurzame impact, waar je trots op kunt zijn.
Personeelskortingen: met flinke kortingen op mode, elektronica, wonen, dagjes uit, verzekeringen en meer.
Persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling: alle ruimte om te groeien en verder te komen.
Bedrijfsmiddelen: goed gereedschap en (digitale) middelen zijn het halve werk. Wij zorgen voor de middelen om jou jouw functie goed uit te kunnen laten voeren.
TBI Holdings: achter onze organisatie staat een financieel sterke moedermaatschappij met daaronder een 20-tal dochtermaatschappijen.

Interesse?

Klinkt dit als jouw ideale uitdaging? Solliciteer dan nu en ontdek wat Eekels voor jou kan betekenen!

Maatschappelijke impact

Werken bij een TBI-onderneming betekent werken bij een onderneming met een grote maatschappelijke betrokkenheid. Die maatschappelijke betrokkenheid blijkt onder andere uit de TBI Klimaattrein, TBI Praktijkfonds en het TBI Studiefonds . Met het TBI Studiefonds komen jouw kinderen mogelijk in aanmerking voor een studietoelage van TBI Studiefonds (vanaf de middelbare school). Lees hier meer over onze maatschappelijke fondsen .

jobs.title: Software Developer Intern
jobs.description:
Our formula for success is to hire exceptional people, encourage their ideas and reward their results.

As a Software Developer Intern
, you will build advanced trading and risk applications leveraging cutting-edge technology. DRW enables our Software Developer Interns to develop computationally intensive software under the guidance of senior technologists with the goal of deployment during your ten weeks. While your days will have you immersed in complex projects directly driving DRW’s progress, your evenings will be spent exploring the city with organized social events to truly discover what it is like to live and work in Amsterdam.

How You Will Make An Impact…

Design, develop test, and deploy proprietary software solutions across the firm. Examples include creating:
Decoders to receive raw pack data from various exchanges and translate it into a more accessible form.
Normalisers which take decoded data and build a book for each instrument traded on that exchange
Applications to facilitate communication around executed trades to our compliance team

Identify innovative solutions to complex problems and advocate for their implementation to your team by communicating your ideas in a clear and concise manner
Conduct robust research using a data driven approach to employ statistical analytics on large data sets
Collaborate with other software developers, quantitative traders and researchers as well as business analysts in cross-functional team environments

What You Bring To The Team…

Are pursuing a bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD in computer science, electrical engineering, computer engineering, physics, mathematics or any related science discipline and have an expected graduation date between December 2027 and August 2028
Have exposure to network programming (TCP/IP), multi‐threaded applications, computational intelligence, algorithms, real‐time programming or GUI programming
Have strong understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, and algorithms
An eagerness to learn and apply what you have learned, and to know the impact of your code
Have strong problem-solving and analytical reasoning skills
Have strong communication and collaboration skills
Exhibit excellent software development skills in C++, Python, Java, C#, or C and a deep curiosity to learn and absorb new technologies quickly

What To Expect During The Internship…

Meaningful projects: You’ll receive a challenging project to complete during your time here. Each project, advised by a software engineer, promotes a comprehensive learning experience and provides you with meaningful work experience.
Community: Throughout the summer, we host a variety of educational, social and team-building activities to foster friendship and camaraderie.
Housing: DRW provides fully furnished apartments located close to the office – making your morning commute as easy as possible.
Mentorship: You’ll build a professional relationship with an experienced mentor in your field. Mentors and mentees meet to discuss goals, challenges, and professional development and explore the city together at our mentor outings.
Education: As technology continues to drive the trading industry forward, both in terms of new products and transaction methods, the future will present us with unique opportunities and challenges. To prepare you for how technology will continue to impact trading’s future landscape, you will complete an options course framed from a developer’s standpoint to help you visualise how your technology solutions will be used in real time. As the trading industry continually evolves, both in terms of new products and transaction methods, the future will present us with unique opportunities and challenges.

DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity, and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters – it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer (Fluent Dutch speakers only)
jobs.description:
Vacancy

Automation Engineer (Fluent Dutch speakers only)

At ParaSoll , you don’t automate for a client you’ll never meet. Everything you build is used in education and makes a direct difference for teachers, IT teams, and students. We’re looking for an Automation Engineer with experience in Azure who enjoys working on a mix of client projects and in-house product development, alongside students.

Apply directly

This job opening is intended for candidates who speak Dutch fluently and live and work in the Netherlands. We will not respond to applications from outside the Netherlands.

Build something that a school will actually use next week

In most automation jobs, you automate processes for a client you never meet. At ParaSoll , it’s different. We work exclusively for the education sector. The scripts, pipelines, and cloud solutions you build are used by schools and universities and make a direct difference for teachers, IT teams, and students. A digital exam system that works flawlessly when 800 students log in—that’s your work.

The function

To strengthen our Azure team, we are looking for an Automation Engineer. You will work on a mix of external projects and internal product development.

For clients—typically IT teams at educational institutions—you’ll automate the setup and management of Azure environments. This includes infrastructure as code, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and eliminating manual tasks that nobody really wants to do anymore. You’ll provide advice, write designs, and handle the technical implementation.

In addition, we develop our own products in collaboration with a school consortium. Students come to work with us in groups on a final project that results in a real product. One example is an AI bot trained to handle security incidents, which students in the security program use to practice de-escalation techniques. Each period is a sprint in which the product advances to the next level. You’ll be the technical linchpin in this process: you’ll ensure quality, contribute to the development, and help students get their ideas up and running.

Who are you?

You’re passionate about automation and the cloud. You see repetitive work as a problem that can be solved with code. You have experience with Azure and tools such as PowerShell, Bicep, or Terraform, as well as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. Experience with AI tools in your work is a plus, but not a requirement. Curiosity and the willingness to quickly learn those tools, however, are essential.

You’re good with young people who don’t have much business experience yet. You explain things without being condescending, adapt your language and leadership style, and at the same time keep the ultimate goal in mind: an educational, enjoyable internship and a successful product iteration.

Technology holds no secrets for you, and you stay up to date on what's happening in your field.

Your Career Path

We assume that you're still relatively early in your career. You've proven yourself in the business world, but there's still plenty to learn.

At ParaSoll , you get to decide what your career path looks like. Together, we’ll explore your long-term ambitions and the steps needed to achieve them. Do you want to broaden your skills, deepen your expertise, or take on a coordinating or advisory role? Common career paths include Azure automation specialist, architect, project manager, or department manager. We’ll work together to determine the balance between technical work and other aspects of the role.

Our guiding principle: Your responsibility and sense of ownership determine your success. You’ll have a great deal of freedom, and much is possible through mutual discussion. You take charge of your work, your development, and your opportunities.

What We Offer

A position ranging from 32 to 40 hours per week, starting immediately
Work from Biddinghuizen or remotely
Work that matters: Everything you build finds its way into education
A small, modern IT company with no bureaucratic red tape. You'll be right at the table when decisions are made.
Opportunities to experiment with AI and new tools in real-world projects
A salary that we determine together based on your degrees, skills, and work experience

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Functieomschrijving

Functieomschrijving

Word jij blij van een stabiel cloudplatform, slimme automatiseringen én techniek die gewoon goed in elkaar zit?

Als Cloud Engineer bij Veneta bouw je mee aan een veilige, schaalbare en toekomstbestendige Azure-omgeving. Je zorgt niet alleen dat onze cloud goed blijft draaien, maar vooral dat we deze steeds slimmer kunnen beheren en verder ontwikkelen.

Je automatiseert infrastructuur, richt monitoring in, verbetert security en helpt nieuwe oplossingen veilig naar productie. Van een deployment pipeline tot een nieuwe Azure-service of AI-oplossing: jij zorgt dat het fundament klopt.

De uitdaging 🚀

Samen met twee collega’s vorm je het Platform & Engineering-team. Jullie zijn verantwoordelijk voor het cloudfundament waarop Veneta iedere dag bouwt. Dat betekent dat je werkt aan beschikbaarheid, performance, security en schaalbaarheid, maar ook aan de manier waarop we onze infrastructuur ontwikkelen en beheren.

Ons cloudplatform ondersteunt de digitale diensten en koppelingen waarop Veneta dagelijks draait. Van de online klantreis en onze data tot de processen achter verkoop en dienstverlening: een betrouwbaar en goed ingericht platform is onmisbaar om onze collega’s en klanten snel te kunnen blijven helpen.

Je kijkt verder dan dagelijks beheer. Handmatige handelingen wil je automatiseren, terugkerende incidenten los je structureel op en nieuwe cloudresources rol je zoveel mogelijk uit via Infrastructure as Code.

Ook denk je mee over de architectuur van nieuwe oplossingen. Welke Azure-services passen het beste? Hoe regelen we identity, networking, logging en security? En hoe zorgen we dat een oplossing straks betrouwbaar, beheersbaar én betaalbaar blijft?

De roadmap ligt niet volledig vast. Dat betekent dat je veel ruimte krijgt om samen met het team te bepalen welke technische verbeteringen de meeste waarde opleveren. Zie jij dat iets slimmer, veiliger of sneller kan? Dan maak je een plan en ga je ermee aan de slag.

Wat je gaat doen 💻

Je bouwt, beheert en optimaliseert onze Microsoft Azure-omgeving.
Je ontwikkelt en beheert cloudinfrastructuur met Bicep en Terraform.
Je bouwt en onderhoudt CI/CD-pipelines in Azure DevOps en GitHub.
Je automatiseert beheertaken en deployments met bijvoorbeeld PowerShell, Azure CLI of Python.
Je richt monitoring, logging en alerting in en vertaalt signalen naar structurele verbeteringen.
Je werkt aan Azure-netwerken, identity, toegangsbeheer, secrets en veilige verbindingen tussen systemen.
Je implementeert securitymaatregelen met onder andere Azure Policy, RBAC, Microsoft Defender for Cloud en Key Vault.
Je zorgt dat back-up, herstel en continuïteit goed zijn ingericht en regelmatig worden getest.
Je onderzoekt incidenten tot de kern en zorgt ervoor dat problemen niet onnodig terugkomen.
Je draait samen met je collega’s volgens een afgesproken rooster mee in de storingsdienst.
Je bewaakt het gebruik en de kosten van Azure en zoekt naar mogelijkheden om resources slimmer in te zetten.
Je adviseert development-, data- en business-teams over het veilig en betrouwbaar gebruiken van cloudservices.
Je helpt nieuwe applicaties en oplossingen van ontwerp en proof of concept tot een stabiele productieomgeving.
Je onderzoekt nieuwe technologieën, waaronder AI-platformen en Large Language Models, en kijkt hoe we deze veilig en schaalbaar kunnen inzetten.
Je documenteert architectuurkeuzes, technische standaarden en beheerprocessen, zodat kennis niet alleen in hoofden blijft zitten.

Wat je krijgt 💰

Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4.000 en € 6.500, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring.
Een fulltime dienstverband van 40 uur per week.
Een werkplek op ons kantoor in Zwolle, waar we als team graag samenwerken, met de mogelijkheid om maximaal twee dagen per week vanuit huis te werken.
Een uitgebreide onboarding waarin je Veneta én je collega’s goed leert kennen.
Veel ruimte om de technische richting van onze cloudomgeving mede te bepalen.
Volop mogelijkheden om certificeringen te behalen in Azure, cloud architecture, AI en security.
Tijd en ruimte om nieuwe technologieën te onderzoeken en proof of concepts uit te werken.
Een goede pensioenregeling met een eigen bijdrage van 6%. Veneta legt 17% in.
25 vakantiedagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband.
Reiskostenvergoeding. Of je nu met de fiets of de auto komt: altijd kassa.
Bedrijfsfitness met korting op je sportabonnement.

Jouw talent 🎯

Je hoeft nog niet ieder onderdeel van onze omgeving volledig te beheersen. We vinden het belangrijker dat je een goede basis hebt, graag automatiseert en jezelf verder wilt ontwikkelen in platform engineering, cloudsecurity en Azure.

Je hebt ervaring als Cloud Engineer, Azure Engineer, Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer of in een vergelijkbare technische functie.
Je hebt hands-on ervaring met Microsoft Azure en begrijpt hoe onderdelen zoals compute, storage, networking, identity en monitoring met elkaar samenwerken.
Je hebt ervaring met Infrastructure as Code, bijvoorbeeld met Bicep, Terraform of vergelijkbare tooling, en vindt het leuk om met beide te werken.
Je hebt ervaring met CI/CD en Git en begrijpt hoe je infrastructuur en configuraties gecontroleerd naar productie brengt.
Je automatiseert graag en kunt overweg met PowerShell, Azure CLI, Python of een vergelijkbare taal.
Je hebt een goede basis in cloudnetwerken, security en monitoring.
Je pakt technisch eigenaarschap, zoekt problemen graag tot de kern uit en kunt jouw keuzes duidelijk uitleggen aan anderen.

Mooi meegenomen 🙌

Ervaring met containers, Kubernetes of Azure PaaS-diensten.
Ervaring met FinOps, kostenoptimalisatie of capacity management.
Ervaring met platformen voor data, integraties of AI.
Certificeringen zoals AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-400 of vergelijkbaar.

Heb je nog niet overal ervaring mee, maar herken je jezelf wel in de functie? Ook dan nodigen we je graag uit om te reageren.

Zie jij jezelf al bouwen aan het cloudfundament van Veneta? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Solliciteer direct en laat zien waarom jij onze nieuwe Cloud Engineer bent.

Enthousiast? Solliciteer!

Zie jij jezelf al bouwen aan een veilig, schaalbaar en slim cloudplatform voor Veneta? Solliciteer dan snel en ontdek zelf waarom werken bij Veneta zo leuk is.

Liever eerst wat meer weten? App met onze recruiter Niels via 06 5429 5664 of mail naar niels.hoolwerf@veneta.com .

Acquisitie? Liever niet.

Bij Veneta doen we graag zoveel mogelijk zelf, ook als het om recruitment gaat. We stellen acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature dan ook niet op prijs.

jobs.description:
MCP Expert (Java API Integration) Amsterdam

Hybrid | 12-Month Contract (Extendable) | Rate: Negotiable

**Required Qualifications (Must-Haves):**
* 5+ years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, release engineering, site reliability engineering, systems engineering, or similar hands-on roles.
* Strong hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation for production software systems.
* Practical experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar CI/CD and engineering workflow tools.
* Experience supporting multiple application environments such as development, QA, UAT, staging, and production.
* Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar tools.
* Experience with release management, deployment validation, rollback planning, environment troubleshooting, and production support.
* Understanding of application hosting concepts, web servers, APIs, background jobs, scheduled tasks, configuration management, certificates, secrets, and service dependencies.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational visibility tools.
* Ability to work with software engineers, QA, DBAs, infrastructure engineers, security teams, Product / Delivery Managers, and business stakeholders.
* Ability to diagnose build failures, deployment failures, environment issues, configuration problems, access problems, and production symptoms in a structured way.
* Understanding of security practices in software delivery, including least privilege, secrets management, access control, vulnerability remediation, and auditability.
* Practical experience with Git-based workflows, branching strategies, pull requests, release tagging, and deployment traceability.
* Clear communication skills with ability to explain platform risks, release blockers, deployment issues, and operational tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* High ownership mindset, good judgment, and ability to make practical decisions under pressure.

**Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Haves):**

* Working knowledge of observability tools such as Zabbix, Grafana, Prometheus, ELK / OpenSearch, Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, Azure Monitor, or similar tools.
* Background working with artifact repositories, package management, dependency scanning, static analysis, and software supply chain controls.

* Prior work supporting ERP, warehouse, internal business platforms, B2B transaction systems, e-commerce, supply chain, logistics, or similar business-critical environments.
* Track record of improving DevOps maturity in an organization where process, ownership, and documentation are still developing.
* Familiarity with cost optimization, license awareness, and practical platform efficiency improvements.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
About The Company

Siemens Healthineers is a globally leading medical technology company dedicated to shaping the future of healthcare. With a rich history rooted in innovation and a commitment to improving patient outcomes, Siemens Healthineers offers a wide range of diagnostic and therapeutic solutions, including imaging, laboratory diagnostics, molecular medicine, and digital health services. Employing over 74,000 professionals across more than 70 countries, the company is at the forefront of technological advancements in healthcare, delivering innovative products and services that benefit millions of patients worldwide. Siemens Healthineers fosters a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and diversity, striving to create a better healthcare environment through technological excellence and customer-centric solutions.

About The Role

We are seeking a dedicated and skilled Software Developer (w/m/d) specializing in Identity & Access Management to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be pivotal in designing, developing, and maintaining secure access solutions for our digital healthcare products. Your expertise will contribute to enhancing the security and usability of our systems, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including product owners, software architects, and international development groups, to implement innovative authentication and authorization mechanisms. This position offers flexibility regarding remote work, including the possibility of mobile working within Germany and abroad under certain conditions, supporting a balanced work-life integration.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, complemented by several years of professional experience in Authentication & Authorization. Proficiency in software development using C# and the .NET framework is essential, along with practical knowledge of Identity & Access Management concepts such as OAuth2, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and JWT. Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized microservice architectures is highly desirable. Familiarity with cloud-native development, deployment, and operation across cloud, on-premise, and edge environments is required. Candidates should also have experience with CI/CD tools like Azure DevOps or GitLab. Additional skills in Microsoft Entra ID, cybersecurity, or Zero-Trust architectures are advantageous. Prior experience in regulated environments, especially within healthcare, will be considered a plus.

Responsibilities

Support the development and enhancement of modern authentication and authorization solutions for digital healthcare products.
Implement and integrate identity and access management systems based on established standards such as OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and JWT.
Contribute to the creation of high-performance, maintainable backend components in C#/.NET tailored for distributed microservice architectures.
Participate in the deployment and operation of software solutions across cloud, on-premise, and edge environments, ensuring reliability and security.
Assist in optimizing Kubernetes-based deployments and managing containerized applications.

Security Operations & Governance Execution:

Description

The Agreements team within AWS Billing is looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our team in Berlin.

Are you interested in building the next generation, cloud-based commerce system for AWS that’s used by millions of customers worldwide? Are you excited by the idea of building real-time stream processing systems that operate at millions of records scale? Do you want to make an impact at a several-billion-a-year business? Then we need to talk!

Computing AWS bills, at its core, is a challenging, distributed systems problem that requires calculations performed over trillions of usage records, millions of accounts, and hundreds of thousands of different rates. Furthermore, our applications must meet strict requirements for accuracy and once-and-only-once processing.

As a Software Development Engineer, you will own problems end-to-end — whether that's the agentic automation powering zero-touch launches, the core data stores for agreements, or the systems that publish agreement and pricing information to AWS downstream clients. You will build on AWS technologies like DynamoDB, Lambda, Step Functions, and CDK, and collaborate directly with AWS service teams to deliver platforms that let them bring new products to market in minutes, not weeks.

The Agreements team within AWS Billing is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) team which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Collaborate with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring to market innovative products and services.

Practical experience working with Azure Cloud Services and Azure DevOps, or equivalent CI/CD tooling

This is an opportunity to join a well-established engineering team working on a global SaaS platform used by automotive retailers and OEMs around the world.

Competitive salary based on experience
Bonus scheme
Share scheme
Hybrid working (flexibility depending on your base location)
25 days holiday plus all UK bank holidays

Senior .NET Engineer | £85K | Hybrid 3 days in London | Fintech Client

A leading FinTech business based in Central London is looking to hire multiple Senior .NET Engineers to join a major transformation programme focused on modernising one of its core technology platforms.

You will join as one of the first senior engineers in a growing development team, helping to shape the technical direction of a new platform from an early stage. The role will involve modernising and migrating an existing system onto a new greenfield solution, with plenty of opportunity to influence architecture, engineering standards and development practices.

This is a hands-on senior engineering position, with a core technology stack including C#, .NET, Azure and Event-Driven Architecture
.

Salary & Location:

Salary up to £85,000 + bonus + benefits

Based in Central London

Hybrid working with 3 days per week in the office

Key Responsibilities:

Design and develop high-performance backend and integration services using C# and .NET
, supporting systems processing very large volumes of data at terabyte scale
.
Build scalable, resilient and highly performant applications
capable of operating within demanding, data-intensive environments.
Develop and maintain APIs, event-driven services and distributed applications
connecting internal platforms and services across the wider technology estate.
Work with event-driven and messaging architectures
to process and distribute high volumes of data efficiently and reliably.
Design solutions with a strong focus on performance, throughput and latency
, making appropriate architectural and engineering trade-offs for performance-sensitive systems.
Develop applications within a distributed private-cloud environment
, where infrastructure is hosted across geographically distributed, internally managed machines rather than a traditional public-cloud model.
Build and deploy containerised services

Apply strong software engineering principles around multithreading, concurrency, scalability, resilience and distributed systems

Follow established practices around automated testing, CI/CD, Git-based development and observability

Collaborate closely with Architects and Engineers to help define the architecture and technical direction of the new platform.
Produce and maintain clear technical, service and process documentation
.
Mentor and support other engineers, promoting strong development practices across .NET, distributed systems and event-driven architecture
.
Ensure solutions meet required security, governance, compliance and supportability standards
.

Experience working within high-volume data environments, distributed systems, private cloud infrastructure or performance-sensitive platforms
would be particularly advantageous.

If you are an experienced .NET Engineer looking to work on a large-scale modernisation programme and help shape a new platform from the ground up, please apply with your up-to-date CV.

During client delivery you will collaborate with Platform Engineers, Quality Engineers and AI Consultants to ensure that world class user experiences are understood, validation procedures are aligned and automation components are delivered.

Deep connections, better outcome

We prioritise supporting our people in balancing what matters to them while ensuring we meet our client commitments. Flexibility is key, as we sometimes need to adapt to meet client needs. People-first 

Great solutions start with great people and those great people are at their best when they’re empowered to be their true authentic selves through leading with kindness, empathy and striving for equity we’re able to create better experiences for our people and our clients. Our culture is central to everything we do - encouraging passion, adventure, adaptiveness and diversity of thought. Inclusion, diversity and equity is at the top of our agenda, we have created a community where we empower our team to be the best version of themselves.
Rewards 

There’s no shying away from it - the compensation and benefits on offer have to be competitive too, right? We know that. That’s why we have a dedicated team working with our leaders to ensure our packages are fair, competitive, and rewarding!

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

We’re looking for forward-thinking, passionate professionals who are ready to contribute to our mission and drive industry innovation. If you’re excited about making an immediate impact and shaping the future of property management, explore career opportunities with us at Plentific.
The Role

We're looking for a Software Architect

to join our engineering team and play a pivotal role in shaping the technical direction of our platform. This is not just a hands-on engineering role, it's a leadership position where you'll be expected to bridge the gap between product vision and technical execution.
You'll work closely with Product Managers to translate business requirements into robust technical strategies, produce detailed technical analyses, and guide a team of engineers toward successful, on-time delivery. At the same time, you'll remain deeply hands-on, contributing directly to our codebase and setting the bar for engineering excellence across the team.
Our engineering team sits at the centre of everything we do at Plentific and is constantly tackling challenging problems, such as online payments, quoting, invoicing, booking, search and scoring algorithms, ETL, data pipelines, in-app messaging, real-time notifications, and fraud prevention. Our backend engineers mostly work with Python and Django on a service-oriented architecture deployed at scale on Kubernetes. The rest of the tech stack includes Django REST Framework, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, AWS, React.js, Docker, Redis, Celery, Pandas, NumPy, Git, Jenkins, and Elasticsearch.
We put significant emphasis on design patterns, code readability, automated testing, maintainability, and extensibility. As Software Architect, you'll be the standard-bearer for these values.
At Plentific AI is at the core of how we build and deliver software. We expect our Software Architect to be fluent in AI-assisted development practices, leveraging AI tools across the entire engineering lifecycle: from spec-driven development and architectural design, to coding, code review, and delivery.

Collaborate closely with Product Managers to translate product requirements into comprehensive technical analyses, breaking down complexity into clear, actionable engineering plans with the help of AI spec-driven development tools
Define and own the technical roadmap for your team, ensuring architectural decisions align with business goals and long-term platform scalability
Guide and mentor engineers throughout the delivery lifecycle, from design through to deployment, ensuring the team stays on track and produces high-quality output
Act as the primary technical point of contact for your squad, facilitating alignment between engineering, product, and stakeholders

Architecture & Design

Design and evolve scalable, resilient microservices architectures using Django and Python, deployed on Kubernetes at scale
Lead the design of APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems with a strong focus on performance, reliability, and maintainability
Define and enforce best practices around database design, query optimisation, and data modelling across relational databases (PostgreSQL)
Evaluate emerging technologies and architectural patterns, making evidence-based recommendations to the broader engineering organisation

Hands-On Engineering

Build and maintain APIs, microservices, and data pipelines
Write complex SQL queries and optimise database performance
Debug and resolve issues across our applications, including production incidents
Review, maintain, and refactor existing code to support improved or new features

AI-Driven Development

Delivery & Collaboration

Work with product owners, engineering managers, UI designers, and engineers to produce technical specifications and project documentation
Remove technical blockers and proactively surface risks to delivery, proposing pragmatic solutions

The current primary objective is migrating existing on-premise systems to a modern Microsoft Azure cloud environment, transforming legacy architecture into scalable, cloud-native solutions. It involves rebuilding and adapting systems used for structuring, processing, and distributing securities such as ABS, MBS, and CLOs. The platform integrates with trading, risk, and regulatory systems to support both real-time and batch data processing. The target architecture follows a microservices-based approach with containerized services deployed on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Infrastructure provisioning and configuration are managed using Terraform as Infrastructure as Code. The system leverages REST APIs and event-driven communication to ensure scalability and flexibility during and after migration. Special focus is placed on maintaining data consistency, performance, and regulatory compliance throughout the transition. The project emphasizes high availability, resilience, and observability in a complex financial ecosystem. AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot are integrated to enhance engineering productivity. The environment promotes modern engineering practices, automation, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java 11+ and Spring Boot within a microservices architecture.
Build and enhance RESTful APIs and message-driven services supporting securitization and credit workflows.
Develop and deploy cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure, including AKS-based container orchestration.
Use Terraform to define and manage infrastructure as code.
Work with containerization technologies (Docker) and contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitLab or GitHub.
Implement integrations using messaging systems such as Kafka, IBM MQ, or Tibco EMS.
Collaborate on system design, ensuring scalability, resilience, and alignment with distributed architecture principles.
Develop and optimize database interactions using Azure SQL, Oracle, or Sybase.
Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality and reliability.
Implement monitoring, logging, and observability practices to support production systems.
Utilize Linux/Unix skills for troubleshooting and scripting.
Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency while maintaining high coding standards.

Mandatory Skills Description:

• Strong object-oriented programming skills with Java 11+
• Extensive experience with Spring Boot / Spring ecosystem
• Hands-on development of Web and/or REST APIs and message-driven services
• Experience building and running containerized applications
• Strong experience with Azure cloud, including:
• Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform
• Kubernetes (AKS) and container orchestration
• Compute (VMs) and storage solutions (e.g., Azure Files)
• Solid Linux/Unix skills (shell scripting, system understanding)
• Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) integrated into development workflows
• Experience with GitLab / GitHub, IntelliJ / VSCode

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

• Microservices architecture and system design
• Messaging and integration technologies: Kafka, IBM MQ, Tibco EMS
• Relational databases: Azure SQL, Oracle, Sybase
• Testing frameworks (unit, integration and E2E testing)
• CI/CD pipelines (GitLab / GitHub)
• Monitoring and observability practices

Appgate · Core Team · Gothenburg, Sweden

Want to build software where you can see the difference your work makes?
At Appgate, we develop IT security software that helps organizations control access to their applications and infrastructure. We're looking for a senior fullstack developer with strong C# experience to join our Core team, building the Appgate SDP client with C# and React/TypeScript. You'll also contribute to the Java REST backend that the same team works on.
We offer a balance that can be hard to find: a company large enough to surround you with experienced engineers, and small enough for your individual contribution to matter. Here, you can take ownership of substantial features and entire subsystems, help shape technical decisions, and follow your work from the first idea through to customers using it. Why Appgate? The people around you make a difference.
At Appgate, you'll work with colleagues who bring deep experience in software development, networking and security. There are people to learn from, discuss difficult problems with, and help you explore unfamiliar areas.
At the same time, there is room to make your own mark. We value developers who ask questions, suggest improvements and take responsibility for moving things forward. As your knowledge of the product grows, so does your opportunity to influence it.
Appgate is growing, with major customer contracts driving expansion across our engineering teams. We're also developing new capabilities in areas such as operational technology (OT), helping secure access to industrial systems. Joining now means contributing as those capabilities take shape.
We're also developing AI-related capabilities in Appgate SDP. As a client and controller developer, you may contribute to how these features connect with the rest of the product, bringing new functionality into the applications and services you work on.

Requirements

Your role in the Core team

The Core team develops the client and controller at the heart of Appgate SDP.
The client is the software users interact with to connect securely. The controller manages the policies and access decisions that determine what they can reach.
This is a fullstack role:
your work will span the client, its C# logic and React/TypeScript interface, and the Java REST backend that powers it. You'll move across this boundary regularly, understanding how a feature connects from backend logic through to what the user sees. 1 Appgate | Core Team We use agentic AI tools as part of our development workflow and continue to explore where they can help us build, test and improve software. You'll have the opportunity to help shape how we use these tools, applying the same engineering judgment and attention to quality that we bring to the rest of our work.
You'll help us:

• Develop features for the Appgate client, using C#, React/TypeScript and Electron.
• Develop features for the Java REST backend.
• Investigate and resolve problems across applications, operating systems and networks.
• Improve automated testing, developer tooling and build and release workflows.
• Shape technical solutions through design discussions, code reviews and collaboration across teams.
What you bring

You enjoy building software, understanding how things work, and seeing a solution through. You're comfortable taking initiative, while knowing when to involve others and work through a problem together.
We're looking for:

• Strong professional experience with C#. • Backend development experience, ideally with Java.
• Experience with, or working knowledge of, React, TypeScript and Electron. • Confidence supporting and debugging software across Windows, macOS and Linux.
• A working understanding of Unix systems. • An interest in writing maintainable code and improving how it is tested and delivered.
• Good communication skills in English.

Benefits

Build something, you can put your name to If you're looking for room to grow, experienced colleagues to learn from, and the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of a security product, we'd like to hear from you.
Join Appgate's Core team and help shape what comes next.

As an Engineering Manager at Tide, you will be responsible for building and running the products your team owns, covering everything our members need to run their business, from banking and payments through to administration and operational tooling.

This role offers an exceptional opportunity to make a real difference by taking ownership of engineering practices in a rapidly expanding company! We trust and empower our Engineering Managers to make real architectural decisions that affect their domain and shape the future of Tide’s Platform.

We operate in domain-aligned, full-stack teams that own products end to end. Engineers self-organise, collaborate on technical challenges, and define shared standards through Communities of Practice.

Being responsible of the tech excellence and architecture within the scope of the team

Securing the continuous growth and wellbeing of the engineers on their team

Extensive experience (10+ years) building server-side applications and detailed knowledge of of Python, Java, C#, or another similar language
Sound knowledge of a backend framework (e.g. Spring/Spring Boot)
Experience with running microservices and implementing and consuming RESTful APIs
Experience engineering scalable and reliable solutions in a cloud-native environment
A mindset of delivering secure, well-tested and well-documented software
Full ownership of your code and technical solutions across their entire lifecycle, from development to production.

Sound knowledge and experience working with relational databases

Ability to communicate technical concepts to a non-technical audience

Experience leading teams
Experience directly managing people

Python, Java, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices (but we welcome people who are used to any strongly typed general purpose programming language!)
Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable

GitHub, Semgrep and solid testing to power the CI/CD pipelines - new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first week
Angular on Web, Flutter for our mobile app, but from time to time we use Swift and Kotlin
Fivetran/BigQuery/Looker for the BI insights and Python/FastAPI/Faust + some ML libs for the automated decisioning and risk management

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
About Tide

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide Facts

Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly
Over $300 million raised in funding
Over 2,800 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Role

As an Engineering Manager at Tide, you will be responsible for building and running the products your team owns, covering everything our members need to run their business, from banking and payments through to administration and operational tooling.

This role offers an exceptional opportunity to make a real difference by taking ownership of engineering practices in a rapidly expanding company! We trust and empower our Engineering Managers to make real architectural decisions that affect their domain and shape the future of Tide’s Platform.

We operate in domain-aligned, full-stack teams that own products end to end. Engineers self-organise, collaborate on technical challenges, and define shared standards through Communities of Practice.

Leading & Directly managing a cross functional team of 8-12 engineers
Partnering with a Product Manager to form the Product Engineering Duo
Deeply caring about what’s being built as much as the how
Being responsible of the delivery of the team - quality, stability, timelines, dependencies
Being responsible of the tech excellence and architecture within the scope of the team
Driving the continuous improvement of the team performance as measured by DORA
Securing the continuous growth and wellbeing of the engineers on their team
Being hands-on, carefully dividing your time between design, coding and coaching other team members. You will be the person people turn to seeking advice and solutions to difficult problems.

What We Are Looking For

Extensive experience (10+ years) building server-side applications and detailed knowledge of of Python, Java, C#, or another similar language
Sound knowledge of a backend framework (e.g. Spring/Spring Boot)
Experience with running microservices and implementing and consuming RESTful APIs
Experience engineering scalable and reliable solutions in a cloud-native environment
A mindset of delivering secure, well-tested and well-documented software
Full ownership of your code and technical solutions across their entire lifecycle, from development to production.
Experience integrating with various third party providers and partners
Sound knowledge and experience working with relational databases
Work effectively in an agile environment, using its practices to deliver value consistently and adapt quickly
Ability to communicate technical concepts to a non-technical audience
Apply continuous integration, delivery, and deployment practices in day-to-day development to deliver software reliably to production
A technical hands on leader who is in the details of what the team is working on day to day
Experience leading teams
Experience directly managing people

Our Tech Stack

Python, Java, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices (but we welcome people who are used to any strongly typed general purpose programming language!)
Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable
Primary datastores are PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users)
Docker, Terraform, ArgoCD and, EKS provided by the Cloud team to run the platform
DataDog for monitoring, observability and automated SLOs
GitHub, Semgrep and solid testing to power the CI/CD pipelines - new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first week
Angular on Web, Flutter for our mobile app, but from time to time we use Swift and Kotlin
Fivetran/BigQuery/Looker for the BI insights and Python/FastAPI/Faust + some ML libs for the automated decisioning and risk management

What You’ll Get In Return

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

Remote first
25 days of paid annual leave
3 paid days off for volunteering or L&D activities
Private Health Insurance
Mental Health Support Platform
FitPass
Family and friendly leave (according to statutory)
Personal L&D budget
Share Options

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace
model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

Disclaimer

It Has Come To Our Attention That Individuals Or Agencies Are Falsely Claiming To Represent Tide And Are Reaching Out To Candidates Regarding Job Opportunities. Please Be Aware That

Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co

Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice .

First, let us tell you more about Forge Digital

We are Forge Digital – a technology agency with cutting-edge solutions and strong domain knowledge in digitalization across manufacturing, retail & logistics, and energy. Our mission is to improve our clients' performance. We guide companies in assessing their current digital maturity, identifying digital challenges and opportunities, and designing a customized digitalization roadmap. What we look for

As a Senior Developer or Architect at Forge, you will design and build robust, scalable systems – from operational and business applications to industrial operator interfaces and real-time situational awareness solutions. You will take technical ownership of complex projects, collaborate closely with clients, and help shape how we work.

Here are a few examples of what you could be working on at Forge:
Development of AI-powered solutions: applied AI for decisioning, optimization, and predictive systems, as well as agentic and generative AI capabilities embedded directly into business applications
Development of operational work-enhancing solutions and real-time situational awareness systems
Development of integrations connecting production, business, and automation systems (IT/OT)
Development of data pipelines, data platforms, and event-driven architectures
Business-critical and high-availability system development
Legacy system modernization for AI-assisted development practices

Our main technology stack includes .NET, C#, Node.js, NestJS, and TypeScript – though we are technology-agnostic and always select the best tools considering the entire solution lifecycle. We work with Azure and AWS cloud platforms, hybrid cloud environments, and on-premises solutions.

Fluency in both written and spoken Finnish and English is required.

How to forge success in this role

To succeed in this role, you bring solid hands-on experience in software development and a genuine interest in building industrial-grade solutions. The following are what we consider essential:
AI-assisted development
: You are comfortable working in AI-assisted development workflows – using AI tooling to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and maintain high standards of human oversight.
Software architecture
: You can design and own the technical architecture of complex, distributed systems – making sound decisions that consider the full solution lifecycle.
Core technologies
: Strong knowledge of most of our main technologies (.NET/C#, Node.js/TypeScript) and databases such as MS SQL, PostgreSQL, and/or document databases.
Container environments
: Comfortable working with containerized applications and deploying to Kubernetes or similar environments.
Event-driven architectures
: Solid experience designing and building event-driven systems and messaging patterns, using tools such as RabbitMQ or Azure Service Bus.
Domain knowledge
: Background in manufacturing, logistics, or energy sectors.
Cloud and infrastructure mindset
: Solid understanding of Azure and/or AWS services, cloud-native architectures, and hybrid environments.
Communication & client interaction
: As a senior member in a consultancy setting, you are comfortable engaging with clients, facilitating technical discussions, and translating business needs into technical solutions.

The following experience is considered an advantage:
Experience building and integrating LLM-based solutions, including agentic workflows and MCP-based systems
Experience with industrial data exchange standards such as OPC UA or similar IT/OT integration patterns
Frontend development experience (React or similar)
Python and data engineering or analytics background

More than anything, we value a learning-oriented mindset and genuine willingness to keep developing your skills.

What we offer

At Forge, senior developers and architects have real influence over how systems are designed and delivered – you will shape technical direction, define standards, and solve problems that directly affect project outcomes. Our clients operate in sectors where the systems you build genuinely matter.

You will join a highly motivated and experienced team, with whom to build the story of Forge Digital. As a newly established company, we provide a real opportunity to put your mark on how we work, operate, and innovate with clients.

This position is full-time, and the start date is agreed with the chosen candidate. We offer a competitive salary based on your experience level. Our comfy offices in the GO21-building in Tampere and Helsinki city center offer a great atmosphere to work in. We work in a flexible hybrid model and put a lot of focus on building a strong team culture and cohesion. In addition, we offer:
A competitive salary, which within the framework of this role is approximately 5000-6000€/month, depending on your experience level
Lunch benefit
ePassi Flex budget of 1 000 €/year
Mobile phone benefit
Home internet
Health and accident insurance
Daily refreshments at the office

Your supervisor will be there to spar on personal learning, career development, and possible training needs.

Our recruitment process

If Forge's approach resonates with you, send us your application and join our skilled team! Our application form is easy and quick: simply add your contact information, CV, and cover letter to the form below. You can also share your LinkedIn profile or attach any other relevant documents you wish. Apply soon, as we will process applications during the application period. In our recruitment process, you can expect to have a couple of interviews, including technical interview.

For more information about the position and our company, you can contact Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist Matilda Mäkinen (matilda.makinen@krosswise.com / 0504330642).
Let’s find a suitable role for you at Forge – together!

Vil du være med til at holde vores kunders data-, AI- og platformmiljøer kørende – og lære af nogle af branchens dygtigste undervejs?

Vi søger en nysgerrig og struktureret Associate til vores Service Delivery-team. Du får en fod inden for drift af moderne dataplatforme fra dag ét, med erfarne kolleger tæt på og en klar oplæring i vores runbooks og processer.

Service Delivery holder kundernes data-, AI- og platformmiljøer kørende – pålideligt, kontinuerligt og i stor skala. Teamet håndterer incidents, driver problemløsning frem mod systemiske fixes frem for gentagne workarounds, automatiserer driftsopgaver og bruger AI-agenter til at forbedre svartid og servicekvalitet.

Som Associate bliver du en del af den daglige drift af kundernes dataplatforme og indgår i vores supportvagt kl. 07:00-17:00, hvor du håndterer standardincidents efter godkendte runbooks under vejledning fra erfarne kolleger.

Din rolle hos Inspari

Som Associate Operations Engineer er du med til at sikre, at kundernes dataplatforme kører stabilt og forudsigeligt. Du arbejder tæt sammen med erfarne kolleger og tager gradvist mere ansvar, efterhånden som du bliver tryg i rollen.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:
Overvåge alerts og håndtere standardincidents inden for scope ved hjælp af godkendte runbooks.
Udføre restarts, re-runs og validering af data loads og refreshes.
Bruge AI til at opsummere incidents, give forslag til runbook-opdateringer og fremskynde log-analyse – altid med validering, før noget output bruges aktivt.
Dokumentere fund og bidrage til løbende forbedring af runbooks og known-issues.
Eskalere korrekt med tydelig kontekst og evidens, når en sag ligger uden for scope.
Give klare skriftlige opdateringer i tickets, Teams og mail efter en simpel struktur (Hvad er der sket / Status nu / Næste skridt / Ansvarlig) og sikre gode overdragelser, så den næste kollega kan fortsætte uden at miste kontekst.
Deltage aktivt i supportvagten kl. 07:00-17:00

Sådan bliver du en succes i rollen

Du håndterer standardincidents og service requests konsekvent og korrekt ved hjælp af etablerede runbooks.
Du leverer klar dokumentation og gode overdragelser, som gør det nemt for kolleger at tage over.
Du bruger AI-værktøjer ansvarligt – med fokus på korrekthed, ingen misbrug af følsomme data og altid validering før handling.
Du deltager pålideligt i supportvagten med forudsigelig udførelse og tydelige overdragelser.

Din profil

Denne rolle er skabt til dig, der er tidligt i din karriere. Du behøver ikke have en lang erfaring i bagagen – bare en solid teknisk grundforståelse og lyst til at lære. Rollen giver dig et bredt indblik i drift af moderne dataplatforme og kan være et naturligt afsæt til videre specialisering inden for fx AI, data platform eller platform engineering.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:
Har en grundlæggende forståelse af dataplatforme, databaser og cloud-teknologier – gerne med kendskab til Microsoft Azure, SQL, Power BI, Fabric, Databricks eller lignende.
Har stærke analytiske evner og kan fejlfinde struktureret.
Kommunikerer klart med både kunder og tekniske kolleger.
Arbejder struktureret med incidents, opgaver og dokumentation.
Tager ejerskab for mindre tekniske opgaver og følger dem til dørs.
Har gode engelsk- og tyskkundskaber, både skriftligt og mundtligt.

Derudover er du nysgerrig, proaktiv og har lyst til at lære. Du har en stærk ansvarsfølelse, er serviceminded og trives med direkte kundekontakt. Du kan holde hovedet koldt, når flere sager kører samtidig, og du er ikke bange for at spørge og lære af erfarne kolleger, mens du gradvist tager mere ansvar.

Hvad vi tilbyder

Hos Inspari bliver du en del af et ambitiøst konsulenthus med stærk specialisering inden for data og AI og komplekse opgaver hos enterprise-kunder.

Du får blandt andet:
En struktureret oplæring i vores runbooks, processer og vidensystemer
Tæt sparring med erfarne kolleger i Service Delivery og på tværs af Platform Engineering og Data Platform-teams
Mulighed for at arbejde med AI-værktøjer som en naturlig del af driften
En klar vej til mere ansvar og faglig udvikling, efterhånden som du vokser i rollen
Certificeringsforløb, der klæder dig på fagligt
En kultur præget af høj faglighed, ansvar, samarbejde og Heartwork

Lokation

Du vil være tilknyttet vores kontor i Kgs. Lyngby (København) eller Lystrup (Aarhus), hvor arbejdet foregår i en hybrid model mellem kontoret og hjemmearbejde.

Rejseaktivitet

Rollen indebærer en vis rejseaktivitet, som planlægges løbende i samarbejde med dig.

Ansøg nu

Hvis rollen matcher din erfaring, faglige profil og det ansvar, du ønsker fremover, glæder vi os til at modtage dit CV og din ansøgning.
Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

As part of the H&F Integration team you are crucial in delivering new mechatronic features on Multi ECU, Multi CAN vehicle network architectures for this high performance agricultural equipment.

Key Responsibilities

Define the control system software requirements, software specification and software structure for vehicle applications
Maintain, archive, and control application source code, manage SW releases
Implement the software architecture and strategies, requirements for closed loop control algorithms, User Interface and related software control logic dealing with complex product offering
Perform unit testing and system integration testing with the hardware and software, via simulation and on-board executions.
Define & Execute test scenarios to verify the implemented control / monitoring strategy
Support Product Validation and Verification Engineers as they conduct Functional and Performance testing
Analyse and interpret field data to improve feature development and troubleshooting. (i.e. CAN traces)
Produce documentation in support of design, implementation, and test activities

Experience Required

Bachelor or Master degree in Electrical, Computer or similar engineering discipline
Experience/knowledge of using C & C# Programming language
Experience with industry coding standards for software development such as MISRA-C
Experience with CAN and/or LIN protocols and diagnostic tools such as Vector CANalyzer®
Demonstrated problem-solving capabilities and experience

Proficient in English, both written and verbal

Experience with code debuggers, code analysis, and memory management

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Working at CNH means working in an environment where, thanks in part to its international character, numerous development opportunities are available. More than 2,500 people work at CNH Belgium’s site in Zedelgem. This single location houses various departments, ranging from design—with an R&D center employing around 400 people—to production, service, dealer training, and all support departments.

CNH Belgium in Zedelgem is also located in a traffic-free area and is easily accessible.

We offer a very attractive salary package with numerous fringe benefits such as insurance, eco vouchers, meal vouchers, a cafeteria plan (Flex Ben), and no less than 20.5 working time reduction days on top of the statutory vacation days (in a full-time system).

Are you as passionate as our people? Would you like to be part of a great team and help build the most innovative and largest agricultural machines on the market? Apply now!

El perfil tendrá una visión transversal de ambos pilares, desde la definición de arquitectura y selección tecnológica hasta el despliegue, escalabilidad, seguridad, observabilidad y operación, con orientación a negocio y a la identificación de casos de uso e impacto real de las soluciones.

Diseñar arquitecturas de IA generativa, agentes, sistemas multiagente, Machine Learning, Deep Learning y Computer Vision.

Seleccionar servicios, patrones arquitectónicos, modelos y frameworks adecuados según el caso de uso, los requisitos no funcionales y las restricciones del cliente.

Diseñar estrategias de evaluación, observabilidad, seguridad, gobierno, escalabilidad y optimización de costes.

Evolucionar soluciones desde prototipos hasta arquitecturas preparadas para producción.

Conocimientos de soluciones de IA generativa, agentes, sistemas multiagente, Machine Learning, Deep Learning y Computer Vision.

Conocimientos de Microsoft Foundry, Foundry Agent Service, Foundry Models, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Agent Framework, LangChain y LangGraph.

Conocimientos de evaluación, observabilidad, seguridad, gobierno, escalabilidad y optimización de costes de soluciones de IA.

Traducir necesidades y objetivos de negocio en soluciones tecnológicas concretas, escalables, seguras, gobernadas y mantenibles.
