Essential Experience

Significant experience in software engineering, technical leadership or principal engineering roles within complex enterprise environments.
Proven experience influencing technical strategy across multiple teams, products or technology domains.
Demonstrable experience leading technology transformation, platform modernisation or engineering improvement initiatives.
Experience operating within highly matrixed, global organisations.

Technical Expertise

Strong full-stack engineering expertise across modern application architectures, APIs, integrations and cloud-native platforms, including Azure.
Deep understanding of software engineering principles, design patterns, architecture and system design.
Strong understanding of event-driven architectures, API-first design and integration patterns.
Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, automation, observability and operational excellence practices.
Strong understanding of security, resilience, scalability and performance engineering.
Ability to challenge and assess vendor-supplied architectures and technical solutions.
Experience balancing SaaS, third-party and internally developed capabilities to maximise strategic value.

Leadership & Influence Skills

Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Credibility and confidence engaging with senior technology and business leadership teams.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence without direct authority.
Ability to build consensus across global, regional and vendor organisations.

Strategic & Commercial Acumen

Ability to align technology decisions to business strategy, customer outcomes and commercial objectives.
Experience evaluating technical debt, technology investments and platform sustainability.

Leadership Behaviours

Highly self-motivated and comfortable operating autonomously.
Challenges thinking constructively and drives positive change.
Takes ownership and accountability for outcomes.
Demonstrates resilience and adaptability in fast-changing environments.
Collaborates effectively across cultures, geographies and organisational boundaries.

Experience supporting geographically distributed engineering teams.

Experience working alongside Product Management organisations in a product-led operating model.

jobs.description:
About This Role

Vice President, AI-Enabled Product Engineer – Aladdin, Investments & Trading Engineering

Location:
Edinburgh

About The Role

BlackRock is seeking a Vice President, AI-Enabled Product Engineer to join Aladdin, Investments & Trading Engineering within Analytics & Compliance Engineering. This role is for a hands-on engineering leader who can build scalable agentic solutions while helping accelerate the adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices across the product development lifecycle.

The successful candidate will work at the intersection of investment technology, investment compliance workflows, full-stack engineering, and applied AI. They will help design and deliver capabilities across the Aladdin platform that support investment professionals, compliance teams, and business stakeholders operating in complex global markets.

About Aladdin, Investments & Trading Engineering

Aladdin is BlackRock’s technology platform used by investment professionals to manage portfolios, analyse risk, execute workflows, and make decisions at scale. Within Investments & Trading Engineering, Analytics & Compliance Engineering develops technology that helps teams manage investment guidelines, regulatory obligations, analytics-driven workflows, and operational controls across global markets.

The Investment and Trading Compliance Engineering team is responsible for developing and maintaining tools to ensure that organizations using Aladdin® comply at different stages of the asset management process. This includes ensuring that clients follow guidelines established internally, by themselves, and by the market regulators. The system accomplishes this through high-throughput rule-based compliance engines, which sit at the heart of the investment system and process millions of calculations per day.

Our engineering teams build products with real reach, real complexity, and real impact. We are evolving our platform with persona-based, workflow-driven experiences, modular architecture, resilient services, and responsible AI capabilities that improve productivity, decision-making, knowledge discovery, and operational efficiency.

What You’ll Do

Design, build, and deliver high-quality full-stack Agnetic product capabilities across the Aladdin platform, with a focus on Analytics & Compliance Engineering workflows.
Act as a hands-on technical leader across the product development lifecycle, contributing to technical design, implementation, testing, deployment readiness, production support, and continuous improvement.
Partner with product managers, engineers, compliance specialists, and business stakeholders to translate complex business problems into clear specifications, technical designs, delivery plans, and actionable Agile backlogs.
Apply AI-enabled engineering practices to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, software development, testing, code review, documentation, and operational support.
Help embed responsible AI capabilities into product workflows and platform services, including intelligent assistants, workflow automation, semantic search, knowledge retrieval, and reasoning over compliance and investment information.
Build scalable, resilient, and operable systems that balance functional requirements with non-functional concerns such as performance, latency, reliability, security, observability, and maintainability.
Influence architecture and technical direction across initiatives, articulating design trade-offs and aligning stakeholders around pragmatic engineering choices.
Champion engineering excellence through test-driven development, behaviour-driven development, DevOps practices, production readiness, and an SRE mindset.
Mentor engineers, raise the bar for technical quality, and contribute to a culture of continuous learning, innovation, accountability, and collaboration across a global engineering organisation.

Qualifications

Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related STEM discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience delivering enterprise-scale systems in production.
Strong full-stack engineering background, with hands-on experience in modern backend and frontend technologies.
Proven ability to lead technical initiatives, shape ambiguous problem spaces, define execution plans, and deliver outcomes through collaboration with cross-functional partners.
Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, distributed systems, APIs, data flows, event-driven architecture, and resilient platform design.
Experience applying modern Agile, DevOps, and engineering excellence practices to improve delivery quality, team productivity, and operational outcomes.
Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Skills And Experience

Hands on experience with AI enabled SDLC / PDLC practices, including:
Using AI to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, and architectural decision making
Applying AI assisted development, testing, code review, and documentation practices
Embedding AI capabilities into product workflows and platform services responsibly and securely
Frameworks such as Devin / Windsurf, Cursor or GitHub Copilot
Hands-on full stack experience with Java or other modern backend languages, and frontend frameworks such as React or Angular.
Experience designing and operating APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures at enterprise scale.
Exposure to Generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, embeddings, knowledge retrieval, or agentic workflow patterns.
Strong focus on software quality, including automated testing, TDD, BDD, code review discipline, observability, resiliency, and production support.
Ability to reason about scalability, reliability, security, cost, maintainability, and delivery velocity when making technical decisions.
Experience working in large, global engineering organisations and collaborating across locations, time zones, product areas, and stakeholder groups.
Ability to build domain context quickly and translate investment, analytics, or compliance workflows into robust product and platform capabilities.

Preferred Experience

Experience in financial services, investment technology, compliance technology, regulatory technology, portfolio management, trading, or enterprise SaaS platforms.
Familiarity with compliance workflows, investment guidelines, rule intelligence, regulatory obligations, or controls-oriented technology.
Experience with cloud-native or hybrid architectures, containerisation, Kubernetes, observability platforms, CI/CD, and modern platform engineering practices.
Experience with AI governance, responsible AI principles, evaluation frameworks, model quality metrics, or monitoring of AI-enabled systems.
Exposure to domain-driven design, micro frontend architectures, platform strategies, or modular product architectures that enable multiple teams to deliver independently and consistently.

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

Are we a perfect match? Check out this video and find out!

As with most things in life, who cares, wins. We really care about inclusion.

It’s about being future-relevant and durable. We owe it to ourselves and the industry to ensure we are playing our part in creating a fair, balanced and transparent financial services sector.  
More diversity means broader experience, a wider set of perspectives and a better collective ability to problem-solve. And it means being more representative of customer groups, which supports areas such as product development.  
At Nucleus, we offer a generous blend of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including a non-contributory pension, bonus, enhanced parental leave, paid time off for emergencies, health and wellbeing initiatives and flexible working options.

Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

Build technology that solves real business problems
We are looking for an experienced Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
to work at the intersection of technology, data, AI and the business.

This is not a traditional software engineering role. You will work directly with our investment, operations and distribution teams, spending time with the people who use our technology to understand their workflows, identify meaningful problems and build solutions that make a measurable difference.

You will have the autonomy to take ideas from problem definition through to production, often moving from prototype to a working solution in days or weeks rather than months.

The role
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:
Work directly with business teams to understand their workflows, challenges and opportunities.
Identify high-impact problems where software, automation, data or AI can improve how we operate.
Rapidly prototype solutions, test them with users and iterate based on real-world feedback.
Take successful prototypes through to production, building secure, reliable and maintainable services.
Work across the full technology stack, including backend services, APIs, data pipelines and user-facing applications.
Integrate data and systems across APIs, databases, files and message queues, turning complex and fragmented data into useful products and services.
Apply modern AI and LLM capabilities to accelerate delivery and create new ways of working.
Partner closely with engineering, data and platform teams to align with architecture, security and technology standards.
Maintain a strong focus on security, governance, data protection and operational resilience, particularly where solutions interact with client assets and regulated activity.

About you
You are a hands-on engineer and pragmatic problem solver who enjoys being close to the people you build for.
You are comfortable operating in environments where the problem is not always clearly defined. You can ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, make sensible trade-offs and move quickly from an idea to something users can actually work with.
You are equally comfortable discussing architecture with engineers, mapping a business process with a subject matter expert, or explaining a technical trade-off to a senior stakeholder.
Most importantly, you care about building the right thing, not simply building things right.

Experience needed for the role:
4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering and supporting production systems.
Experience taking projects end to end, from problem definition and design through development, deployment and ongoing improvement.
Experience working directly with users, clients or business stakeholders is highly desirable.
Strong experience integrating APIs, databases, files and messaging systems, and working with complex or imperfect real-world data.
Experience in financial services, investment management, asset management or another regulated, data-intensive environment is highly desirable.
Experience using modern AI/LLM technologies, or a demonstrated ability and enthusiasm to adopt them quickly.

Technical skills
We are looking for strong engineering fundamentals rather than a specific technology background. Experience with one or more of the following is valuable:
Programming: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, C# or Go.
Full stack development: backend services, APIs and modern web applications.
Data: SQL, PostgreSQL, Azure SQL, data modelling, cloud storage and graph technologies, including GraphRAG.
Cloud and infrastructure: Azure, containers, CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
Security: authentication, authorisation, data isolation, input validation and secure handling of sensitive information.
AI: LLMs, AI-assisted development, intelligent automation and emerging AI application patterns.

If you are an engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working directly with users and turning ideas into production technology, we would like to hear from you.

Demonstrable experience as a Technical Architect at a Programme level, capable of multitasking and prioritising technical debt alongside project deliverables.

Strong proficiency in ALM practices and DevOps automation.
Excellent technical documentation skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Familiarity with configuring autonomous agents and utilizing AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery velocity.
Proficiency in modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Angular) for complex PCF (Power Apps Component Framework) control development.
Proven track record in scripting complex data transformations from legacy on-premise systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle) to Dataverse.

Strong commercial experience developing with C# and .NET / .NET Core

Solid understanding of object-oriented design, SOLID principles and clean code

What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Staff Software Engineer
in Revenue Intelligence, you will shape the technical direction of systems that help hospitality businesses understand demand, identify revenue opportunities, and make better pricing and commercial decisions. You will work across customer-facing applications, backend services, data pipelines, analytical stores, recommendation workflows, and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will solve complex engineering problems directly while establishing architecture, improving reliability and security, reducing systemic technical debt, and aligning multiple teams around durable technical decisions. Your impact will extend beyond individual features to the quality, scalability, operability, and long-term evolution of the Revenue Intelligence platform.

Our Revenue Intelligence Team:

The Revenue Intelligence team builds products and platforms that turn hospitality data into practical decisions for hoteliers, including pricing recommendations, demand insights, reporting, automation, and commercial opportunities. Our systems span frontend experiences, APIs, distributed services, data processing, machine-learning workflows, and production infrastructure. We value pragmatic engineering, strong ownership, evidence-based decisions, and technical leaders who raise the effectiveness of the people and systems around them.

What You Bring to the Team:

Set and evolve the technical strategy for Revenue Intelligence, translating product and business goals into coherent architecture and executable engineering plans
Lead the design and delivery of complex capabilities across customer-facing web applications, backend APIs, event-driven services, data pipelines, analytical storage, and recommendation workflows
Identify and resolve systemic risks in scalability, reliability, security, data quality, observability, and operability before they become recurring customer or engineering problems
Drive modernization of legacy systems and infrastructure through incremental, well-reasoned migrations that preserve delivery momentum and production stability
Partner with Product, Data Science, Infrastructure, Security, and engineering leaders to define boundaries, contracts, ownership, and long-term platform direction
Remain hands-on in the codebase through implementation, technical spikes, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and the most consequential or ambiguous engineering work
Raise the technical effectiveness of the wider organization through mentoring, architecture guidance, engineering standards, documentation, and constructive challenge

What Sets You Up for Success:

10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant technical leadership across complex production systems
Deep hands-on expertise in Python, with the ability to work effectively across both ecosystems and guide engineering decisions beyond a single language
Strong architecture and distributed-systems fundamentals, including API design, event-driven workflows, consistency, failure handling, scalability, and service boundaries
Experience with data-intensive systems such as PostgreSQL, Redshift, or similar analytical platforms, batch and streaming pipelines, and large-scale data processing
Experience designing or operating recommendation systems, machine-learning platforms, pricing systems, experimentation workflows, or other decision-support products
Strong cloud and platform engineering experience across AWS, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, CI/CD, observability, and secure production operations
A demonstrated ability to lead through influence, create alignment across teams, communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, and drive decisions from ambiguity to execution
A strong record of improving engineering quality through testing strategy, operational readiness, incident learning, security, documentation, and sustainable technical standards
Product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to connect technical investments to measurable outcomes for hoteliers and the business
Business-level English fluency and experience collaborating effectively in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

Deep hands-on expertise in .NET/C#

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Hitachi Solutions Europe is a global Digital, Data and Technology consultancy, Microsoft Gold partner and Cloud Services partner, specialising in end-to-end transformation.

As a global consultancy firm working across the private and public sectors, we specialise in Dynamics 365 Business Applications, Power Platform, including Azure, Application Modernisation and Data & Analytics.

Our highly skilled team help drive improvements, creating efficiency and growth within organisations. We are committed to Microsoft technologies, with a mission to revolutionise modern businesses. To achieve this we employ the best, most dedicated talent to deliver outstanding technology solutions to both our local and global clients.

Be part of our Hitachi family

We place value on collaboration, open communication, and transparency. We emphasise the importance of team spirit, cohesion, and appreciation – And through our talented people, innovative culture, and technical and business expertise, we deliver game changing outcomes every day. Our learning culture and flat hierarchy are our recipes for success. But don´t take our word for it – Have a look at what our employees are saying: Hitachi Solutions: Recruiting the best talent and offering outstanding career opportunities (hitachi-solutions.co.uk)

What To Expect, Your Benefits

Hitachi Solutions offers competitive compensation packages (incl. bonuses), pension and benefits plans. Work/Life balance is an essential part of our culture, and all our employees are home workers, although you will be expected to come into our or customer’s offices regularly. We operate a comprehensive career development programme that includes mentoring and training plans to ensure that you will continue to grow and develop your career at Hitachi.

Job Description

We are growing our consulting team, and looking for an experienced AI Architect
to lead the design and delivery of secure, scalable and responsible AI solutions across enterprise and public‑sector programmes. This role combines hands‑on technical expertise with strong architectural leadership, shaping end‑to‑end AI solutions from early discovery through to production delivery and scale.

You will act as a trusted advisor to clients and internal teams, defining AI architectures, setting standards and guardrails, and ensuring AI is applied where it delivers real business value.

Key Responsibilities

Design and own end‑to‑end AI client-specific solution architectures, including Generative AI, Agents and traditional ML.
Define and maintain enterprise AI architecture patterns, reference architectures, and reusable building blocks within the Microsoft ecosystem.
Lead AI governance, security and Responsible AI by design, ensuring solutions meet regulatory, ethical and organisational standards.
Provide architectural oversight across delivery teams, ensuring quality and scalability.
Support pre‑sales and discovery, shaping solution approaches and technical estimates and delivery roadmaps.
Advise stakeholders on AI feasibility, trade‑offs, risks and long‑term sustainability.
Build hands-on prototypes, reference implementations and reusable accelerators to remain close enough to the code to set credible technical direction and unblock delivery teams.

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience

Significant overall experience delivering AI and Data solutions in complex enterprise environments, with a minimum of 5 years hands-on AI delivery experience.
Proven experience delivering production-grade AI solutions end‑to‑end, from discovery through to live operations and ongoing model management.
Hands-on expertise across Microsoft cloud and AI ecosystem, including Microsoft Foundry and data platform.
Strong experience with integrating low-code Power Platform solutions into enterprise-scale solutions, including hands-on experience with Copilot Studio.
Solid understanding of Microsoft security, identity and compliance (Entra ID, RBAC, network isolation, data protection).
Strong experience designing LLM‑based solutions, including Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering strategies and agent‑based architectures, leveraging frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, and Microsoft Agent Framework.
Deep practical experience with classical Machine Learning, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model selection, training pipelines, evaluation frameworks and production lifecycle management, equivalent in depth to GenAI expertise.
Proven ability to assess client use cases and make well-reasoned architectural decisions between classical ML and Generative AI approaches; and articulate clearly why.
Strong experience in cloud‑native architecture, including API‑based and event‑driven designs, enterprise integration patterns and architectures focused on scalability, resilience and reliability.
Experience with DevOps, MLOps and LLMOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, environment strategies and operating LLM‑based solutions in production, with a strong focus on model and prompt lifecycle management, observability and evaluation, reliability and cost management.
Strong understanding of Generative AI governance, operational controls and cost evaluation, including monitoring usage, performance and designing solutions that are supportable, auditable and sustainable at scale.
Strong experience embedding Responsible AI and governance into Generative AI solutions, covering safety, risk management, transparency, explainability, human‑in‑the‑loop design and regulatory alignment.
Desirable experience in integrating enterprise data platforms with AI solutions, including familiarity with Lakehouse architectures and data engineering principles.
Proven experience in a consulting role, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes, effectively engaging non‑technical stakeholders and senior leaders.
Good experience of managing and mentoring junior AI engineers or consultants.
Must hold at least two relevant Microsoft certifications (AI-901, AI-103, DP-800 AZ‑305., AI-300),or be actively working towards them.

Candidates must hold, or be eligible for, UK Security Clearance.

Additional Information

In applying for a role with Hitachi Solutions Europe Limited and/or its affiliates (“Hitachi”) you consent to Hitachi collecting and storing your personal information (including your name, job title and email address) in relation to this role and any others that may be suitable in the future. For more information please refer to our Privacy

Policy located at Privacy policy (hitachi-solutions.co.uk)

Beware of scams

Our recruiting team may communicate with candidates via our @hitachisolutions.com domain email address and/or via our SmartRecruiters (Applicant Tracking System) [email protected] domain email address regarding your application and interview requests.

All offers will originate from our @hitachisolutions.com domain email address. If you receive an offer or information from someone purporting to be an employee of Hitachi Solutions from any other domain, it may not be legitimate.

jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Engineer - Open Banking Europe

Overview

Software engineers working on Mastercard’s Open Banking platform play a key role in the development and maintenance of the products that secure high quality connectivity to banks across Europe. Building on the strong foundation of our state-of-the-art bank connectivity APIs, the engineers create turn-key solutions that take the burden of handling account information and payment initiation services from customers that want to spend their efforts building great products that leverage the full potential of the Open Banking standard.

Role

Open Banking engineers work at the bleeding edge of the account information and payment initiation technologies, often solving problems that are yet to be tackled within the industry in areas of API security, data accessibility, processing, and analysis. You will be joining a group of highly skilled individuals working together as a team to push the limits of what is possible to achieve with open banking.

You will have many colleagues around different countries, with your nearest peers being located primarily in Denmark, Ireland and Poland.

About You

We are looking for motivated individuals that are looking to be a part of an established team comprised of both industry veterans as well as newcomers. What they all have in common is the understanding that in order to achieve great things, being able to work together as a team is a must.

You will be spending most of your time in the Microsoft domain, meaning APIs built in C# with .NET (latest version) and ASP.NET deployed to the cloud (Azure, AWS). Deep knowledge of at least some of these areas is a requirement. However, we believe that learning is a part of the job, so if you for example have extensive experience building ASP.NET apps, but not in the cloud, do not hesitate to apply regardless.

Beyond that, it is expected that you have experience building software using modern development standards, meaning it should not come as a surprise that we utilise all the tools at our disposal from standard ticketing systems (Azure DevOps), VCS, test automation, to CI/CD pipelines.

Additionally, if you have experience with provisioning infrastructure as code (Terraform) as well as interest in computer security (Certificates, HTTPS) it would be a great benefit. Prior experience from working in closely regulated industries (financial, medical, etc.) is welcome, but not required.

And above all, we hope that you love solving problems!

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Technology is our how. And people are our why.

At Endava, we harness technology to drive meaningful change. By combining AI-native engineering, deep industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we partner with leading organisations to solve complex business challenges and create digital products and platforms that make a lasting impact.

From strategy and design to engineering and operations, we help our customers accelerate innovation and transform their businesses. Join us and be part of a global team delivering work that matters.

Job Description

As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, you will join an experienced cross-functional engineering team responsible for designing, developing and evolving the Authentication and Authorization capability used across multiple products and engineering teams.

This is not a traditional application development role. Instead, you will help build a reusable identity platform that enables other engineering teams to adopt standardised authentication and authorisation services while improving security, developer experience and operational efficiency.

The capability provides shared identity and access management services that help applications authenticate users securely, authorise access to business resources and integrate with enterprise identity providers.

Built on Auth0, Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) and modern Azure services, it includes reusable SDKs, reverse proxy services and developer tooling that make secure integration simpler across ICT’s technology landscape.

You will work closely with architects, product teams, platform engineers and business stakeholders helping deliver secure, scalable and high-quality technology solutions that create value for WTW and its customers. You will be expected to work with a high degree of autonomy, take ownership of significant work packages and make sound technical decisions within the agreed platform direction.

What Success Looks Like

In this role you will:

Help deliver secure, reusable authentication and authorization services used by multiple product teams.
Build high-quality .NET APIs, Angular administration tools and integration services that are maintainable and easy to operate.
Improve the reliability, scalability and security of shared identity services through well-tested engineering changes.
Support platform adoption by improving SDKs, documentation, developer tooling and integration patterns.
Contribute to automation, CI/CD and cloud platform improvements that make delivery faster and more predictable.
Collaborate with architects, product owners, QA, DevOps and consuming product teams to solve identity and access management challenges.
Actively learn, share knowledge and contribute to a positive engineering culture within the Quartz team.

Key Responsibilities

Identity Platform Development

Design, develop and maintain authentication and authorization services using modern .NET technologies.
Develop reusable platform services supporting secure authentication and authorization across multiple business applications.
Build scalable REST APIs and integration services used throughout the organisation.
Develop and maintain Angular-based administration portals supporting user, group and permission management.
Contribute to the evolution of Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) capabilities and centralized access management services.

Platform Services & Developer Experience

Develop reusable SDKs, libraries and APIs that simplify integration with the enterprise identity platform.
Build developer tooling that improves onboarding and adoption of shared authentication services.
Improve developer experience by simplifying authentication, authorization and platform integration.
Produce and maintain technical documentation supporting engineering teams consuming the platform.
Help minimise breaking changes by designing stable, reusable platform interfaces.
Take ownership of technical designs and implementation approaches for assigned capabilities, identifying dependencies, risks and trade-offs and following work through to a production-ready outcome.
Lead focused technical work packages and provide practical guidance to other engineers contributing to the same capability.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Develop cloud-native services running on Microsoft Azure.
Build and maintain reverse proxy capabilities using Azure API Management.
Support Infrastructure as Code implementation using OpenTofu/Terraform.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation using Azure DevOps.
Support continuous improvements in platform scalability, security and operational resilience.

Engineering Excellence

Write unit, integration and automated tests ensuring platform quality and reliability.
Participate in peer reviews, architecture discussions and technical design sessions.
Promote engineering best practices including Clean Code, automated testing and secure software development.
Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, QA Engineers and Platform Engineers to deliver high-quality platform capabilities.
Support less experienced engineers through constructive reviews, knowledge sharing and technical mentoring.

Operations & Collaboration

Participate in third-line production support and on-call rotation.
Investigate production issues and contribute to platform reliability improvements.
Work closely with multiple product teams integrating with the platform.
Share knowledge and contribute to establishing long-term Endava ownership of the Authentication & Authorization capability.

Qualifications

Software Engineering

6+ years of commercial software development experience using C# and modern .NET.
Strong experience designing and developing REST APIs.
Experience building scalable enterprise applications or shared platform services.
Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming and modern software design principles.

Identity & Security

Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC) and JWT.
Good understanding of modern authentication and authorization concepts.
Experience integrating applications with enterprise identity providers.
Understanding of secure API design and identity-based access control.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Experience developing cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure.
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience using Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or OpenTofu.
Understanding of Azure API Management or similar API Gateway technologies.

Front-End Development

Experience developing Angular applications using TypeScript.
Experience building administrative or developer-facing web applications.

Engineering Practices

Experience writing automated tests (unit, integration and API testing).
Experience working in Agile Scrum teams.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work effectively across multiple product teams.
Ability to influence technical outcomes across team boundaries, communicate delivery risks and contribute to decisions affecting shared platform consumers.

Preferred Skills and Experience

Auth0
Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA)
Google Zanzibar authorization model
Azure API Management (APIM)
SCIM integrations
Identity Federation Datadog
Playwright
Trivy
GitLeaks
Invicti
Experience building reusable developer platforms
Experience working with enterprise shared services

:

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started.

Location:

Remote (Europe)

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Staff Software Engineer
in Revenue Intelligence, you will shape the technical direction of systems that help hospitality businesses understand demand, identify revenue opportunities, and make better pricing and commercial decisions. You will work across customer-facing applications, backend services, data pipelines, analytical stores, recommendation workflows, and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will solve complex engineering problems directly while establishing architecture, improving reliability and security, reducing systemic technical debt, and aligning multiple teams around durable technical decisions. Your impact will extend beyond individual features to the quality, scalability, operability, and long-term evolution of the Revenue Intelligence platform.

Our Revenue Intelligence Team:

The Revenue Intelligence team builds products and platforms that turn hospitality data into practical decisions for hoteliers, including pricing recommendations, demand insights, reporting, automation, and commercial opportunities. Our systems span frontend experiences, APIs, distributed services, data processing, machine-learning workflows, and production infrastructure. We value pragmatic engineering, strong ownership, evidence-based decisions, and technical leaders who raise the effectiveness of the people and systems around them.

What You Bring to the Team:

Set and evolve the technical strategy for Revenue Intelligence, translating product and business goals into coherent architecture and executable engineering plans
Lead the design and delivery of complex capabilities across customer-facing web applications, backend APIs, event-driven services, data pipelines, analytical storage, and recommendation workflows
Identify and resolve systemic risks in scalability, reliability, security, data quality, observability, and operability before they become recurring customer or engineering problems
Drive modernization of legacy systems and infrastructure through incremental, well-reasoned migrations that preserve delivery momentum and production stability
Partner with Product, Data Science, Infrastructure, Security, and engineering leaders to define boundaries, contracts, ownership, and long-term platform direction
Remain hands-on in the codebase through implementation, technical spikes, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and the most consequential or ambiguous engineering work
Raise the technical effectiveness of the wider organization through mentoring, architecture guidance, engineering standards, documentation, and constructive challenge

What Sets You Up for Success:

10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant technical leadership across complex production systems
Deep hands-on expertise in Python, with the ability to work effectively across both ecosystems and guide engineering decisions beyond a single language
Strong architecture and distributed-systems fundamentals, including API design, event-driven workflows, consistency, failure handling, scalability, and service boundaries
Experience with data-intensive systems such as PostgreSQL, Redshift, or similar analytical platforms, batch and streaming pipelines, and large-scale data processing
Experience designing or operating recommendation systems, machine-learning platforms, pricing systems, experimentation workflows, or other decision-support products
Strong cloud and platform engineering experience across AWS, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, CI/CD, observability, and secure production operations
A demonstrated ability to lead through influence, create alignment across teams, communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, and drive decisions from ambiguity to execution
A strong record of improving engineering quality through testing strategy, operational readiness, incident learning, security, documentation, and sustainable technical standards
Product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to connect technical investments to measurable outcomes for hoteliers and the business
Business-level English fluency and experience collaborating effectively in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

Deep hands-on expertise in .NET/C#

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle.

Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.
Learn more online at cloudbeds.com

Company Awards:

Job Description

Ciklum
is looking for a Senior Agentic Engineer
to join our team full-time in Poland.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About The Role

As a Senior Agentic Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

We are seeking a Senior Agentic Engineer (AI & Automation) to lead the design and implementation of scalable, automated, and AI-driven technical solutions across our operational ecosystem. This is a hands-on builder role, designed for an OpsTech professional who thrives on creating efficient, reliable business systems using a combination of low-code platforms, custom development, and advanced AI integration.

The ideal candidate excels at translating high-level business and operational requirements into robust technical solutions, owning delivery from initial design through implementation and iteration. You will manage your work through structured sprint cycles, balancing operational stability with continuous improvement, and proactively identifying opportunities to replace manual processes with intelligent, self-service, and AI-powered workflows.

Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end technical health, stability, and scalability of operational systems and internal tools
Manage and continuously optimize the Zendesk ticketing ecosystem, including workflows, integrations, and automation
Lead the design and development of automated and self-service solutions to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency
Own the resolution of complex technical issues, from investigation through root cause and permanent fix
Plan and execute work within a two-week sprint cycle, balancing operational reliability with continuous improvement and innovation
Design, build, and maintain system integrations and new platform capabilities supporting Operations and CX teams
Leverage AI capabilities (including LLM-based applications and multi-agent systems) to enhance system intelligence and automate decision-making
Identify manual, repetitive processes and transform them into scalable, AI-driven workflows
Partner closely with Operations, Product, and Engineering stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions
Ensure internal tools are reliable, observable, secure, and continuously evolving through proactive improvements and monitoring

Requirements

AI & Prompt Engineering: Experience leveraging cutting-edge AI tools and LLMs to accelerate development, automate complex tasks, and enhance solution quality. Must demonstrate an ability to craft sophisticated prompts and integrate AI outputs into functional workflows. - Must
API Integration: Experience working with REST APIs to connect disparate systems and build cohesive technical ecosystems. - Must
Great Communication skills - Must
Great scripting experience
Azure Platform: Hands-on experience building and managing solutions within the Azure ecosystem, specifically:
Function Apps (Serverless compute)
Automation Accounts (Process automation and configuration)
Logic Apps (Workflow orchestration)
Azure DevOps (Boards, Repos, and Pipelines)
Agile & Operations: Experience working within a formal ticketing system (ZenDesk, SF)
Business Translation: ability to take high-level business requirements and architect the technical "how-to" from scratch
Problem Solving: Excellent analytical skills and troubleshooting complex environment issues independently
Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks
Microsoft Power Platform: Experience with Power Apps or Power Automate.

Desirable

Data & Scripting: Advantage for candidates with strong proficiency in data manipulation and scripting (PowerShell, Bash, or SQL).
Coding: Advantage Experience with Python coding is a significant plus.
Familiarity with additional languages.

What’s in it for you?

Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
Papaya Global is a rapidly growing, award-winning B2B tech unicorn with an ambitious mission to revolutionize the payroll & payments industry. With over $400M raised from multiple tier-one investors, our innovative technology provides a comprehensive solution for managing global workforces, encompassing everything from hiring and onboarding to managing and paying employees in over 160 countries.

About The Role

We're looking for a Software Architect
to join Papaya's central Architects Team
— a small group of senior architects that partners with every R&D department in the company. In this role you won't own a single product silo; instead, you'll move across domains (payments, payroll, workforce management, platform, data, security) to help teams shape sound, scalable, secure systems and to keep Papaya's overall technical direction coherent.

This is a hands-on architecture role at the intersection of engineering, product, security, and DevOps. You'll be expected to dive deep into unfamiliar domains quickly, influence without direct authority, and bring the highest bar of technical thinking — including modern AI-assisted engineering practices — to everything you touch.

If you're energized by hard problems at global scale, by working across many teams rather than one, and by shaping how a modern engineering organization actually builds software in the age of AI, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Lead architectural design across multiple Papaya domains and infrastructure systems, ensuring solutions meet business, scalability, performance, and compliance needs.
Act as a trusted architectural partner to R&D, Product, Security, and DevOps teams — translating business and product requirements into clear technical direction.
Define and maintain high-level architecture across domains, with a focus on seamless integration, maintainability, and long-term evolvability.
Build hands-on Proofs of Concept (POCs) to de-risk architectural decisions, validate new technologies, and demonstrate viable paths forward before broad investment.
Lead technical Due Diligence on third-party vendors, platforms, and integrations — evaluating architecture fit, scalability, security posture, compliance, operational maturity, and long-term cost.
Drive secure-by-design practices, embedding security, privacy, and regulatory considerations into every stage of system design.
Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies, frameworks, and patterns — including AI/LLM-based capabilities — where they create real leverage for the business.
Champion the adoption of AI-powered engineering tools and agentic workflows across R&D, helping teams use them effectively, safely, and consistently.
Define and steward Papaya's architectural guidelines, standards, and best practices, and help ensure they are actually applied in day-to-day delivery.
Provide technical mentorship and architectural guidance to development teams across the company.
Review designs, RFCs, and critical implementations to maintain architectural consistency and system quality across projects.

Requirements:

Experience & Background

8+ years of proven experience as a System / Software Architect designing robust, scalable systems.
12+ years of hands-on software development experience, with strong proficiency in Java (preferred) or an equivalent backend language.
Proven experience building enterprise SaaS platforms, self-service products, and highly scaled production systems.
Experience in financial technology (FinTech) or other regulated industries is a strong advantage.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

Technical depth

Deep expertise in cloud-native architecture; strong advantage for AWS (Lambda, ECS, S3, RDS, IAM, etc.).
Hands-on experience with microservices, event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS), and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
Strong command of software design patterns, SDLC, and system integration strategies.
Expertise in design paradigms such as DDD, TDD, EDD, and principles like SOLID, KISS, DRY, SSOT, and CQS.
Solid grasp of security fundamentals: encryption, authentication, authorization, data privacy, and secure coding practices.
Proficiency with SQL and NoSQL databases, and API design using REST and GraphQL.
Practical experience with Git branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development practices.

AI-powered Engineering (required)

Deep, hands-on experience with at least one agentic AI coding tool such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot (Agent Mode), or Codex CLI — used regularly on real, non-trivial work.
Practical fluency with AI productivity tools across the broader workflow: LLM chat assistants for design and review, AI-assisted code review, documentation generation, and research.
Ability to design effective context for AI agents — writing good prompts, structuring repos and docs (e.g. CLAUDE.md / rules files) so agents perform well, and knowing when to delegate vs. when to drive manually.
Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and the broader pattern of connecting AI agents to internal tools, data sources, and services.
Awareness of the security, privacy, IP, and quality risks of AI-assisted development, and opinions on how to mitigate them at an organizational level.
Experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities and agent-based components into backend products and workflows is a strong plus.

Ways of working

Demonstrated ability to drive end-to-end delivery of complex features — from architecture through production.
Excellent analytical skills and a strong self-learning instinct; comfortable ramping up quickly on unfamiliar domains.
Strong communication and influencing skills — able to align engineers, product managers, and senior stakeholders around a technical direction.
Excellent written and verbal English.

jobs.description:
Att jobba som .NET-utvecklare

Vill du använda din erfarenhet inom .NET för att utveckla lösningar som spelar en viktig roll i arbetet mot penningtvätt?

Hos oss blir du en del av Team Norrsken i Piteå, ett erfaret och välfungerande team med stort ansvar för verksamhetskritiska lösningar. Här får du möjlighet att påverka tekniska vägval, utvecklas tillsammans med kunniga kollegor och arbeta inom ett område som får allt större betydelse.

Några Anledningar Till Att Välja Rollen

Ett uppdrag med tydligt syfte – du arbetar med lösningar inom bland annat antipenningtvätt och bidrar till utvecklingen av system som möter regulatoriska krav.
Erfarna kollegor nära dig – du blir en del av ett kompetent team med seniora systemutvecklare, teamcoach, systemansvarig, mjukvaruarkitekt och produktägare.
Påverka både lösning och arbetssätt – du får vara delaktig från krav och design till utveckling, test och förvaltning.
Möjlighet att fortsätta utvecklas – på sikt finns möjligheter att bredda dig mot exempelvis arkitektur, Teamcoach, systemansvar eller systemspecialist.
Gemenskap på kontoret i Piteå – teamet värdesätter samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och gemensamt ansvar, samtidigt som det finns möjlighet till ett flexibelt hybridarbete.

Vi är 9 personer i teamet som består av systemutvecklare, Scrum Master/Teamcoach, systemansvarig, mjukvaruarkitekt samt systemspecialist. I teamet verkar även från verksamheten en produktägare (PO).

Vi arbetar agilt med dagliga avstämning. Uppgifter och prioriteringar hanteras i Azure DevOps. Din huvudsakliga arbetsplats är vårt kontor centralt i Piteå. Vi ser ett värde i att arbeta tillsammans på plats, samtidigt som rollen erbjuder möjlighet till hybridarbete.

Tillsammans förvaltar och vidareutvecklar vi system inom bland annat antipenningtvätt, där produkten Actimize är en viktig del. I takt med utökade regulatoriska krav väntar fortsatt design och utveckling av tjänster inom området.

Dina Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter Är Att

utveckla och förvalta IT-lösningar i C#, .NET och .NET Framework
delta i kravarbete och omsätta verksamhetens behov till tekniska lösningar
bidra i designarbete med hänsyn till arkitektur, livscykel och roadmap
arbeta med SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git och enhetstester
genomföra testaktiviteter och bidra till ökad testautomation
felsöka och lösa incidenter och problem samt analysera bakomliggande orsaker
dokumentera lösningar och bidra till förbättringar av teknik, processer och teamets arbetssätt.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet från en liknande roll och gedigen erfarenhet av backendutveckling i C#och .NET. Du har även erfarenhet av MS SQL, SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git, enhetstester och agila arbetssätt. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift.

Som person är du självgående, analytisk och lösningsorienterad med förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i teknik och verksamhet, förstå krav och omsätta dem till väl genomtänkta lösningar. Eftersom vi arbetar nära varandra behöver du också vara kommunikativ, dela med dig av kunskap och våga be om hjälp. Du bidrar med ett prestigelöst och positivt förhållningssätt där teamets gemensamma resultat står i fokus.

Det är meriterande med eftergymnasial utbildning inom relevant område samt erfarenhet av testautomation, händelsedrivna system, REST/SOAP, CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy och felsökning i Splunk eller AppDynamics. Även kunskaper inom TypeScript/JavaScript, React.js och AI-utveckling är meriterande.

Vad händer nu?

Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet. För att göra rekryteringsprocessen så rättvis och objektiv som möjligt kommer det att ingå intervjuer, tester, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning.

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen ta kontakt med madelene.skogh@skandia.se eller rekryterande chef på margit.ronn@skandia.se.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Mer om Banken

Vi har varit pionjärer inom digital bankverksamhet sedan starten 1994, som Sveriges första helt digitala bank. Med en passion för innovation och kundfokus har vi vuxit till att erbjuda ett brett utbud av produkter och tjänster inom områdena Låna, Spara och Betala – med särskilt fokus på bolån.

Vår verksamhet är fördelad mellan Stockholm och Linköping. I Stockholm finns majoriteten av vår verksamhet, medan vår kundservice har sitt hjärta i Linköping. Tillsammans är vi cirka 270 medarbetare anställda på banken som varje dag skapar smarta lösningar för våra kunder.

Spara: Sparande i fonder och aktier samt på sparkonto
Betala: Lönekonto samt smidiga kort- och betalningstjänster.

The Fintech Value Stream strives to improve and automate key financial processes to deliver a best-in-class experience for a broad range of business domains. We’re a cross-functional team collaborating closely with stakeholders across EQT to ensure data and technology strategically support business outcomes. Our team includes tech leads, data professionals, product managers and architects who together shape the future of finance operations through scalable, data-driven solutions.

What You’ll Do

As a Software and Solution Architect, you will play a key role in shaping EQT’s technical landscape within the Fintech Value Stream. Utveckling av automation och scripting för installation, konfiguration och uppgradering av våra system.
Design av standardiserade, återanvändbara lösningar som gör leveransen likadan oavsett kund och geografi.
Förbättring av arbetsflöden i drift genom verktyg, pipelines och infrastructure as code.
Felsökning och grundorsaksanalys – och att bygga bort problemet så att det inte återkommer.

,

Intresse eller engagemang utanför arbetet, exempelvis idrott, musik eller ideellt arbete.

jobs.title: Cloud Network Architect till VING
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och forma framtidens nätverksarkitektur i ett av Nordens mest välkända reseföretag? Trivs du i en roll där du får kombinera strategiskt inflytande med tekniskt hands-on arbete och samtidigt driva utvecklingen av moderna cloudlösningar? Då kan det här vara möjligheten du har väntat på.

OM ROLLEN

Som Cloud Network Architect hos Ving får du en central roll i företagets fortsatta transformation mot en molnbaserad och framtidssäkrad infrastruktur. Du ansvarar för att utveckla och forma nätverksarkitekturen med fokus på Azure, Cloud Networking och säker, skalbar kommunikation mellan verksamhetens plattformar och tjänster.

Rollen kombinerar arkitekturansvar med operativt arbete. Du driver tekniska initiativ, tar fram målarkitekturer och roadmaps samt omsätter idéer till lösningar i produktion. Samtidigt fungerar du som teknisk rådgivare och samarbetar nära utvecklingsteam, cloudspecialister, arkitekter och externa partners för att säkerställa att vår nätverksmiljö utvecklas i linje med bolagets cloudstrategi.

Här erbjuds du stort mandat, hög teknisk mognad och möjligheten att påverka framtida teknikval i en internationell verksamhet där innovation och utveckling står högt på agendan.

DIN PROFIL

Vi Tror Att Du Har

Djup kompetens inom Microsoft Azure och Azure Networking (VNET, Hub & Spoke-arkitektur, VWAN, NSG, Private Link & Private Endpoints, Azure Firewall)
Djup kompetens inom WAN och Hybrid Connectivity (WAN-design, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, BGP, Private Link, Private Endpoint)
Erfarenhet av Cloud Architecture & Governance
Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Bicep eller Terraform
Erfarenhet av Cloud Security och moderna säkerhetsprinciper (Zero Trust)
Vana av att samarbeta med utvecklingsteam och DevOps-miljöer
Har erfarenhet av att arbeta agilt
Relevant högskoleutbildning inom IT eller motsvarande kompetens

Meriterande Om Du Även Har

Erfarenhet av Datacenter & Enterprise Networking
Är certifierad inom IT arkitektur (ex. TOGAF, COBIT)
Azure-certifieringar (t.ex. AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-700)

Som person är du engagerad, nyfiken och ansvarstagande. Du motiveras av att driva teknisk utveckling framåt och tycker om att omsätta strategier till konkreta resultat. Du är kommunikativ och har lätt för att skapa förtroende hos både tekniska och affärsnära intressenter. Dessutom är du prestigelös i ditt samarbete och trivs i en kultur där kunskapsdelning, initiativförmåga och laganda värdesätts högt.

OM ORGANISATIONEN

Ving är en del av Nordic Leisure Travel Group (NLTG) som säljer resor från Sverige, Danmark, Norge och Finland. I gruppen ingår researrangörerna Ving Sverige, Ving Norge, Globetrotter, Spies i Danmark, Tjäreborg i Finland, flygbolaget Sunclass Airlines samt våra egna hotellkoncept Sunwing Family Resorts, Ocean Beach Club och Sunprime Hotels. Gruppen säljer ett normalt år runt 1 250 000 resor i de nordiska länderna.

Vi erbjuder en spännande och utvecklande miljö där du får möjlighet till en intern karriär. Du får en omväxlande vardag tillsammans med härliga kollegor - vi arbetar i nära samarbete mellan de nordiska länderna för att ge våra gäster de bästa veckorna på året. Vi har dessutom ett högt medarbetarengagemang som år efter år visar sig i vår interna medarbetarundersökning. Vi älskar vårt jobb och välkomnar dig ombord på vår resa i Nordic Leisure Travel Group!

About the company
A specialist in identity, secure transactions, and digital services, IN Groupe is the global leader in secure identity and trust services. Every day, our 4,000 employees across 40 countries work to ensure that everyone has access to a reliable and secure identity, both in the physical and digital worlds. With our solutions and our international network of 10 R&D centers, we support governments and businesses in more than 130 countries.
Joining IN Groupe means helping to shape the future of the identity and secure transaction market. Become part of our international teams — driven by innovation and proud to design solutions that make life easier and protect personal data for millions of people around the world.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior backend engineer
to join our Stockholm office with strong, hands‑on expertise in modern Java, experienced in building and maintaining distributed systems and microservices. Brings solid proficiency in CI/CD and Azure DevOps (or comparable platforms), along with practical knowledge of cloud environments, containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, automated testing practices, and operating services reliably in production.

Main responsibilities

•Focus on backend development
, with responsibility for services, databases, and system integrations.
• Develop, improve, and maintain services with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
• Select and use technologies based on problem-solving value, not trendiness.
• Ensure that deliveries are on time and secure, always balancing speed with quality.
• Collaborate closely with teammates and stakeholders, enabling fast and sustainable delivery.
• Over time, take a leading role in driving improvements in both technology and ways of working.
Our Tech Stack (key areas for this role)
• Java (primary language: deep expertise required)

• Spring Boot

• REST, Microservices, Databases

• Azure (cloud environment), Docker, Kubernetes

About you

• Highly experienced in backend Java development and proficient with Azure.
• Results-oriented: you deliver what is needed, when it is needed.
• Pragmatic: you enjoy new technology but choose what best solves the current problem while limiting technical debt.
• Humble and grounded: you listen, collaborate, and keep the team's health in mind.
• Independent yet collaborative: you take initiative but thrive in teamwork.
• User-focused: the end user's experience is always your guiding star.
Qualifications
• Extensive experience in Java backend development (main requirement).
• Experience with Spring Boot and modern development practices.
• Solid understanding of Microservices and integrations.
• Professional proficiency in English.

What we offer

• Impactful work: Your code directly powers secure identity services used by real customers worldwide.
• A pragmatic environment: We value smart choices over shiny tools. You'll use the most adapted technologies to solve problems, reduce complexity, and limit future technical debt.
• A healthy team culture: We believe in humility, collaboration, and keeping team well-being in balance with delivery goals.
• End-to-end responsibility: You'll see the whole lifecycle, from development through deployment to customer use.
• Growth into leadership: Over time, you'll have the opportunity to take on a bigger role in driving initiatives and supporting others in the team.

jobs.title: Full Stack .NET Developer
jobs.description:
SMBC Group is a top-tier global financial group. Headquartered in Tokyo and with a 400-year history, SMBC Group offers a diverse range of financial services, including banking, leasing, securities, credit cards, and consumer finance. The Group has more than 130 offices and 80,000 employees worldwide in nearly 40 countries. Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group, Inc. (SMFG) is the holding company of SMBC Group, which is one of the three largest banking groups in Japan. SMFG’s shares trade on the Tokyo, Nagoya, and New York (NYSE: SMFG) stock exchanges.

In the Americas, SMBC Group has a presence in the US, Canada, Ireland, Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, and Peru. Backed by the capital strength of SMBC Group and the value of its relationships in Asia, the Group offers a range of commercial and investment banking services to its corporate, institutional, and municipal clients. It connects a diverse client base to local markets and the organization’s extensive global network. The Group’s operating companies in the Americas include Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corp. (SMBC), SMBC Nikko Securities America, Inc., SMBC Capital Markets, Inc., SMBC MANUBANK, JRI America, Inc., SMBC Leasing and Finance, Inc., Banco Sumitomo Mitsui Brasileiro S.A., and Sumitomo Mitsui Finance and Leasing Co., Ltd.

This is a hybrid role, requiring the successful candidate to attend our Tralee office.

Role Description

SMBC is seeking a Full Stack .NET Developer to join its Development team in Tralee. The team develops and supports strategic and tactical applications that enable critical business processes across the organisation.

The successful candidate will have hands-on experience across the full technology stack, including web applications, user interfaces, backend services, REST APIs, databases and enterprise application support. Strong experience with C#/.NET, object-oriented programming, Oracle and/or SQL Server databases and complex SQL development is required.

The role will design, develop, enhance and support business applications, workflow solutions and system integrations. Working closely with business users, analysts, architects and development teams, the successful candidate will deliver scalable and reliable solutions within a global financial services environment.

This role will report to the Senior Applications Developer - Business Process Management.

Role Objectives: Delivery

Design, develop, test and support full stack applications using C#/.NET technologies.
Develop web applications, user interfaces, RESTful APIs, backend services and workflow solutions.
Design and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views and database objects.
Gather and analyse business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Troubleshoot application, integration and database issues.
Provide production support, root cause analysis, system maintenance and performance tuning.
Collaborate with business users, analysts, architects and development teams to deliver scalable and reliable solutions.
Participate in application design, code reviews, testing, deployment and continuous improvement.
Produce and maintain technical documentation.

Qualifications And Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline.
5+ years of full stack software development experience.
Strong C#/.NET development and object-oriented programming experience.
Experience developing web applications, user interfaces, RESTful APIs and backend services.
Strong Oracle and/or Microsoft SQL Server database experience.
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, stored procedures, query optimisation and performance tuning.
Strong knowledge of relational database concepts, data modelling and database design.
Experience with application integrations, enterprise systems and application architecture.
Experience supporting, debugging and troubleshooting production applications.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and root cause analysis skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent verbal and written communication and collaboration skills.
Self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership, accountability and teamwork.
Commitment to continuous learning and professional growth.
Experience within financial services or banking is preferred.

Additional Requirements

SMBC’s employees participate in a hybrid workforce model that provides employees with an opportunity to work from home, as well as, from an SMBC office. SMBC requires that employees live within a reasonable commuting distance of their office location. Prospective candidates will learn more about their specific hybrid work schedule during their interview process.

SMBC provides reasonable accommodations during candidacy for applicants with disabilities consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please let us know at accommodations@smbcgroup.com.

From secure device connectivity and real-time data platforms to intelligent clinical tools and patient-facing experiences, PCS transforms complex cardiac data into clarity — helping physicians make faster decisions, improving outcomes, and giving patients greater confidence in their care.
