jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
KIPCO Grubu'nun (Kuwait Projects Company) bir iştiraki olarak 1977 yılında kurulan Burgan Bank Grubu, MENAT (Orta Doğu&Kuzey Afrika, Türkiye) bölgesinin en büyük şube ağına sahip bankalarından biridir. Özellikle kurumsal müşterilere, finansal kurumlara ve özel bankacılığa odaklanmış olup bireysel ve özel bankacılık alanlarında büyüyen bir markadır.

2013 yılından bu yana Burgan Bank Türkiye olarak sürekli değişen ve gelişen dünyanın dinamik yapısına hızla ayak uyduruyor, yenilikleri fırsata dönüştürüyoruz. Her zaman güvene dayalı, samimi ve sürdürülebilir ilişkiler kurarak tecrübeleri ve uzmanlıklarıyla birbirini besleyen ‘biz olmak, dinamizm ve kazanmak’ değerleri doğrultusunda uyum içinde çalışan bir kurumuz.

Hedefe ulaşırken tüm ekip arkadaşlarımızın çabasını ve performansını güçlendirmek için çalışan mutluluğunu benimsiyoruz. Ailemizin her üyesine daha ilk günden itibaren “Burgan seninle” mesajını veriyor; kariyer, gelişim, gelecek ve yaşam yolculuğunda her türlü eğitim, seminer ve uygulamalarla Burganlılara destek oluyoruz.

Bilgi Teknolojileri Grubu, Ödeme Sistemleri Geliştirme Bölümü, Kart ,Kampanya ve Ödemeler ekiplerimizde bankacılıkta fark yaratarak, müşterilerimize en iyi bankacılık deneyimini sunmak için çalışıyoruz.

Agile ve çevik yaklaşımlarla, sadece kod yazmıyor, aynı zamanda geleceği şekillendiriyoruz.
Eğer sen de bu heyecan verici yolculuğa katılmak istiyorsan başvurularınızı bekliyoruz !

Nasıl Yapıyoruz?

SOLID Prensipleri:
Temiz kod ve sürdürülebilir projeler için SOLID prensiplerini benimsiyoruz.
.Net Core:
Backend geliştirmelerimizde en güncel .Net Core versiyonlarını dapr destekli kullanıyoruz, N8N & Zeebe gibi araçlarla entegrasyon sağlıyoruz
Veritabanı Teknolojileri:
MSSQL, Qlik, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL kullanıyor ve Entity Framework ile ORM geliştirmeleri yapıyoruz.Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ: Veri erişimi için Redis, event streaming için Kafka ve RabbitMQ kullanıyoruz.
Openshift:
Üretim ortamında container teknolojisi ile Openshift altyapısını kullanıyoruz.
Azure DevOps:
CI/CD süreçlerimizi Azure DevOps ile yönetiyor, zero downtime deployment ile süreçleri hızlandırıyoruz.
Elastic Stack: Loglama ve performans yönetiminde Elastic Stack ile hayatımızı kolaylaştırıyoruz.

Kimi Arıyoruz?

5 yıl veya üzeri yazılım geliştirme deneyimi
Tercihen Kredi Kartı, Ödeme Sistemleri (Para Transferleri), Kampanya Yönetimi vb. alanların bir veya bir kaçında.Net Core ve Micro Service konularında yetkin
DDD, Clean Architecture ve Yazılım Mimarileri konusunda karar alabilecek
Agile ve Scrum metodolojilerine aşina
Takım çalışmasına yatkın ve iletişim becerileri kuvvetli

Ne Sunuyoruz?

As a BHS Software Engineer, you take ownership of baggage handling applications, production support, system integration and configuration for international airport installations. You work on mission-critical airport systems, solve complex operational issues and contribute to the reliability of baggage handling operations while collaborating with airport stakeholders, equipment vendors and international project teams.

At Equans, we believe that diverse talents strengthen our teams. We actively build an inclusive work environment where everyone feels welcome, can be themselves, and we encourage everyone to apply.

Your work location:
Machelen.

Zoom on the job:

act as the primary maintenance engineer for baggage handling applications across international airport sites
diagnose and resolve production incidents including display issues, sorting problems, flight data discrepancies and system performance issues
perform root cause analysis on complex software issues related to baggage messaging, sortation control and workflow processing
prepare and present maintenance reports to airport stakeholders
collaborate with on-site technicians, airport IT teams and third-party equipment suppliers to resolve cross-system issues
lead the technical integration between EDAS software and third-party baggage handling systems
develop and maintain connectors between BHS applications and industrial equipment such as sorters, conveyors and scanners
configure security settings, resolve communication protocol issues and ensure reliable production data flows
configure and maintain baggage tracking, sortation and reconciliation systems
design and test high-availability and redundancy configurations
provide 2nd and 3rd line support across the EDAS BHS application suite
work with message brokers, IATA messaging standards and real-time data processing pipelines
work with industrial communication protocols including OPC UA and IATA 1745 BSM messaging
maintain sortation allocation interfaces for real-time baggage routing
troubleshoot workflow engines, message broker integrations and sortation logic
integrate systems with airline departure control systems and baggage reconciliation platforms
maintain technical documentation including configuration documents, integration specifications, troubleshooting guides and operational runbooks
document connector behaviour, deployment procedures and redundancy configurations
contribute to knowledge sharing and the internal knowledge base
identify recurring issues and implement permanent improvements
contribute to software stabilisation initiatives across the application portfolio
participate in test environment development and virtual airport test platforms
contribute to software refactoring activities to improve maintainability and code quality

Come as you are, ideally with:

bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, industrial automation or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience
minimum 3 years of experience in software engineering, systems integration or technical support within an industrial, logistics, transport or 24/7 production environment
experience with baggage handling applications, baggage tracking, sortation and reconciliation systems
solid knowledge of OPC UA, IATA 1745 BSM, SITA messaging, MQTT, AMQP and system integration concepts
strong debugging and root cause analysis skills across application, database, network and protocol layers
experience with C# (.NET Framework/.NET Core), Python, PowerShell or Bash
knowledge of SQL Server, PostgreSQL, stored procedures, database performance tuning and data migration processes
experience with Windows Server and Linux (Red Hat Enterprise Linux/CentOS) administration
familiarity with VMware, Hyper‑V, VPN, RDP, SSH and secure remote connectivity
experience with Git, GitLab, GitHub, CI/CD concepts, Docker, Jira and Confluence
understanding of network troubleshooting, firewalls, TLS/SSL and industrial network segmentation
knowledge of baggage handling architecture, SAC systems, BMR, airline DCS integration and IATA airport operations standards
able to produce clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with customers, partners and colleagues
organised and comfortable managing activities across multiple sites and projects
collaborative approach with the ability to work independently when required
knowledge of French (both written and spoken — valuable for communication with many airport stakeholders)

What if you became BHS Software Engineer at Equans?

For you this means:

a market rate salary in line with your education and experience
interesting training and career opportunities
group insurance, hospitalization insurance
eco vouchers, meal vouchers, representation allowance, 13th month, holiday pay
electrical lease car, bicycle lease plan
smartphone with subscription, internet fee
additional paid leave, seniority leave, homeworking
discounts through Benefits@Work (culture, sports, travel, and more)

About Equans Digital Airport Systems (EDAS)

Equans Digital Airport Systems (EDAS) is the BHS (Baggage Handling System) software unit within Equans Belux. We design, develop, deploy, and maintain mission-critical software solutions for airport baggage handling systems worldwide — serving airports across Europe, North America, Africa, and the Middle East.

As part of Equans ICT, we combine deep domain expertise in airport logistics with modern software engineering practices. Our team of 9 developers works closely with project managers, support engineers, and on-site technicians to deliver reliable, high-availability systems that keep baggage flowing 24/7.

We are currently undertaking a significant transformation program focused on software stabilization, CI/CD automation, remote access platform development, and test environment modernization — you will be joining at an exciting time of technical renewal.

As a Cloud-Native Software / Solutions Architect at Devoteam Creative Tech, you will take a leading role in designing, building, and evolving cloud-native application architectures for our clients. Design and lead the architectural strategy for cloud-native applications, ensuring high availability, scalability, and resilience in hybrid or multi-cloud environments.

Communicate effectively with clients and stakeholders, clearly explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a strategic mindset.
Deep understanding of software design patterns, principles, and architectural styles (microservices, event-driven, SOA, clean architecture).
Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, including Agile methodologies.
Solid grasp of security concepts, compliance standards, and DevSecOps best practices.
Excellent communication and leadership skills — ability to lead technical workshops, present to C-level stakeholders, and mentor teams.
Genuine curiosity and enthusiasm for AI — you actively experiment with AI tools and stay on top of the latest developments in generative AI, LLMs, and AI-assisted engineering.
Willingness to continuously learn and obtain certifications in cloud technologies and AI.
Fluency in Dutch or French, and English.

Technical Requirements

Languages & Cloud Platforms

Programming Languages — Java, Python, C#/.NET, TypeScript, or similar.
Cloud Platform Expertise — Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud with hands-on experience in cloud-native services.

Infrastructure & DevOps

Containerization & Orchestration — Docker, Kubernetes, AKS/EKS/GKE.
Infrastructure-as-Code — Terraform, Bicep, Pulumi, or CloudFormation.
CI/CD Pipeline Design — GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, Jenkins.

APIs & Integration

API Design & Management — REST, gRPC, GraphQL, API gateways.
Message-Driven Architectures — Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, Pub/Sub.

AI Skills

This is an AI Augmented role.
The following AI competencies are mandatory:

Hands-on experience with AI-assisted coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity, Google Gemini, Claude, or similar).
Practical understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and how to integrate LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure OpenAI) into applications.
Experience with or strong understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, pgvector), and embedding models.
Ability to design and architect AI-powered features and agents within cloud-native applications.
Familiarity with AI/ML platforms and services (Azure AI, Google Vertex AI, AWS SageMaker, or Hugging Face).
Understanding of responsible AI principles: bias mitigation, explainability, data privacy, and ethical AI use.

Assets (Nice to Have)

Relevant cloud certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Architect).
AI/ML certifications (e.g., Claude Architect, Google Cloud ML Engineer, AWS ML, Azure Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect).
Experience building AI agents or multi-agent systems (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen).
Experience with MLOps practices and model deployment pipelines.
Experience with serverless architectures (Azure Functions, AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions).

Additional Information

Work on cutting-edge projects combining modern software development with AI innovation.
A competitive salary package including company car, net allowances, meal vouchers, and group insurance.

comparis.ch is Switzerland's leading comparison platform, helping users make informed decisions through transparent comparisons across health insurance, insurance, telecommunications, banking, cars, and real estate. As a Backend Engineer in the Marketplace team, you will help develop one of Switzerland's largest real estate platforms, used by thousands of people every day. You will build scalable backend services and APIs while contributing to the evolution toward a modern cloud-native platform based on Azure and Kubernetes. You will also play an important role in migrating existing applications from the legacy .NET Framework stack to a modern, container-based environment.

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using .NET Core and ASP.NET.
- Develop and operate REST APIs and microservices.
- Work with SQL Server and Azure Cosmos DB to manage application data.
- Improve search functionality using Elasticsearch.
- Deploy and operate applications with Docker and Kubernetes.

Du konzipierst und bewertest skalierbare Architekturen für E-Commerce-, PIM- und CMS-Projekte, häufig bereits in der Konzept- und Pitchphase. Dazu gehören die Modellierung von Domänen und Datenstrukturen sowie der Entwurf von Schnittstellen zwischen Frontend, Backend und Systemen wie Shops oder ERPs.
Du arbeitest hands-on: von Prototypen über Architektur-Reviews in Pull Requests bis zum Pair Programming. Ebenso entwickelst du gewachsene Systeme weiter – durch Migrationen, Refactorings und Performance-Optimierungen – und achtest dabei auf Testbarkeit und Wartbarkeit über mehrjährige Produktlebenszyklen.
Zentrale Anwendungsbausteine, wiederverwendbare Komponenten und Schnittstellen, die wir projektübergreifend einsetzen, entstehen unter deiner Verantwortung
Du gestaltest Build-, Deployment- und Infrastrukturprozesse mit – von Containern über CI/CD bis zum Cloud-Hosting – und bringst AI-gestützte Entwicklung in enger Abstimmung mit unseren Expert:innen voran
Gemeinsam mit dem Chapter Lead und den anderen Staff Engineers definierst du das technische Zielbild des Chapters, legst Standards fest und setzt Technologie-Prioritäten. Bei kritischen Projekten bist du zudem fachliche Eskalationsinstanz für Team Leads und Entwickler:innen
Du gibst dein Wissen weiter – durch Schulungen, Reviews und technische Austauschformate für die Teams

Dein Profil

Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung als Senior oder Lead Engineer in der Entwicklung komplexer Webanwendungen mit
Fundierte Kenntnisse in PHP und Symfony gehören ebenso zu deinem Profil wie die Erfahrung, Anwendungen über mehrere Jahre hinweg weiterzuentwickeln und zu verantworten. Dabei denkst du full-stack, vom Datenmodell über die Schnittstelle bis ins Frontend (z. B. Node.js, TypeScript, React)
Du hast bereits projektübergreifend wiederverwendbare Bausteine entwickelt – Basis-Setups, Bundles, geteilte Bibliotheken und wiederkehrende Module
Mit CI/CD, Container-Umgebungen und dem Betrieb in der Cloud (z. B. AWS, GCP oder Azure) kennst du dich aus und triffst hier Architekturentscheidungen mit, ohne den operativen Betrieb zu übernehmen
AI-gestützte Entwicklung und agentische Workflows sind fester Bestandteil deines Arbeitsalltags
Du überzeugst durch Argumente statt durch Hierarchie: Du bindest Team Leads und Entwickler:innen frühzeitig ein, begründest deine Vorschläge nachvollziehbar und passt sie an, wenn gute Gegenargumente vorliegen. Technische Zusammenhänge erklärst du sowohl Kund:innen als auch der Geschäftsführung verständlich, und es liegt dir daran, andere fachlich weiterzubringen
Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und gute Deutschkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab und ermöglichen dir die sichere Kommunikation mit deutschsprachigen Kund:innen
Idealerweise bringst du außerdem Erfahrung mit Pimcore oder in einer Digitalagentur mit

Mitarbeit in einem agilen und fokussierten Team

Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit der Wahl zwischen hybrid oder full remote innerhalb Deutschlands, Spaniens oder Österreichs

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world's largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organisation at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society.

To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jLJ7ZO3wOW4

About the Role
:

We are looking for an enthusiastic Full Stack .NET Engineer to join our team. You will work in the Researcher Profiles Service
team, where we build and manage a global-scale academic data platform.
Through powerful APIs and intuitive UIs, we make critical research information accessible to the rest of the company and to end-users worldwide.

We have fully embraced AI-based spec-driven design
, integrating AI throughout the entire software development lifecycle. From specification to implementation, AI tooling shapes how we architect, build, and iterate — making us faster, more deliberate, and focused on what matters most. This isn't an experiment. It's how we work.

You will take ownership of high-impact projects and drive them to success in a team that's redefining how modern software is built.

Key Responsibilities
:

Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance web applications using .NET and Vue.js
Enhance and support existing solutions built with older versions of .NET and Vue.js
Collaborate with product managers, architects, and other cross-functional teams to gather requirements, assess technical feasibility, and determine optimal implementation strategies
Collaborate within a multinational, cross-functional team to deliver software solutions aligned with business needs
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while adhering to best practices
Ensure the quality of the delivered solutions
Optimise applications for performance, scalability, and responsiveness
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical challenges
Conduct code reviews and mentor junior engineers
Willingness to learn, flexible approach, and staying current with emerging trends in IT to maintain an up-to-date technology stack
Business-oriented attitude with a focus on delivering measurable outcomes for end-users. Demonstrable experience in owning and driving full-stack projects end-to-end, from the specification refinement phase to the production monitoring

Requirements

5+ years of experience in software engineering, specializing in .NET Core/Framework
3+ years of hands-on experience with modern frontend frameworks (Vue 3 is a plus)
Familiar with Agile/Scrum methodologies
Deep expertise in Vue.js, including Vue 2 and Vue 3, with a strong understanding of state management, component-based architecture, and best practices for building scalable front-end applications
Strong expertise in SQL Server, including performance tuning, indexing strategies, query optimization, and troubleshooting production issues.
Heavy experience in implementing APIs with REST and GraphQL
Experience integrating AI solutions into customer-facing applications
Proficient in leveraging AI to enhance daily engineering work
Expexienced in owning complex, distributed system architectures
Solid understanding of microservices and micro-frontend concepts
Collaborative and thriving in a hybrid environment

Nice-to-Have Skills
:

Experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB)
Experience with containerization platforms (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)

Benefits

We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub
Competitive local benefits country dependent (e.g. healthcare and pension/retirement provision)

Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination - including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.

Our Development team in Malaga is growing and we are now looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer to join! Our Campaigns & Rewards unit at Betsson Group ensures our customers come back for more. It’s all about loyalty. We provide a world class customer experience beyond the game play featuring Tournaments, Dynamic personalized campaigns and much more!

You will be part of preparing our journey to containerization, increasing the scalability of our systems while also maintaining their high quality. To accommodate new requirements, we are constantly re-evaluating our systems design and working on exciting new features.

What you'll do

Design and develop distributed backend services using .NET and event-driven architecture.
Collaborate with product and commercial teams to turn engagement ideas into scalable, maintainable, and user-friendly solutions.
Optimize our microservice ecosystem for performance, reliability, and observability.
Drive our containerization and cloud migration strategy forward.
Participate in architecture discussions and help shape technical decisions.
For senior engineers Lead architectural decisions and proactively identify areas for improvement.

Write maintainable, well-tested code and conduct code reviews.
Participate in incident resolution and the team’s on-call rotation.
Maintain clear technical documentation such as ADRs, runbooks, and guidelines.
Build and share your domain expertise within the team.

What Tech Stack you'll be working with

We don’t expect you to know everything listed below – but the more you’re familiar with, the better. What matters most is your ability to learn, collaborate, and write high-quality, maintainable code.

Core Technologies

These are essential to the role, and we’re looking for solid experience here – especially for senior candidates.

Languages & Frameworks

jobs.title: Medior full stack engineer
jobs.description:
As a Medior Full Stack Engineer (.NET/Modern Frontend), you will join a friendly, agile, and fully remote DevOps team. We have a clear mission: We want to focus our efforts on evolving and enhancing our core Digital Signing application. To achieve this, your role will be a balance between building these new capabilities and helping us maintain and stabilize our existing ecosystem (Digital Signing, Document Creation, and File Transfer).

Your duties will revolve around designing and delivering resilient software solutions, ensuring high code quality through strong review practices and automated testing (we own our code from design to deployment!). We embrace modern tooling, so you will leverage AI-assisted tools to drive productivity and optimize our processes. As part of the team, you will participate in all agile ceremonies and actively contribute with your ideas and expertise. 

Skill set

Team spirit.
Autonomous and self-organized.
Be a persistent, creative problem-solver.
Flexible and willing to accept a change in priorities as necessary.
Strong attention to detail.
Outstanding collaboration.
Fluent English: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. English is our daily working language (meetings, documentation, and code). Our team is distributed in the Netherlands and in Spain. 
A positive, resilient attitude. We are looking for someone who brings good energy to the team, enjoys helping others, and navigates maintenance or legacy challenges with a constructive mindset.

Technical skill set

At least 5+ years' experience in web and software development (Medior level).
Strong backend experience: Solid knowledge of .NET / .NET Core architecture and API programming experience (REST).
Modern frontend knowledge: Experience with a modern frontend framework like React, Vue, or Angular using TypeScript. (Note: Our stack is Angular, but if you come from React/Vue and are willing to learn, we want you!)
Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude) to accelerate workflows while ensuring code quality.
Hands-on experience or strong interest in integrating LLMs and generative-AI services into applications (e.g., Azure OpenAI Service).
Familiarity with concepts like prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or vector search.
Microsoft Azure experience.
Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions experience (CI/CD pipelines).
SQL experience.
Experience handling integration challenges (authentication, rate limiting, error handling, resiliency, and messaging like Service Bus/Event Grid).
Awareness of data-privacy principles (GDPR/AVG), including the safe handling of personal and payroll data (encryption in transit and at rest).
Strong code review practices and critical thinking to evaluate technical trade-offs.
Experience working in an agile environment.
Experience with professional software engineering best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, source control management, build processes, automated testing, and operations.

Nice to have:

Direct hands-on experience specifically with Angular (TypeScript).
Experience with Document Generation libraries (e.g., TextControl).
Specific domain knowledge in Digital Signing or File Transfer applications.

Responsibilities

Drive our core product: Design, build, and maintain full-stack features fully hosted in Microsoft Azure, focusing on the evolution and enhancement of our core Digital Signing application for Youforce.
Support the ecosystem: Maintain, stabilize, and troubleshoot our existing ecosystem (Digital Signing, Document Creation, and File Transfer), which includes navigating legacy technologies and keeping our support baseline under control.
Own the quality: Take full ownership of software testing (Unit, Integration, E2E) and performance. We don't have a dedicated QA team, so our engineers own the code from design to deployment.
Smart AI Integration: Responsibly integrate AI APIs (like LLMs) into our products when needed, ensuring they handle personal and payroll data in strict compliance with GDPR/AVG and least-privilege principles.
AI Monitoring & Guardrails: Build guardrails, evaluation, and monitoring for any AI features you integrate, keeping a close eye on quality, cost, latency, safety, and bias. 
Architecture & Problem Solving: Architect and implement software solutions by analyzing business context, technical feasibility, and system scalability.
Code Excellence: Evaluate, refactor, and review code actively. Ensure high security standards, architectural integrity, and efficiency.
Take Ownership: Make informed decisions quickly and take ownership of services and applications at scale.
Team Collaboration: Actively participate in agile team meetings, propose creative solutions to daily challenges, share knowledge, and work collaboratively to achieve our goals.

What we offer

Our local staff is part of a dynamic and multicultural environment (average age of 41, 9 nationalities)
Challenging, exciting, and varied tasks.
An inclusive and inspiring work environment with skilled colleagues.
Exciting professional environment based on a high level of expertise.
Facilitation for professional and personal development.
Competitive pay.
Social benefits (ticket restaurants, teleworking expenses and health insurance).
Team building activities and social business life.
Autonomy day (take a day off from your daily duties to research, experiment with new technologies/AI tools, or self-learning).
Flexible working hours, 7-10h / 16-19h (Friday from 8-15h).
During July and August, 8-15h every day.
Salary 44.000-55.000 annual gross

Position with full flexibility: full remote*, partial or in office.
Remote working across different areas of Spain is not a problem but please note that you'd have to be already located and eligible to work in the country to apply. Scopely is looking for a Staff Server Engineer to join our new unannounced project in Barcelona, Spain to work on a hybrid basis 3 times a week. We can support with visa sponsorship and relocation support.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a distributed team of game enthusiasts who are developing, publishing, and innovating in the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world every day.

We are in the development stages of one of our new unannounced projects. We are looking for passionate game makers to collaborate, get in early and make their mark on this exciting venture

We are in the early stages of development on a bold, unannounced, cross-platform Strategy/MMO title, crafting a team of dedicated and hard-working game makers to join us on this exciting journey!

What You Will Do

The Staff Backend Software Engineer will lead the effort to develop new backend features for our game, focusing on developing large scale features in collaboration with other developers and game stakeholders
Work as part of a cross functional team that develops core technologies and game features
Mentor members of the backend teams
Analyze and identify technical bottlenecks in the existing codebase as well as future implementations, and propose new technical strategies
Refactor and optimize internal code to improve efficiency, scalability, and maintainability
Collaborate with other engineering teams to ensure cohesive and scalable backend architecture
Develop and enforce best practices for code quality, and emphasize maintainability and scalability in a distributed architecture
Conduct regular code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members
Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and technologies to continually enhance backend technologies and practices
Collaborate with Design, Product and other game stakeholders to define roadmap and prioritize technical initiatives.

What We’re Looking For

Experienced in Software Development
Experience in developing highly available back-end systems and servers for large-scale MMO games, high-traffic web systems or applications
Experienced with Go, Python and C#.
Deep understanding of microservices architecture, cloud-native development, and container orchestration
Problem-solving skills and ability to lead complex projects
High leadership skills, with experience mentoring junior and peer engineers
High degree of collaboration in a cross functional team to deliver product features focused on solid and realistic solutions.

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Solid experience with Unified Namespace concepts and enabling technologies:

, com 2+ anos de experiência

.
Não procuramos alguém que já domine todas as tecnologias da stack. Procuramos uma pessoa com boas bases de Software Engineering, experiência sólida em C#/.NET e vontade de crescer tecnicamente
num ambiente moderno, exigente e internacional.
📍 Algés / Miraflores

🏢 Híbrido – 3 dias presenciais por semana

💻 Junior/Mid – 2+ anos de experiência

🌍 Inglês obrigatório

✈️ Disponibilidade para viagens internacionais

✈️ O projeto
Vais integrar um contexto tecnológico ligado à indústria da aviação
, participando no desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações e serviços utilizados num ecossistema internacional.
É um ambiente onde temas como integração entre sistemas, disponibilidade, performance, qualidade de código e fiabilidade das aplicações
assumem particular importância.
Vais trabalhar maioritariamente no ecossistema Microsoft/.NET
, mas terás contacto com diferentes tecnologias de Back-End, Front-End, messaging, databases, scripting e infraestrutura.

⚙️ O core tecnológico
A principal linguagem de desenvolvimento será:
C# 14 + .NET 10

Procuramos experiência em desenvolvimento Back-End com C#/.NET
, incluindo construção e evolução de aplicações, serviços e integrações.
No acesso e persistência de dados, vais trabalhar com: Entity Framework Core + PostgreSQL 17

Será importante compreender conceitos como modelação e acesso a dados, queries, operações CRUD, migrations e interação eficiente entre aplicação e base de dados.

🔗 APIs & Integrações
Uma parte importante do trabalho passa pelo desenvolvimento e integração de serviços através de: REST APIs

Queremos alguém confortável com conceitos de APIs, endpoints, requests/responses, integração entre sistemas, tratamento de erros e debugging.
Terás também contacto com: RabbitMQ

Experiência com messaging, queues ou arquiteturas assíncronas será valorizada, especialmente em contextos onde diferentes aplicações e serviços necessitam de comunicar de forma desacoplada.

🧪 Testing & qualidade
Qualidade de software também faz parte do desenvolvimento.
A stack inclui: xUnit

Valorizamos experiência ou conhecimentos de Unit Testing
, preocupação com código testável e utilização de boas práticas que permitam construir aplicações mais robustas e fáceis de manter.

🐳 Containers & ambientes
Terás contacto com: Docker + Virtual Machines

É importante compreender como as aplicações são executadas e disponibilizadas nos diferentes ambientes, não ficando limitado/a apenas ao desenvolvimento local.
Experiência com containers, criação/utilização de imagens Docker, configuração de ambientes ou troubleshooting será valorizada.

⚛️ E há Front-End?
Sim. Embora C#/.NET seja o principal foco
, existe também uma componente de desenvolvimento web.
Poderás trabalhar com:
React 19

TypeScript 5

HTML 5.2

CSS3

Não procuramos necessariamente um especialista de Front-End. Experiência ou conhecimentos nestas tecnologias serão uma vantagem para quem gosta de compreender e contribuir para a solução de forma mais transversal.

🛠️ Automação & Scripting
Também poderás ter contacto com diferentes linguagens e ferramentas de scripting:
Python 3

PowerShell 7

Shell

São conhecimentos úteis para automação, troubleshooting, operações e pequenas ferramentas de suporte ao desenvolvimento.

🎯 O perfil que procuramos
• 2+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software
;
• Experiência prática com C# e .NET
;
• Conhecimentos de Entity Framework Core
;
• Experiência com bases de dados relacionais, idealmente PostgreSQL
;
• Experiência no desenvolvimento ou integração de REST APIs
;
• Conhecimentos de Unit Testing
e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
• Contacto com Docker e/ou Virtual Machines
;
• Capacidade de analisar problemas e fazer troubleshooting;
• Interesse em aprender e trabalhar com diferentes componentes de uma solução;
• Boa capacidade de comunicação e trabalho em equipa;
• Inglês obrigatório
para comunicação num contexto internacional;
• Disponibilidade para trabalhar 3 dias por semana presencialmente em Algés/Miraflores
;
• Disponibilidade para viagens internacionais
, de acordo com as necessidades dos projetos.

Se tens uma boa base de C#/.NET
, já trabalhas profissionalmente em desenvolvimento de software e queres continuar a crescer, queremos conhecer-te.
🌍 Software + Aviação + contexto internacional
Esta é uma oportunidade para trabalhar num projeto onde a tecnologia está inserida num ecossistema global de aviação
, com contacto com diferentes realidades, equipas e desafios técnicos.
E sim: existe a possibilidade de viajar para diferentes partes do mundo
no âmbito dos projetos. ✈️

Smartcat is building the future of work, where human expertise meets digital teammates to drive 10x to 1000x productivity gains for the world’s leading enterprises.

We’re on the frontier of an entirely new category: Agentic AI. We enable enterprises to build high-performing hybrid workforces made up of both humans and AI agents. These AI agents aren’t generic copilots. They’re fully trained digital teammates that learn from your best people, your content, and your business strategy—ready to get to work from day one.

Our platform combines generative AI, human-in-the-loop workflows, and a living Enterprise Skill Graph that continuously learns and improves. Whether you're launching a product globally, onboarding new hires, translating learning content, or aligning legal teams across regions, Smartcat turns knowledge into action and action into scale.

Over 1,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Smartcat to bring their business to the world—instantly, accurately, and in every language. As a Series C company with consistently high year-over-year growth, we’re scaling fast and investing in people who want to shape the future of work with us.

Join us in unlocking global potential, one human and agent team at a time.

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM

We are building the future of software development — AI-First is the new standard
. You won’t be “experimenting”; you’ll be delivering. Fast. Smart. Relentless. Join the core team that will prove AI-driven engineering is the only way forward. If you love challenges, own your outcomes, and are obsessed with delivery, you’ll thrive here.

MISSION

As an AI-First Engineer, your mission is to deliver production-quality features at a speed and scale that traditional teams cannot match. You will apply AI aggressively across every stage
of the development lifecycle — from requirements and design to coding, testing, and release — and establish a new engineering benchmark for the company.

OUTCOMES

Consistently deliver high-quality, production-grade features faster than traditional teams.
Build and optimize AI-first workflows that integrate AI across all development stages.
Raise the bar for speed, quality, and ownership in product delivery.
Be a core contributor to the new engineering culture built on AI-First principles.

How You’ll Ramp

By Day 30:

Deeply understand our AWS, .NET, Python, MongoDB tech stack and delivery model.
Start shipping real features using AI at every stage: coding, testing, documenting, releasing.
Contribute to improving workflows for even faster delivery.

By Day 60:

Independently own the full lifecycle of feature delivery through AI-first methods.
Identify and drive improvements in velocity, automation, and team efficiency.
Partner with Product and Tech Leads to aggressively accelerate time-to-market.

By Day 90:

Deliver features faster and with higher quality than baseline teams.
Actively mentor others on using AI as a multiplier across development.
Become a key driver of the AI-First engineering standard inside the company.

WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED:

Proven track record
of delivering production-grade products using AI-driven approach.
Mastery in using AI tools
(Copilot/Cursor/WindSurf (etc, you choose), GPT APIs, LLMs) across the entire development lifecycle — design, code generation, testing, documentation, and release.
Strong technical foundation in AWS, .NET, Python, and MongoDB.
Obsessed with delivery: you ship, you improve, you own the outcome.
Comfortable moving fast, taking ownership, and constantly pushing for better, faster, smarter execution.

Why joining Smartcat might be your best move so far

A global, connected team
We’re a team of 200+ people across 30+ countries, working together through a hub-and-spoke model anchored in eight key locations: New York, London, Lisbon, Costa Rica, Serbia, Armenia, Georgia, and Spain. Most of our roles are remote-friendly, giving you the flexibility to do your best work from where you thrive. For customer-facing teams, we prioritize proximity to our customers, ensuring we stay deeply connected to their needs and deliver an exceptional experience. No matter where you’re based, you’ll be part of a highly collaborative, globally-distributed team that values ownership, speed, and meaningful impact.
Be part of an AI Native Organization
We are highly innovative, using AI across all areas of the organization to accelerate decision-making and free people to focus on strategy and high-impact work. We embrace new ideas and encourage all Smartcaters, regardless of level or department, to manage their own AI Agents. At Smartcat you’ll shape how AI transforms the workplace and play an integral role in ensuring Smartcat remains a leader in AI innovation.
Innovating a $100 Billion industry
Smartcat is reshaping the $100B multilingual content industry with an AI-powered platform that makes it easy for companies to create, translate, and localize global content at scale. Our platform enables enterprise teams to move away from slow, traditional outsourcing methods, and achieve fast, high-quality results, at a fraction of the cost.
Join the rocketship to scale-up 10x and beyond together
We are looking for someone to become an integral part of our team and play a crucial role in the most exciting part of our journey: transitioning from a post-Series C startup to a company exceeding $100M in ARR and $1B in valuation. Our journey isn’t for the faint of heart. We are growing at 130% YoY, thanks to our strong product-market fit and high-performing team, and plan to accelerate from here.
Smartcat Culture Code: Where Diversity Meets High Performance
At Smartcat, we are committed to building a culture that highlights respect and appreciation for each individual's unique background and perspective, while maintaining a strong focus on results and engagement. We believe in welcoming everyone and fostering an inclusive environment where team members can be their authentic selves at work. Our commitment to inclusion is steadfast, and we stand firmly against discrimination and harassment.

About Us Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights. Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more.
We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day. 
About the Role The Connect Team enables seamless integrations between external vendor ecosystems and Riskified’s comprehensive product portfolio - including Chargeback Guarantee, Dispute Resolve, and Policy Engine.
We build high-performance connectors, apps, and APIs that bridge third-party services (Payment Gateways, Return Vendors, eCommerce Platforms, and CRMs) directly into our platform. By extending our platformic integration layers and introducing cutting-edge AI and agentic solutions, our team drastically simplifies merchant onboarding and accelerates integration velocity across thousands of global eCommerce merchants.
This role requires strong technical execution paired with a deep understanding of our business domain to deliver frictionless, highly reliable onboarding experiences.

Drive AI & Automation: Introduce and implement AI and agentic solutions into product onboarding flows to maximize speed, accuracy, and automation for merchants.
Embrace Modern Workflows: Actively utilize agentic coding tools and AI-assisted workflows to boost team development velocity and code quality.
Bridge Tech & Business: Partner with Product, Design, and Domain experts to translate complex risk, dispute, and policy business logic into elegant software architecture.
Ship to Production Daily: Maintain modern CI/CD pipelines, deploying high-quality code daily and taking strong end-to-end ownership of service reliability and performance.
Active part in planning the team roadmap and products

Qualifications B.Sc. in Computer Science or equivalent certifications
5+ years of proven experience in hands-on server-side coding
Proven experience with server-side development languages, such as TypeScript, Scala, Java, C#, or Kotlin

Experience incorporating LLMs or agentic frameworks directly into customer-facing products - advantage

The base salary is one part of the total compensation package at Riskified. All full-time regular employees receive a bonus target and are eligible to receive stock-based awards. Also, our value proposition goes way beyond compensation: our perks and benefits package, culture, community, and learning and development programs are just some of the elements we provide to bring value to our employees.
Join us in shaping the future of Riskified’s innovative FinTech solutions, contributing to our cutting-edge environment while honing your skills as a Backend Developer. If you’re ready to take on impactful challenges and excel in a collaborative, forward-thinking team, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
About Air Apps

At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger—and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal, in 2018—and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco—we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.
Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.
Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way.
The Role

As a Software Architect / Solutions Architect
at Air Apps, you will be responsible for defining and overseeing the overall system architecture
for our AI-powered platform. You will collaborate with engineering teams, product managers, and stakeholders to design scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions
that align with business objectives.
You will play a key role in shaping our technology strategy, evaluating new tools and frameworks, and ensuring best practices
in software design, cloud infrastructure, and system integration.
Responsibilities

Define and maintain the overall architecture and system design for scalable and efficient software solutions.
Provide technical leadership to engineering teams, guiding them in best practices for architecture, coding, and system scalability.
Design and document high-level system diagrams, data flows, and API structures.
Evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks, and cloud services to optimize performance, security, and cost-efficiency.
Ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and security in all architectural decisions.
Oversee system integrations, including microservices, APIs, and third-party services.
Work closely with DevOps and SRE teams to ensure smooth deployment and operational reliability.
Establish coding and architecture standards, ensuring maintainability and scalability of codebases.
Identify and mitigate technical risks, ensuring system resilience and future scalability.
Conduct architecture reviews and performance audits to continuously improve system efficiency.

Requirements

Around 6+ years of experience in software development and architecture.
Strong expertise in system design, cloud computing, and microservices architecture.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform) and cloud-native architectures.
Proficiency in backend technologies (e.g., Node.js, Python, Java, .NET) and experience with modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue).
Knowledge of databases (SQL and NoSQL), caching strategies, and data pipelines.
Experience with event-driven architectures, API design, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
Strong understanding of security best practices, identity management, and encryption techniques.
Ability to evaluate trade-offs in architectural decisions, balancing scalability, cost, and complexity.
Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex architectural concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What benefits are we offering?

Apple hardware ecosystem for work.
Annual Bonus
Top-tier Health and Life Insurance for peace of mind.
Transportation Budget to support your commute needs.
Coverflex benefits package for meal allowances, well-being, and more.
Childcare support.
Air Conference - an opportunity to meet the team, collaborate, and grow together.
Pension Fund to support your long-term financial planning.
Urban Sports Club membership to keep you active.
Meals 100% free at the hub.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Air Apps, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We enthusiastically welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that varied voices and experiences make us stronger.
Application Disclaimer

At Air Apps, we value transparency and integrity in our hiring process. Applicants must submit their own work without any AI-generated assistance. Any use of AI in application materials, assessments, or interviews will result in disqualification.

jobs.description:
Energizing a new world with Exide Technologies

About us:

Exide Technologies (www.exidegroup.com) is an internationally leading provider of innovative and sustainable battery storage solutions for automotive and industrial applications. With more than 135 years of experience, Exide has developed and globally marketed innovative batteries and systems, contributing to the energy transition and driving a cleaner future. Exide Technologies' culture and strategy are centred on recycling, sustainability, and environmental responsibility. The company has 11 manufacturing and 3 recycling facilities across Europe, ensuring resilience and a low CO2 footprint with a local supply chain. With a team of 5,000 employees, we provide €1.6bn energy storage solutions and services to customers worldwide, every year.

Exide Technologies’ Energy Solutions division
is developing and manufacturing stationary energy storage batteries, from backup power to large-scale storage systems (BESS and C&I). Exide´s technology portfolio spans from multiple lead-acid over to lithium-ion technologies supporting the global energy transition and digitalization. Our storage systems are used in UPS, Telecom, Datacenters, Public Transport, in Front-of- and Behind-the-Meter applications and many more.

About the job:

For our fast-growing division Energy Solutions in Castanheira do Ribatejo, Portugal at the earliest possible date we are looking for a: R&D Embedded Software Engineer - Lithium Battery Systems.

Reporting to the department manager, your mission will be to integrate the software engineering group within the R&D department, contributing to the development, integration, and optimization of embedded software solutions for advanced battery and energy storage systems.

What will your daily responsibilities include in this role?

Develop and maintain the control system, working with the team to translate customer requirements into a fully delivered product.
Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans to validate the functionality and performance of the software.
Collaborate closely with customers throughout all project stages to ensure that technical requirements are accurately understood and incorporated into the software design.
Perform hands‑on testing on real test benches and in simulated environments, with a solid understanding of the limitations and advantages of each setup.
Drive continuous improvement by enhancing both software quality and testing methodologies, reducing testing time and increasing overall efficiency.

What we ask for:

Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent.
Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in software development within technical or engineering domains.
Hands-on programming experience in C# for Microsoft .NET Core.
Software Development Practices: Familiarity with unit testing, continuous integration, and Git version control.
Networking and IoT: Strong understanding of IoT technologies, with proficiency in data bus communication protocols such as CAN, RS485, Modbus, as well as IP networking.
Experience working with low to high voltage battery systems ranging from 12 V to 1000 V DC.
Background in the Network Power (Stationary Energy) sector.
Knowledge of Lithium Energy Storage Systems (ESS) and Bulk Energy Storage Systems.
Solid understanding of data bus communication protocols (CAN, RS485, Modbus, etc.).
English level C1 required.
Ability to work in international and multicultural scenarios.

What we offer:

We offer you a challenging, responsible and varied job in a modern, fast growing division within an International Corporation. You can expect a highly collegial working environment with a reasonable scope for action and decision-making. You will benefit from exciting personal and professional development opportunities, additional corporate well-being initiatives, and several key benefits, including:

Competitive compensation.
Flexible working hours system.
Annual holidays: 23 days. Plus 3 extra company‑provided days, one of which is the employee’s birthday.
Subsidized meals.
Pension Plan financed by the employer.
Medical Services according Exide protocols.
Professional growth possibilities & learning opportunities.
Access to Gamelearn platform.
Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues.
Contribute to innovative projects.
A real perspective of working in a dynamic environment.

Working with us means being engaged and agile. Our culture of continuous learning and commitment to sustainability and diversity create an environment where you can grow your skills and your career.

Feel free to apply if you think you meet the criteria and are excited to join our project. Please submit your application along with an updated CV. A member of our Selection team will reach out to you. Best of luck!
Our energy: It’s you!
Together, we will be transforming the energy sector.

Since 2009, previously known as INTEGRITY, our team based in Portugal is specialised in providing cutting-edge Managed Security Services that combine its expertise and proprietary technology to consistently and effectively reduce the cyber risk of our clients.

The comprehensive service range includes Persistent Intrusion Testing, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, GRC Consulting and Solutions, and Third-Party Risk Management. jobs.title: Client Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Client Suppoort Engineer

London, Belfast or Lisbon - hybrid working

Intapp is looking for a Client Support Engineer to join our Client Success & Support team. This is a technical, client-facing role focused on the investigation and resolution of issues across Intapp Time — our time capture and management platform — in both cloud and on-premise environments.

What you'll do

Own investigation, triage, and resolution of client-reported issues across Intapp Profitability, with a primary focus on Intapp Time in cloud and on-premise environments.

Diagnose issues across the Intapp Time ecosystem, including the web application, Admin, Desktop, Desktop Extension, Mobile, Capture, tenant configuration, and identity and access management.

Investigate common support scenarios such as time-entry and submission failures, missing client or matter data, validation and synchronisation issues, performance problems, login failures, and integration errors.

Use logs, error messages, configuration, browser diagnostics, API responses, and client-provided evidence to isolate root cause and distinguish product defects from configuration, data, network, or environmental issues.

Troubleshoot integrations between Intapp Time and clients' practice-management or financial-management systems using SQL, stored procedures, SOAP/REST APIs, data mappings, service accounts, and integration logs.

Support issues involving Intapp Integration Service (Dell Boomi) and Intapp Integrate, including schedules, connectors, mappings, credentials, queues, and process reporting.

Apply impact-based triage and prioritisation, taking account of production availability, affected users, business impact, and service-level expectations, and act promptly on high-priority or widespread issues.

Provide accurate, timely, and technically clear updates to client contacts, translating complex findings into practical next steps and maintaining ownership through to resolution.

Prepare complete escalation packages for product defects, including business impact, diagnostic evidence, steps to reproduce, and relevant logs.

Recognise when a request falls outside break-fix support and route it to the appropriate team while maintaining a smooth client handover.

Maintain accurate, audit-ready ticket records and contribute to knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides that improve consistency and time to resolution.

What you'll need

2+ years' experience supporting enterprise SaaS and/or on-premise software in a client-facing technical support or application support role.

Experience supporting integrations between enterprise business applications.

Practical experience with ticketing systems and support workflows, including impact-based prioritisation, SLA management, and accurate technical documentation.

Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate complex symptoms, interpret logs, and identify root cause.

Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL; Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL experience is highly desirable.

Working knowledge of SOAP and REST APIs, HTTP, authentication, JSON/XML payloads, and common integration or connectivity issues.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical client contacts.

A strong sense of ownership and client responsibility, with the ability to work independently, collaborate across cross-functional teams, and exercise sound judgement on when to escalate.

A genuine interest in using AI tools to improve the speed, quality, and consistency of support work; hands-on experience applying AI in a support or technical environment is an advantage.

Desirable

Experience supporting Intapp Time, other Intapp Profitability products, Intapp Integration Service (Dell Boomi), or Intapp Integrate.

Experience integrating time or billing applications with legal practice-management or financial-management systems such as Aderant, Elite/3E, or Carpe Diem.

Understanding of synchronisation, data mapping, scheduled jobs, and source-of-truth concepts in integrated enterprise applications.

Familiarity with Microsoft technologies such as .NET, Internet Information Services (IIS), Windows Server, PowerShell, or SQL Server, or relevant Microsoft, .NET, or SQL certification.

Experience with enterprise connectivity troubleshooting, including DNS, proxies, TLS certificates, firewall rules, load balancers, or network tracing tools such as Wireshark or Fiddler.

Experience with identity and access technologies such as SSO, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, or Microsoft Entra ID.

Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman or browser developer tools.

Experience creating knowledge-base content or support procedures that reduce recurring issues and improve resolution quality.

What you'll gain

At Intapp, you'll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. You'll be part of a growing public company, with a modern work environment that's connected yet flexible, where your professional growth and well-being are top priorities.

Expand your skills

Unlock your potential with professional development opportunities supported by a community of experienced professionals. We offer reimbursement for training and continuing education to help you stay ahead in your career.

Enjoy where you work

Thrive in our modern, open offices designed to inspire creativity and collaboration. Our complimentary lunches and fully stocked kitchens ensure you have everything you need to stay energised throughout the day.

Support what matters most

Our comprehensive wellness and flexible time-off programmes and benefits are designed to care for you and your family. Our family-formation benefits and support during your family-building journey ensure you have the resources you need when it matters most. Als Fullstack Engineer
bist du Teil eines Teams, das für die Prozessautomatisierung von Festnetzzugangsprojekten innerhalb der Telekom Deutschland verantwortlich ist. mit umfangreicher Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit C# .NET, fundierten Kenntnissen in Microservice-Architekturen, Containerisierungstechnologien und Prozessautomatisierungsplattformen, kombiniert mit solidem Bildungshintergrund und kollaborativer Denkweise.

Abschluss in Informatik, Computer Science oder einem verwandten Bereich

Kenntnisse in mindestens einer objektorientierten Programmiersprache, vorzugsweise C#

Praktische Erfahrung mit Orchestrierung mittels Kubernetes
Praktische Erfahrung mit Camunda

Erfahrung in der Konfiguration und Entwicklung von Monitoring-Tools wie Grafana, Prometheus und Dapr
Vertraut mit gängigen Best Practices der Softwareentwicklung einschließlich Design Patterns
Vertraut mit Clean-Code-Prinzipien
Vertraut mit testgetriebener Entwicklung (TDD)
Vertraut mit Versionskontrollsystemen (Git)
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microservice-Architekturen, vorzugsweise mit .NET und Kubernetes

Erfahrung im Design und der Implementierung von Integration Connectors
Analytische und lösungsorientierte Herangehensweise an Problemstellungen
Angetrieben von der Bereitschaft zu wachsen und dich und dein Team kontinuierlich dazu zu bringen, innovative Ideen zu erkunden
Fähigkeit, in einem agilen Arbeitsumfeld erfolgreich zu sein

Company Description

As Hungary’s most attractive employer in 2025 (according to Randstad’s representative survey), Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions
is a subsidiary of the Deutsche Telekom Group. The company provides a wide portfolio of IT and telecommunications services with more than 5300 employees. We have hundreds of large customers, corporations in Germany and in other European countries.

DT-ITS recieved the Best in Educational Cooperation award from HIPA in 2019, acknowledged as the the Most Ethical Multinational Company in 2019. The company continuously develops its four sites in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs and Szeged and is looking for skilled IT professionals to join its team.

Job Description

Project Description:

The Fixed Access Rollout Orchestration (FARO) system is a cloud native software platform whose main task is the automation of business processes. FARO is based on a microservice architecture written in C# .NET. It provides process control (so called MissionScheduler) and connects to 3rd party systems in the environment of the processes (so called connectors). In the future FARO will enable our new process platform Camunda with connectors. The team in addition to developing connectors for FARO will also be responsible to develop templates and APIs for Camunda.

Activity Description:

As a Fullstack engineer you are part of a team which is responsible for process automation for fixed access network projects within Telekom Deutschland. You will be part of an innovative and agile work environment where you will be implementing future-oriented software solutions to manage and plan the hardware rollout for the fixed access network.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend microservices using C# .NET within a Kubernetes-orchestrated environment
Implement and improve traceability, observability, and stability of the growing microservice architecture through monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, and Dapr
Develop and enhance frontend components using Angular to deliver responsive user interfaces and support rapid feature deployment
Design and implement RESTful APIs and integration connectors for FARO and Camunda process automation platform
Model, configure, and optimise business processes using BPMN standards within the Camunda ecosystem
Containerise applications using Docker and manage deployment pipelines within Kubernetes clusters
Conduct code reviews, share technical expertise, and provide constructive feedback throughout the development lifecycle to maintain code quality and team growth
Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve performance bottlenecks and system issues across the microservice architecture
Contribute to the continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation processes
Drive innovation by evaluating and implementing emerging technologies and best practices in software development, including design patterns, clean code principles, and test-driven development

Qualifications

Must-Have Skills:

You hold a degree in informatics, computer science, or a related field
You have multiple years of professional experience as either a Fullstack or Backend Developer
You are proficient in at least one object-oriented programming language, preferably C#
You have hands-on experience with containerisation using Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes
You have practical experience with Camunda and are proficient in BPMN process modelling
You have experience in configuring and developing monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, and Dapr
You are well-versed in common software development best practices including design patterns, clean code principles, test-driven development (TDD), and version control systems (Git)
You possess proficient knowledge of microservice architectures, preferably with .NET and Kubernetes
You have experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and integration connectors
You are analytical and solution-oriented in your approach to problem-solving
You are driven by a willingness to grow and continuously push yourself and your team to explore innovative ideas
You thrive in an agile work environment and embrace collaborative development practices
You are interested in telecommunication technologies and their applications
You are proficient in English; German language skills are a significant advantage

Nice-to-Have Skills:

You have experience with Angular and can make quick, effective fixes to the front end
You have hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation processes
You have demonstrated experience in performance optimisation and troubleshooting complex system issues
You are familiar with emerging technologies and best practices in software development and are keen to evaluate and implement them

Additional Information

Please be informed that our remote working possibility is only available within Hungary due to European taxation regulation.

Why Join Exadel

We’re an AI-first global tech company with 25+ years of engineering leadership, 2,000+ team members, and 500+ active projects powering Fortune 500 clients, including HBO, Microsoft, Google, and Starbucks.

From AI platforms to digital transformation, we partner with enterprise leaders to build what’s next.

What powers it all? Our people are ambitious, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

About The Client

The leading provider of vehicle lifecycle solutions, with headquarters in Chicago, enables the companies that build, insure, and replace vehicles to power the next generation of transportation. Its platform delivers advanced mobile, artificial intelligence, and car technologies. It connects a network of 350+ insurance companies, 24,000+ repair facilities, hundreds of parts suppliers, and dozens of third-party data and service providers. The customer's collective solutions enhance productivity and help clients deliver better experiences for end consumers.

Design and evolve cloud-native architectures across the full platform stack — compute, API management, messaging, eventing, and data primarily on Microsoft Azure (e.g., App Services, Container Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Azure SQL); equivalent AWS services welcome, Azure preferred

Champion the use of AI and intelligent automation to lift engineering productivity, code quality, and delivery velocity

Extensive professional experience in .NET application architecture and development, with a strong C# foundation
Proven experience designing and deploying cloud-native solutions (Azure or AWS) using microservices, RESTful APIs, and distributed-system design
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tooling (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or comparable agentic coding tools) and proven ability to apply them to lift team-wide engineering productivity

Ezen felül vállalati szintű tesztelési módszertanok kialakítását és üzleti folyamatok automatizációját végezzük. A tesztelési és robotizációs kompetenciánk mellett a nagyvállalati projektmenedzsmentben is kiváló referenciákkal rendelkezünk.

A magyar piacon telekommunikációs, pénzintézeti, biztosítói és energiaipari ügyfeleink mellett nemzetközi projekteken is dolgozunk hazai csapatunkkal.

Csapatunk eredményeit saját belső képzési rendszerünkkel biztosítjuk, a jó kedvet pedig rendszeres munkaidőn belüli- és kívüli csapatépítő programokkal garantáljuk. A kölcsönös rugalmasság és bizalom tesz minket közösséggé, ahol a szakmai fejlődés nem elvárás, hanem kiugrási lehetőség.

Tapasztalt Quality Automation Engineert keresünk Innovation Teamünkbe, aki aktívan hozzájárul új tesztelési és quality engineering megoldások fejlesztéséhez.

A pozíció fókuszában olyan újrahasznosítható megoldások tervezése és fejlesztése áll, amelyek javítják a szoftvertesztelés, a termékminőség és a fejlesztési folyamatok hatékonyságát. jobs.title: Data & Reporting Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview

The Data & Reporting Integration Engineer is responsible for managing all data flows and integrations across systems through the data layer into the Oracle Fusion ERP general ledger, as well as reporting integrations to downstream applications and reporting. The role ensures seamless, secure, and accurate data movement to support financial operations. Additionally, the role plays a key part in enabling reliable, scalable, and high-quality financial reporting by ensuring that data pipelines, transformations, and integrations are aligned with reporting requirements, data governance standards, and audit expectations.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain data integration pipelines, including extracting, transforming, and loading data from traditional structured and non structured sources as well as SAS solutions such as Oracle Fusion Cloud
Analyze and document business requirements to ensure technical solutions address stakeholder needs
Collaborate with business users to map current vs. future state processes and identify improvement opportunities, with a focus on data consumption, reporting processes, and output usability
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather integration requirements, map data models, and implement security protocols for ERP integrations
Ensuring data quality, accuracy, completeness, traceability, auditability, reconciliation and control frameworks of data integrations till the downstream systems and reporting layer.
Contribute to data pipeline orchestration, including scheduling, dependency management, and monitoring, troubleshooting and optimizing performance
Ensure data structures and transformations support financial, regulatory compliance and management reporting requirements
Partner with business teams thru requirements gathering, implementation, testing and deployment of reports
Support testing cycles by implementation of automated testing, validating functionality, documenting gaps, and coordinating with technical teams

Required Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
5+ years of hands-on data pipeline development experience in Python or .NET
Expertise with modern application frameworks and paradigms (e.g., .NET/C#, Java, OOD/OOP, functional programming, Spring, J2EE, SOA, DI, architectural patterns)
PowerBI or any other market leading reporting tool to design and implement business reports.
Understanding of microservices and API-based integration patterns
Experience in database design, including relational and dimensional modeling, data warehousing approaches (e.g., star schema).
Experience developing data solutions using cloud services (AWS) and associated tooling (e.g., EC2, ECS, S3, Redshift)
Exposure to event-driven or streaming-based data processing is an advantage
Experience with build and deployment tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git/Bitbucket, Maven, Jenkins, Nexus, SQL Management Studio)
Strong knowledge of data security, APIs, and data structures
Excellent problem-solving and communication skills
Familiarity with integration frameworks or messaging/streaming technologies is an advantage
Experience working with financial reporting datasets (e.g., GL, subledger, or aggregated reporting layers) is a plus

What we offer

Competitive salary
Comprehensive health package
Cafeteria
All You Can Move
Brand new office at an excellent location
Hybrid working
Opportunities for growth and advancement
A highly people-centric, positive, and supportive work environment
