jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer - REF5795Q
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgabe

Als Fullstack Engineer
bist du Teil eines Teams, das für die Prozessautomatisierung von Festnetzzugangsprojekten innerhalb der Telekom Deutschland verantwortlich ist. Du arbeitest in einem innovativen und agilen Umfeld und implementierst zukunftsorientierte Softwarelösungen zur Verwaltung und Planung des Hardware-Rollouts für das Festnetzzugangsnetz. Das Fixed Access Rollout Orchestration (FARO) System ist eine Cloud-native Softwareplattform, deren Hauptaufgabe die Automatisierung von Geschäftsprozessen ist, basierend auf einer Microservice-Architektur, die in C# .NET geschrieben ist. Das Team wird Konnektoren für FARO entwickeln und für die Entwicklung von Templates und APIs für Camunda verantwortlich sein.

Hauptaufgaben

Design, Entwicklung und Wartung skalierbarer Backend-Microservices mit C# .NET in einer Kubernetes-orchestrierten Umgebung
Implementierung und Verbesserung der Nachverfolgbarkeit, Beobachtbarkeit und Stabilität der wachsenden Microservice-Architektur durch Monitoring-Tools wie Grafana, Prometheus und Dapr
Entwicklung und Verbesserung von Frontend-Komponenten mit Angular zur Bereitstellung responsiver Benutzeroberflächen und Unterstützung schneller Feature-Deployments
Design und Implementierung von RESTful APIs und Integrationskonnektoren für FARO und die Camunda-Prozessautomatisierungsplattform
Modellierung, Konfiguration und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen unter Verwendung von BPMN-Standards im Camunda-Ökosystem
Containerisierung von Anwendungen mit Docker und Verwaltung von Deployment-Pipelines in Kubernetes-Clustern
Durchführung von Code-Reviews, Weitergabe von technischem Fachwissen und konstruktives Feedback während des gesamten Entwicklungszyklus zur Aufrechterhaltung der Code-Qualität und des Teamwachstums
Fehlerbehebung, Diagnose und Lösung von Performance-Engpässen und Systemproblemen in der Microservice-Architektur
Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von CI/CD-Pipelines und Deployment-Automatisierungsprozessen
Förderung von Innovation durch Evaluierung und Implementierung neuer Technologien und Best Practices in der Softwareentwicklung, einschließlich Design Patterns, Clean Code-Prinzipien und testgetriebener Entwicklung

Dein Profil

Wir suchen einen qualifizierten Fullstack Engineer
mit umfangreicher Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit C# .NET, fundierten Kenntnissen in Microservice-Architekturen, Containerisierungstechnologien und Prozessautomatisierungsplattformen, kombiniert mit solidem Bildungshintergrund und kollaborativer Denkweise.

Muss-Kriterien

Abschluss in Informatik, Computer Science oder einem verwandten Bereich
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Fullstack- oder Backend-Entwickler
Kenntnisse in mindestens einer objektorientierten Programmiersprache, vorzugsweise C#
Praktische Erfahrung mit Containerisierung mittels Docker
Praktische Erfahrung mit Orchestrierung mittels Kubernetes
Praktische Erfahrung mit Camunda
Kenntnisse in BPMN-Prozessmodellierung
Erfahrung in der Konfiguration und Entwicklung von Monitoring-Tools wie Grafana, Prometheus und Dapr
Vertraut mit gängigen Best Practices der Softwareentwicklung einschließlich Design Patterns
Vertraut mit Clean-Code-Prinzipien
Vertraut mit testgetriebener Entwicklung (TDD)
Vertraut mit Versionskontrollsystemen (Git)
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microservice-Architekturen, vorzugsweise mit .NET und Kubernetes
Erfahrung im Design und der Implementierung von RESTful APIs
Erfahrung im Design und der Implementierung von Integration Connectors
Analytische und lösungsorientierte Herangehensweise an Problemstellungen
Angetrieben von der Bereitschaft zu wachsen und dich und dein Team kontinuierlich dazu zu bringen, innovative Ideen zu erkunden
Fähigkeit, in einem agilen Arbeitsumfeld erfolgreich zu sein
Begeisterung für kollaborative Entwicklungspraktiken
Interesse an Telekommunikationstechnologien und deren Anwendungen
Gute Englischkenntnisse

Von Vorteil

Deutschkenntnisse
Erfahrung mit Angular und die Fähigkeit, schnelle und effektive Anpassungen am Frontend vorzunehmen
Praktische Erfahrung mit CI/CD-Pipelines und Deployment-Automatisierungsprozessen
Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in Performance-Optimierung und Troubleshooting komplexer Systemprobleme
Vertrautheit mit aufkommenden Technologien und Best Practices in der Softwareentwicklung
Begeisterung dafür, aufkommende Technologien und Best Practices zu evaluieren und zu implementieren

Über uns

Als attraktivster Arbeitgeber Ungarns im Jahr 2025 (laut repräsentativer Umfrage von Randstad) ist Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions
eine Tochtergesellschaft der Deutsche Telekom Gruppe. Das Unternehmen bietet mit mehr als 5300 Mitarbeitern ein breites Portfolio an IT- und Telekommunikationsdienstleistungen. Wir haben Hunderte von Großkunden und Konzernen in Deutschland und anderen europäischen Ländern.

DT-ITS erhielt 2019 den Best in Educational Cooperation Award von HIPA
und wurde als ethischstes multinationales Unternehmen 2019
anerkannt. Das Unternehmen entwickelt kontinuierlich seine vier Standorte in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs und Szeged weiter und sucht qualifizierte IT-Fachkräfte, die Teil des Teams werden möchten.

jobs.title: Director - Digital Engineering
jobs.description:
The Director - Digital Engineering will provide technical leadership across Qiddiya's core digital product streams, ensuring that all platforms, services, and digital capabilities are designed and delivered to the highest engineering standards. The role is accountable for ensuring that digital products are built with a reusable, scalable, resilient, reliable, observable, and extensible architecture that can be leveraged across multiple Qiddiya assets. This includes setting the technical direction, challenging low-level engineering decisions, governing solution quality, and ensuring that all delivery outcomes meet the standards defined by Qiddiya Investment Company. The Director - Digital Engineering will work in a multi-vendor delivery environment and will play a critical role in ensuring that vendors, engineering teams, and embedded technical leaders are aligned to Qiddiya's technology strategy, architecture principles, and operating model.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership & Engineering Governance

Lead the technical oversight of Qiddiya's core digital product streams, ensuring that all solutions are designed and delivered in line with Qiddiya's target architecture, engineering standards, and long-term technology vision
Define and enforce engineering principles around reusability, scalability, resiliency, reliability, observability, maintainability, security, and performance across all digital products and platforms
Ensure that all technical decisions are properly reviewed, challenged, and validated by Qiddiya, with clear ownership and governance over architecture and engineering direction
Act as a senior technical authority capable of engaging at low-level design, architecture, code, integration, infrastructure, and operational decision-making levels
Challenge vendor proposals, solution designs, implementation approaches, and technical trade offs to ensure that Qiddiya retains control over critical engineering decisions

Product Architecture & Reusability

Ensure that digital products are built as reusable capabilities that can be extended and adopted across multiple Qiddiya assets, rather than being designed as isolated one-off implementations
Drive the creation of reusable patterns, components, services, APIs, integration approaches, and engineering guidelines that support product scalability across the Qiddiya ecosystem
Partner closely with architecture, product, delivery, DevSecOps, cloud, and security teams to ensure that product delivery aligns with the overall digital target state

Leadership of Staff Engineers

Lead and manage Staff Software Engineers who will be embedded within product streams and work closely with vendor teams
Set clear expectations for Staff Engineers around technical governance, architecture review, engineering excellence, code quality, observability, resiliency, and vendor challenge
Ensure that Staff Engineers are actively influencing product delivery, reviewing technical decisions, and protecting Qiddiya's long-term technology interests
Build a strong internal engineering capability that reduces dependency on vendors for critical technical decisions and strengthens Qiddiya's ownership of its digital platforms

Requirements

Significant experience in senior engineering leadership roles, ideally within large-scale digital platforms, e-commerce, entertainment, travel, hospitality, fintech, or other high-traffic consumer digital environments
Strong hands-on technical background with the ability to challenge detailed engineering, architecture, integration, infrastructure, and implementation decisions
Proven experience leading engineering teams in a complex multi-vendor or system integrator delivery model
Strong experience governing the delivery of reusable digital platforms, shared services, APIs, and scalable product architectures
Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, DevSecOps, cloud-native architecture, observability, resiliency, reliability engineering, and secure-by-design delivery
Experience working with executive stakeholders and translating technical risks, trade-offs, and recommendations into clear business and delivery decisions

jobs.title: MS Dynamics 365 Solution Architect
jobs.description:
The MS Dynamics 365 Solution Architect is responsible for defining, designing, and guiding the technical and
functional architecture for enterprise-wide Dynamics 365 solutions. This role requires a "hands-on" architectural
experince who translates complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and practical D365 designs. The
architect will actively lead real-world implementation cases, resolve complex technical blockers, and ensure the
ongoing performance, optimization, and maintenance of large-scale, high-volume D365 deployments across the
enterprise.
Key Focus Areas:
 Dynamics 365 Architecture & Solution Design
 Hands-on Implementation & Delivery
 Large-Scale System Maintenance & Optimization
 Integration & Power Platform Enablement
 Application Modernization & Upgrades
 Cross Domain Application Alignment
 Infrastructure, Security & Environment Strategy
 Drive Innovation
Job Description
Dynamics 365 Architecture & Solution Design
 Design end-to-end application architectures across the MS Dynamics 365 ecosystem (F&O, Commerce,
SCM, CE) and related enterprise platforms.
 Define application architecture standards, customization patterns (extension over over-layering), and best
practices for modular design, maintainability, scalability, and performance.
 Evaluate out-of-the-box (OOTB) capabilities versus custom development, identifying technical risks,
assessing cost versus benefit, and recommending fit-for-purpose architecture decisions.
 Create comprehensive Solution Blueprints that consider applications, data flows, integrations, infrastructure,
security, operations, and delivery constraints.

Hands-on Implementation & Delivery

 Actively participate in real-world implementation cases, rolling up sleeves to guide complex configurations,
custom extension designs (X++, C#), and advanced data migration strategies.
 Provide deep technical troubleshooting and hands-on guidance during delivery to resolve critical blockers
and ensure the implemented solution remains aligned with the approved design.
 Lead the technical design of complex customizations, ensuring engineering teams follow Microsoft best
practices for code quality and performance.
 Oversee and validate data migration strategies (DMF/DIXF) from legacy ERP/CRM systems into Dynamics
365.
Large-Scale System Maintenance & Optimization
 Architect and oversee the post-go-live maintenance of large-scale Dynamics 365 environments supporting
thousands of users and high-volume retail transactions.
 Proactively monitor system performance, identifying bottlenecks in database sizing, batch job scheduling,
API limits, and complex query execution.
 Guide the optimization of large-scale data sets, archiving strategies, and high-availability setups to ensure
continuous business operations across global outlets.
 Partner with Microsoft Support (FastTrack) and internal teams to resolve critical infrastructure, platform, or
product-level issues.
Integration & Power Platform Enablement
 Design robust integration architectures connecting D365 to enterprise systems, SaaS platforms, and legacy
applications using Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management) and Dataverse.
 Guide the practical adoption of the Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) to extend
D365 capabilities without heavy custom code.
 Ensure integration choices (OData, Custom Services, Dual-Write, Virtual Entities, Business Events) are
secure, scalable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
Application Modernization & Upgrades
 Manage the architecture strategy for continuous updates (Microsoft One Version), ensuring the enterprise is
prepared for platform updates with minimal business disruption.
 Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt by deprecating legacy customizations and replacing them with
newly released OOTB features or Power Platform solutions.
 Support legacy application assessment, rationalization, and modernization initiatives transitioning to the
Dynamics 365 cloud ecosystem.
Cross Domain Application Alignment & Security
 Work closely with enterprise, data, infrastructure, and security architects to ensure D365 solutions are aligned
across the broader technology landscape.
 Incorporate security by design principles, architecting robust Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Extensible
Data Security (XDS), and aligning with Azure Active Directory (Entra ID) for identity management.
 Ensure application designs properly address master data management (MDM) needs, reporting dependencies,
and operational dependencies.

Architecture Governance & Compliance Alignment
 Work with the Architecture Review Board and domain architects to ensure D365 solution designs follow
approved architecture standards and governance processes.
 Review application and technical designs for alignment with enterprise standards across integration, data,
infrastructure, security, and operational readiness.
 Track architecture decisions, exceptions, risks, and follow-up actions through appropriate governance
forums.
Leadership & Collaboration
 Serve as the ultimate Subject Matter Expert (SME) and technical advisor for MS Dynamics 365 initiatives.
 Mentor D365 developers, functional consultants, and engineering teams on architecture principles, security
best practices, and technology adoption.
 Lead architectural reviews, provide technical guidance, and resolve design conflicts between functional
requirements and technical constraints.
Documentation & Knowledge Management
 Create and maintain Solution Architecture Documents (SAD), Functional/Technical Design Documents
(FDD/TDD), system context diagrams, data flow diagrams, and architecture decision records.
 Document application design standards, technical patterns, operational guidelines, and support considerations
for the Dynamics 365 ecosystem.
 Conduct knowledge transfer sessions and capability building programs for engineering, product, delivery,
and technical teams.
Knowledge, Skills & Experience
Relevant Job
Experience Professional Experience

 10+ years of experience in application development, technical architecture, or
enterprise systems delivery.
 5+ years of dedicated experience as a Solution Architect or Lead Technical
Architect for MS Dynamics 365 (specifically F&O, SCM, Commerce, and/or CE).
 Proven hands-on experience leading real end-to-end D365 implementations (from
discovery and design through build, test, and go-live).
 Strong track record of maintaining and optimizing large-scale, high-volume D365
enterprise environments, including performance tuning and database management.
 Experience managing Microsoft Dynamics Lifecycle Services (LCS) and Power
Platform Admin Center (PPAC) for enterprise deployments.
 Practical experience with cloud platforms (Azure) including hosting, deployment
patterns, scalability, security, monitoring, and cost awareness.
 Experience working with integration teams on APIs, middleware, event-based flows,
data exchange, and system interaction patterns specific to D365.
 Retail, ecommerce, hospitality, or supply chain business systems experience
strongly preferred.
Technical Skills

 D365 Architecture: Deep understanding of D365 F&O/Commerce architecture,
extension frameworks, X++, C#, SSRS, data management framework (DMF), and
BYOD/Data Lake export.
 Hands-on Implementation: Environment planning, release management, code
merging strategies, data migration execution, and technical blocker resolution.
 Large-Scale Operations: Performance troubleshooting (Trace Parser, SQL insights,
Environment monitoring), batch job optimization, and high-availability
management.
 Integration Design: Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, Service Bus), OData,
Custom API Services, Business Events, Dual-Write, Virtual Entities, and REST
APIs.
 Power Platform & Dataverse: Practical understanding of extending D365 using
Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse integration.
 Security by Design: D365 Security Framework (Roles, Duties, Privileges),
Extensible Data Security (XDS), Azure AD/Entra ID SSO, and compliance
alignment.
 DevOps and Automation: Azure DevOps for D365, CI/CD pipelines, automated
testing (RSAT), release management, and environment strategy.
 Observability and Operations: Monitoring via LCS/Azure Monitor, logging,
alerting, incident readiness, production support, and operational handover.
 Architecture Documentation: Solution Blueprints, application diagrams, system
context diagrams, data flow diagrams, technical design documents, and architecture
decision records.

Required
Leadership Skills

 Strategic Thinking: Ability to translate business requirements into technical
architecture and long-term infrastructure strategy
 Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to articulate
complex technical concepts to diverse audiences
 Problem Solving: Analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot complex
infrastructure, platform, and application challenges
 Collaboration: Strong team player with experience working across organizational
boundaries and with external partners (including Microsoft FastTrack)
 Innovation: Forward-thinking approach to evaluating and adopting emerging D365
features and Power Platform capabilities

De functie

Eekels | TBI is voor de locatie Kolham op zoek naar een Software Engineer/Architect. Als Software Engineer/Architect ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp, de standaardisatie en automatisering van software architectuur en modules binnen onze ‘Configure to Order’ (CTO) productfilosofie. Je ontwikkelt modulaire en schaalbare softwareoplossingen die perfect aansluiten op onze elektrische modules. In deze functie zorg jij ervoor dat onze software architectuur en softwarestandaarden worden geoptimaliseerd en geborgd binnen het CTO-proces. Je werkt aan de ontwikkeling van gestandaardiseerde modulaire oplossingen, waardoor configuratie eenvoudiger wordt en onze klanten een flexibel productaanbod krijgen. In deze functie werk je nauw samen met de Product Manager, productie en andere disciplines van het ontwikkelteam om technische haalbaarheid en efficiënt produceren op elkaar af te stemmen. Je assisteert af en toe op de productielocatie om ontwerpen te bespreken en implementaties te begeleiden. In jouw rol rapporteer je direct aan de Product Manager.

Wat wordt er van jou verwacht?

Ontwikkelen en beheren van modulaire software architectuur en ontwerpen die passen binnen de CTO-filosofie;
Afstemmen van softwarecomponenten met elektrotechnische engineers voor een geïntegreerd en configureerbaar productportfolio;
Definiëren en documenteren van standaard software modules om productconfiguratie, producttestbaarheid en productie-efficiëntie te verbeteren;
Definiëren en realiseren van automatische softwareparametrisatie op basis van de klantspecifieke functionaliteit en de geleverde configuratie;
Uitvoeren van productontwikkelingstrajecten, waarbij je softwareontwerpen borgt binnen de productlevenscyclus;
Ondersteunen van de productie (productiefaciliteit Galati, Roemenië) bij de implementatie van nieuwe softwarestandaarden en verbeteringen in het product;
Het ontwikkelen van software t.b.v. geautomatiseerd testen van product modules tijdens productie;
Borgen van informatie en ontwerpen in Plastic SCM en andere version control methodieken om productbeheer en samenwerking binnen het team te optimaliseren.

Werkomgeving

De business unit Products, gevestigd in Kolham, opereert onder de merknaam Corvia. Corvia is het nieuwe merk van Eekels Technology. Wij zetten ons in voor slimmere en duurzame voortstuwingsoplossingen voor de maritieme sector. Met onze belangrijkste innovatie, het Modular Propulsion Platform (MPP), bieden we scheepseigenaren een flexibel, toekomstbestendig systeem dat de transitie naar emissievrije scheepvaart ondersteunt.

Ervaring

Herken je jezelf in dit profiel?

Aantoonbaar hbo werk- en denkniveau en opleiding op het gebied van Technische informatica of Elektrotechniek;
Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in softwareontwerp, productontwikkeling en/of CTO-omgevingen;
Kennis van en ervaring met C#, .NET, CODESYS en industriële netwerken;
Ervaring in de maritieme sector is een pré;
Affiniteit met technische producten, industrieel ontwerp, standaardisatie en automatisering van softwareontwerp;
Communicatief vaardig, werkt gemakkelijk samen en neemt binnen het team de rol van technisch kartrekker op zich;
Proactieve werkwijze en een goed analytisch vermogen;
Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.

Wat wij bieden

Bij Eekels Technology bieden we een breed scala aan aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Cao: de cao Technisch Installatiebedrijf is op jou van toepassing.
Aantrekkelijk salaris: passend bij jouw functie, kennis en ervaring.
Een ruim aantal vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen en 13 adv-dagen op fulltime basis (afhankelijk van jouw leeftijd wordt dit aangevuld met extra seniorendagen).
Aantrekkelijke vergoedingen en regelingen: waaronder een bovengemiddelde reis- en overurenvergoeding en thuiswerkregeling.
Winstdelingsregeling: deel mee in het succes van ons bedrijf en ook onze winst!
Collectieve pensioenregeling: via het “Pensioenfonds Metaal en Techniek”.
Stimuleren van jouw gezondheid: door onze jaarlijkse (sport)activiteitenkalender.
Fiscale voordelen: voor de aanschaf van een fiets of een fitnessabonnement.
Jouw vakmanschap: door onze leercultuur blijf jij scherp binnen jouw vakgebied en verbreed jij jouw kennis.
Actieve personeelsvereniging: het hele jaar door diverse georganiseerde (sport) activiteiten met collega’s (meestal ook voor jouw eventuele partner of kind(eren)!).
Plezierige werkomgeving: met een goede werksfeer en collega’s waar je blij van wordt.
Interessante projecten: werken aan prestigieuze, technische projecten en producten met een duurzame impact, waar je trots op kunt zijn.
Personeelskortingen: met flinke kortingen op mode, elektronica, wonen, dagjes uit, verzekeringen en meer.
Persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling: alle ruimte om te groeien en verder te komen.
Bedrijfsmiddelen: goed gereedschap en (digitale) middelen zijn het halve werk. Wij zorgen voor de middelen om jou jouw functie goed uit te kunnen laten voeren.
TBI Holdings: achter onze organisatie staat een financieel sterke moedermaatschappij met daaronder een 20-tal dochtermaatschappijen.

Interesse?

Klinkt dit als jouw ideale uitdaging? Solliciteer dan nu en ontdek wat Eekels voor jou kan betekenen!

Maatschappelijke impact

Werken bij een TBI-onderneming betekent werken bij een onderneming met een grote maatschappelijke betrokkenheid. Die maatschappelijke betrokkenheid blijkt onder andere uit de TBI Klimaattrein, TBI Praktijkfonds en het TBI Studiefonds . Met het TBI Studiefonds komen jouw kinderen mogelijk in aanmerking voor een studietoelage van TBI Studiefonds (vanaf de middelbare school). Lees hier meer over onze maatschappelijke fondsen .

Vacancy

Automation Engineer (Fluent Dutch speakers only)

At ParaSoll , you don’t automate for a client you’ll never meet. Everything you build is used in education and makes a direct difference for teachers, IT teams, and students. We’re looking for an Automation Engineer with experience in Azure who enjoys working on a mix of client projects and in-house product development, alongside students.

Apply directly

This job opening is intended for candidates who speak Dutch fluently and live and work in the Netherlands. We will not respond to applications from outside the Netherlands.

Build something that a school will actually use next week

In most automation jobs, you automate processes for a client you never meet. At ParaSoll , it’s different. We work exclusively for the education sector. The scripts, pipelines, and cloud solutions you build are used by schools and universities and make a direct difference for teachers, IT teams, and students. A digital exam system that works flawlessly when 800 students log in—that’s your work.

The function

To strengthen our Azure team, we are looking for an Automation Engineer. You will work on a mix of external projects and internal product development.

For clients—typically IT teams at educational institutions—you’ll automate the setup and management of Azure environments. This includes infrastructure as code, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and eliminating manual tasks that nobody really wants to do anymore. You’ll provide advice, write designs, and handle the technical implementation.

In addition, we develop our own products in collaboration with a school consortium. Students come to work with us in groups on a final project that results in a real product. One example is an AI bot trained to handle security incidents, which students in the security program use to practice de-escalation techniques. Each period is a sprint in which the product advances to the next level. You’ll be the technical linchpin in this process: you’ll ensure quality, contribute to the development, and help students get their ideas up and running.

Who are you?

You’re passionate about automation and the cloud. You see repetitive work as a problem that can be solved with code. You have experience with Azure and tools such as PowerShell, Bicep, or Terraform, as well as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. Experience with AI tools in your work is a plus, but not a requirement. Curiosity and the willingness to quickly learn those tools, however, are essential.

You’re good with young people who don’t have much business experience yet. You explain things without being condescending, adapt your language and leadership style, and at the same time keep the ultimate goal in mind: an educational, enjoyable internship and a successful product iteration.

Technology holds no secrets for you, and you stay up to date on what's happening in your field.

Your Career Path

We assume that you're still relatively early in your career. You've proven yourself in the business world, but there's still plenty to learn.

At ParaSoll , you get to decide what your career path looks like. Together, we’ll explore your long-term ambitions and the steps needed to achieve them. Do you want to broaden your skills, deepen your expertise, or take on a coordinating or advisory role? Common career paths include Azure automation specialist, architect, project manager, or department manager. We’ll work together to determine the balance between technical work and other aspects of the role.

Our guiding principle: Your responsibility and sense of ownership determine your success. You’ll have a great deal of freedom, and much is possible through mutual discussion. You take charge of your work, your development, and your opportunities.

new_jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Functieomschrijving

Functieomschrijving

Word jij blij van een stabiel cloudplatform, slimme automatiseringen én techniek die gewoon goed in elkaar zit?

Als Cloud Engineer bij Veneta bouw je mee aan een veilige, schaalbare en toekomstbestendige Azure-omgeving. Je zorgt niet alleen dat onze cloud goed blijft draaien, maar vooral dat we deze steeds slimmer kunnen beheren en verder ontwikkelen.

Je automatiseert infrastructuur, richt monitoring in, verbetert security en helpt nieuwe oplossingen veilig naar productie. Van een deployment pipeline tot een nieuwe Azure-service of AI-oplossing: jij zorgt dat het fundament klopt.

De uitdaging 🚀

Samen met twee collega’s vorm je het Platform & Engineering-team. Jullie zijn verantwoordelijk voor het cloudfundament waarop Veneta iedere dag bouwt. Dat betekent dat je werkt aan beschikbaarheid, performance, security en schaalbaarheid, maar ook aan de manier waarop we onze infrastructuur ontwikkelen en beheren.

Ons cloudplatform ondersteunt de digitale diensten en koppelingen waarop Veneta dagelijks draait. Van de online klantreis en onze data tot de processen achter verkoop en dienstverlening: een betrouwbaar en goed ingericht platform is onmisbaar om onze collega’s en klanten snel te kunnen blijven helpen.

Je kijkt verder dan dagelijks beheer. Handmatige handelingen wil je automatiseren, terugkerende incidenten los je structureel op en nieuwe cloudresources rol je zoveel mogelijk uit via Infrastructure as Code.

Ook denk je mee over de architectuur van nieuwe oplossingen. Welke Azure-services passen het beste? Hoe regelen we identity, networking, logging en security? En hoe zorgen we dat een oplossing straks betrouwbaar, beheersbaar én betaalbaar blijft?

De roadmap ligt niet volledig vast. Dat betekent dat je veel ruimte krijgt om samen met het team te bepalen welke technische verbeteringen de meeste waarde opleveren. Zie jij dat iets slimmer, veiliger of sneller kan? Dan maak je een plan en ga je ermee aan de slag.

Wat je gaat doen 💻

Je bouwt, beheert en optimaliseert onze Microsoft Azure-omgeving.
Je ontwikkelt en beheert cloudinfrastructuur met Bicep en Terraform.
Je bouwt en onderhoudt CI/CD-pipelines in Azure DevOps en GitHub.
Je automatiseert beheertaken en deployments met bijvoorbeeld PowerShell, Azure CLI of Python.
Je richt monitoring, logging en alerting in en vertaalt signalen naar structurele verbeteringen.
Je werkt aan Azure-netwerken, identity, toegangsbeheer, secrets en veilige verbindingen tussen systemen.
Je implementeert securitymaatregelen met onder andere Azure Policy, RBAC, Microsoft Defender for Cloud en Key Vault.
Je zorgt dat back-up, herstel en continuïteit goed zijn ingericht en regelmatig worden getest.
Je onderzoekt incidenten tot de kern en zorgt ervoor dat problemen niet onnodig terugkomen.
Je draait samen met je collega’s volgens een afgesproken rooster mee in de storingsdienst.
Je bewaakt het gebruik en de kosten van Azure en zoekt naar mogelijkheden om resources slimmer in te zetten.
Je adviseert development-, data- en business-teams over het veilig en betrouwbaar gebruiken van cloudservices.
Je helpt nieuwe applicaties en oplossingen van ontwerp en proof of concept tot een stabiele productieomgeving.
Je onderzoekt nieuwe technologieën, waaronder AI-platformen en Large Language Models, en kijkt hoe we deze veilig en schaalbaar kunnen inzetten.
Je documenteert architectuurkeuzes, technische standaarden en beheerprocessen, zodat kennis niet alleen in hoofden blijft zitten.

Wat je krijgt 💰

Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4.000 en € 6.500, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring.
Een fulltime dienstverband van 40 uur per week.
Een werkplek op ons kantoor in Zwolle, waar we als team graag samenwerken, met de mogelijkheid om maximaal twee dagen per week vanuit huis te werken.
Een uitgebreide onboarding waarin je Veneta én je collega’s goed leert kennen.
Veel ruimte om de technische richting van onze cloudomgeving mede te bepalen.
Volop mogelijkheden om certificeringen te behalen in Azure, cloud architecture, AI en security.
Tijd en ruimte om nieuwe technologieën te onderzoeken en proof of concepts uit te werken.
Een goede pensioenregeling met een eigen bijdrage van 6%. Veneta legt 17% in.
25 vakantiedagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband.
Reiskostenvergoeding. Of je nu met de fiets of de auto komt: altijd kassa.
Bedrijfsfitness met korting op je sportabonnement.

Jouw talent 🎯

Je hoeft nog niet ieder onderdeel van onze omgeving volledig te beheersen. We vinden het belangrijker dat je een goede basis hebt, graag automatiseert en jezelf verder wilt ontwikkelen in platform engineering, cloudsecurity en Azure.

Je hebt ervaring als Cloud Engineer, Azure Engineer, Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer of in een vergelijkbare technische functie.
Je hebt hands-on ervaring met Microsoft Azure en begrijpt hoe onderdelen zoals compute, storage, networking, identity en monitoring met elkaar samenwerken.
Je hebt ervaring met Infrastructure as Code, bijvoorbeeld met Bicep, Terraform of vergelijkbare tooling, en vindt het leuk om met beide te werken.
Je hebt ervaring met CI/CD en Git en begrijpt hoe je infrastructuur en configuraties gecontroleerd naar productie brengt.
Je automatiseert graag en kunt overweg met PowerShell, Azure CLI, Python of een vergelijkbare taal.
Je hebt een goede basis in cloudnetwerken, security en monitoring.
Je pakt technisch eigenaarschap, zoekt problemen graag tot de kern uit en kunt jouw keuzes duidelijk uitleggen aan anderen.

Mooi meegenomen 🙌

Ervaring met containers, Kubernetes of Azure PaaS-diensten.
Ervaring met FinOps, kostenoptimalisatie of capacity management.
Ervaring met platformen voor data, integraties of AI.
Certificeringen zoals AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-400 of vergelijkbaar.

Heb je nog niet overal ervaring mee, maar herken je jezelf wel in de functie? Ook dan nodigen we je graag uit om te reageren.

Zie jij jezelf al bouwen aan het cloudfundament van Veneta? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Solliciteer direct en laat zien waarom jij onze nieuwe Cloud Engineer bent.

Enthousiast? Solliciteer!

Zie jij jezelf al bouwen aan een veilig, schaalbaar en slim cloudplatform voor Veneta? Solliciteer dan snel en ontdek zelf waarom werken bij Veneta zo leuk is.

Liever eerst wat meer weten? App met onze recruiter Niels via 06 5429 5664 of mail naar niels.hoolwerf@veneta.com .

Acquisitie? Liever niet.

Bij Veneta doen we graag zoveel mogelijk zelf, ook als het om recruitment gaat. We stellen acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature dan ook niet op prijs.

**Job Title:** Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer
**Location:** Amsterdam or Munich
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**About the company:**
Our client is a global digital distributor of electronic components, transforming how modern businesses bring products to market.

**Job Summary:**
We are seeking a Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer to build and support the delivery platform, release process, environments, automation, monitoring, and operational tooling used by engineering teams. This hands-on technical role will help engineering teams deliver software more reliably, reduce production risk, minimize manual deployment work, and resolve environment-related blockers.

**Responsibilities:**
* Design, build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines for internal applications and business-critical systems.
* Support release automation and deployment processes across development, QA, UAT, staging, and production environments.
* Improve environment consistency, configuration management, deployment repeatability, and rollback readiness.
* Work with software engineers, QA, DBAs, infrastructure, and security teams to make releases safer and more predictable.
* Support Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, boards, release processes, work tracking, and related engineering tooling where applicable.
* Help define and enforce practical release readiness expectations, including build quality, test execution, deployment validation, database migration coordination, monitoring readiness, and rollback planning.
* Build and maintain automation scripts, operational tools, deployment utilities, and self-service capabilities that reduce manual work and operational errors.
* Support monitoring, logging, metrics, alerting, and observability for applications, services, jobs, pipelines, environments, and production dependencies.
* Participate in L2 / L3 triage for build failures, deployment issues, environment problems, performance symptoms, and production incidents.
* Contribute to root cause analysis after release, deployment, platform, or environment-related incidents and help define practical remediation actions.
* Identify fragile deployment steps, undocumented dependencies, manual processes, configuration drift, and environment-related single points of failure.
* Partner with DBA / Data Platform teams to coordinate database scripts, migration validation, backup / recovery considerations, and data-related deployment risks.
* Partner with Infrastructure & Security teams on servers, network dependencies, identity, access, certificates, secrets, vulnerability remediation, and platform security controls.
* Improve developer experience by reducing build times, deployment friction, environment blockers, and unclear release processes.
* Create and maintain practical documentation, runbooks, deployment instructions, troubleshooting guides, and operational procedures.
* Ensure DevOps / platform work is tracked, communicated, and prioritized through agreed tools and processes, including Azure DevOps where applicable.

**Required Qualifications (Must-Haves):**
* 5+ years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, release engineering, site reliability engineering, systems engineering, or similar hands-on roles.
* Strong hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation for production software systems.
* Practical experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar CI/CD and engineering workflow tools.
* Experience supporting multiple application environments such as development, QA, UAT, staging, and production.
* Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar tools.
* Experience with release management, deployment validation, rollback planning, environment troubleshooting, and production support.
* Understanding of application hosting concepts, web servers, APIs, background jobs, scheduled tasks, configuration management, certificates, secrets, and service dependencies.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational visibility tools.
* Ability to work with software engineers, QA, DBAs, infrastructure engineers, security teams, Product / Delivery Managers, and business stakeholders.
* Ability to diagnose build failures, deployment failures, environment issues, configuration problems, access problems, and production symptoms in a structured way.
* Understanding of security practices in software delivery, including least privilege, secrets management, access control, vulnerability remediation, and auditability.
* Practical experience with Git-based workflows, branching strategies, pull requests, release tagging, and deployment traceability.
* Clear communication skills with ability to explain platform risks, release blockers, deployment issues, and operational tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* High ownership mindset, good judgment, and ability to make practical decisions under pressure.

**Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Haves):**
* Experience with Microsoft-based enterprise environments, including Windows Server, IIS, .NET applications, SQL Server-backed systems, Active Directory, and service accounts.
* Hands-on background with Azure cloud services, Azure DevOps, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, or Microsoft-oriented delivery tooling.
* Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, Pulumi, Ansible, or similar tools.
* Practical knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, container registries, Helm, or container-based deployment models where they are practical for the environment.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP beyond the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Working knowledge of observability tools such as Zabbix, Grafana, Prometheus, ELK / OpenSearch, Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, Azure Monitor, or similar tools.
* Background working with artifact repositories, package management, dependency scanning, static analysis, and software supply chain controls.
* Understanding of DevSecOps practices, security scanning, vulnerability management, policy-as-code, or pipeline-integrated security controls.
* Prior work supporting ERP, warehouse, internal business platforms, B2B transaction systems, e-commerce, supply chain, logistics, or similar business-critical environments.
* Track record of improving DevOps maturity in an organization where process, ownership, and documentation are still developing.
* Familiarity with cost optimization, license awareness, and practical platform efficiency improvements.

indiwa ist ein kleines Team von derzeit 16 Personen, flachen Hierarchien und einem tollen Team-Zusammenhalt. indiwa gibt es jetzt seit 2001. Schreibst Du in der Zukunft unsere Erfolgsgeschichte mit?

Wir suchen einen oder eine Softwareentwickler(-in)
(m/w/d) für spannende, webbasierte Software-Projekte im Bereich der Transportlogistik. Du verfügst über sehr gute C#
-Kenntnisse und bist im .NET
Bereich und im Blazor-
und **Web-**Umfeld zu Haus und hast Lust auf Neuentwicklung
und ganz viel Gestaltungsspielraum
? Dann ist das hier vielleicht die neue Herausforderung
für Dich:

Als Software-Entwickler bei indiwa arbeitest Du mit uns zusammen an der Transportmanagementsoftware der Zukunft. Dein Job wird es sein ein völlig neues, modernes Produkt aktiv mitzugestalten. Du erarbeitest mit uns zusammen den Baukasten, um Deinen Kollegen mit langjähriger Erfahrung im Bereich Logistiksoftware eine schnelle und effiziente Entwicklung neuer Features zu ermöglichen. Du bist Teil unseres Framework- und F&E-Teams in der Entwicklungsabteilung.

Aufgaben

Du bist Teil eines kompetenten Entwickler-Teams, welches an dem Ausbau und der Modernisierung unserer Logistiksoftware arbeitet.

Du arbeitest an unserem Bremer Standort und gerne anteilig auch mobil.

Du bist in der Neuentwicklung spannender Teilprodukte für unser Transportmanagementsystem Contado tätig und hast die Möglichkeit, diese aktiv mitzugestalten.

Du arbeitest aktiv an Konzeption und Architektur unserer Software-Lösungen mit.

Du berätst unsere Product Owner und Business Consultants dabei, wie sie unsere Produkte unter technischen Aspekten bestmöglich weiterentwickeln und beim Kunden in den Einsatz bringen können.

Du hast gelegentlichen Kundenkontakt bei der Etablierung neuer Teilprodukte oder sehr technischer Projekte.

Ganz wichtig: Du hast Spaß an der Arbeit und lernst jeden Tag gerne etwas hinzu.

Heute setzen wir noch viel .NET Framework ein und unsere Oberflächen sind als ASP oder ASP.Net-Lösung mit Bootstrap und jQuery realisiert. Für unsere neuen Teilprodukte arbeiten wir auf .NET 10 Basis mit Blazor an einer webbasierte B2B-Anwendung zur Abbildung von logistischen Prozessen mit hohem Automatisierungs- und Schnittstellenanteil.

Qualifikation
Must haves:

Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine Berufsausbildung im Informatik-Bereich oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung

Du hast ein paar Jahre Berufserfahrung Erfahrung als Full Stack Entwickler in der Software-Entwicklung mit C# / .NET >= 8 und hast schon unter Verwendung von C# und Blazor Software-Projekte realisiert.

Du verfügst über praktische Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Postgres

Für Dich sind Begrifflichkeiten wie Clean Code und Unit-Tests nicht nur Wikipedia-Artikel.

Dich zeichnet eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität, Prozessverständnis und eine lösungsorientierte sowie strukturierte Arbeitsweise aus.

Du hast Lust auf die Herausforderungen in der Software-Neuentwicklung und scheust Dich auch nicht, eine der treibenden Kräfte in Grüne-Wiese-Projekten zu sein.

Du bist nicht nur passionierter Software-Entwickler, sondern Du redest auch gerne darüber. Als Ausbildungsbetrieb ist uns bei indiwa die Vermittlung von Wissen im Team wichtig. Du passt zu uns, wenn Du gerne Dein Wissen teilst.

Siemens Healthineers is a globally leading medical technology company dedicated to shaping the future of healthcare. With a rich history rooted in innovation and a commitment to improving patient outcomes, Siemens Healthineers offers a wide range of diagnostic and therapeutic solutions, including imaging, laboratory diagnostics, molecular medicine, and digital health services. Employing over 74,000 professionals across more than 70 countries, the company is at the forefront of technological advancements in healthcare, delivering innovative products and services that benefit millions of patients worldwide. Siemens Healthineers fosters a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and diversity, striving to create a better healthcare environment through technological excellence and customer-centric solutions.

About The Role

We are seeking a dedicated and skilled Software Developer (w/m/d) specializing in Identity & Access Management to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be pivotal in designing, developing, and maintaining secure access solutions for our digital healthcare products. Your expertise will contribute to enhancing the security and usability of our systems, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including product owners, software architects, and international development groups, to implement innovative authentication and authorization mechanisms. This position offers flexibility regarding remote work, including the possibility of mobile working within Germany and abroad under certain conditions, supporting a balanced work-life integration.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, complemented by several years of professional experience in Authentication & Authorization. Proficiency in software development using C# and the .NET framework is essential, along with practical knowledge of Identity & Access Management concepts such as OAuth2, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and JWT. Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized microservice architectures is highly desirable. Familiarity with cloud-native development, deployment, and operation across cloud, on-premise, and edge environments is required. Candidates should also have experience with CI/CD tools like Azure DevOps or GitLab. Additional skills in Microsoft Entra ID, cybersecurity, or Zero-Trust architectures are advantageous. Prior experience in regulated environments, especially within healthcare, will be considered a plus.

Responsibilities

Support the development and enhancement of modern authentication and authorization solutions for digital healthcare products.
Implement and integrate identity and access management systems based on established standards such as OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and JWT.
Contribute to the creation of high-performance, maintainable backend components in C#/.NET tailored for distributed microservice architectures.
Participate in the deployment and operation of software solutions across cloud, on-premise, and edge environments, ensuring reliability and security.
Assist in optimizing Kubernetes-based deployments and managing containerized applications.
Collaborate closely with product owners, software architects, and international development teams to align technical solutions with business needs.
Drive automation initiatives, continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD), as well as testing and release processes, to improve efficiency and quality.
Bring in your technical expertise to continuously improve development workflows and contribute to innovative project solutions.

Benefits

Employees enjoy access to ongoing training and development programs, fostering continuous learning and growth. The company promotes a healthy work-life balance through flexible hours and remote working options. Additionally, Siemens Healthineers provides comprehensive health and wellness programs, employee discounts, and a collaborative corporate culture that values diversity and inclusion. Being part of a global organization also offers international exposure and career advancement opportunities, allowing employees to grow within a forward-thinking and innovative environment.

Equal Opportunity

Siemens Healthineers is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diversity and equal opportunity. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including those with disabilities, and ensure fair treatment throughout our hiring processes. Our company believes that diverse teams drive innovation and better serve our global customer base. We adhere strictly to equal employment opportunity policies and provide a work environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to our shared success.

new_jobs.title: Cloud & Security Architect (w/m/d)
new_jobs.description:
Jenoptik is an international photonics group with representatives in over 80 countries. Optical technologies are the foundation of our business. We employ around 4,000 people worldwide.

Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Cloud & Security Architect
to join our team and lead the architecture, resilience, and security posture of our enterprise application platform. In this role, you will bridge the gap between Azure Cloud Architecture
, Security Engineering
, and Modern Application Development
.Our application suite is built with C# and .NET
and is deployed across a hybrid environment spanning Microsoft Azure
, On-Premises infrastructure
, and Docker / Kubernetes (K8s)
. Because our application is exposed directly to the public internet, ensuring robust security - ranging from edge defense and zero-trust networking to secure coding practices and container hardening - is at the core of this role.

Responsibilities:

DevSecOps Culture & Mentorship:

Drive and cultivate a security-first and DevOps-oriented culture across software engineering and infrastructure teams
Lead hands-on workshops, establish security excellence programs, and mentor developers on secure coding and automated operational practices

Public Internet Security & Perimeter Defense:

Design and enforce edge protection strategies (Azure Front Door, WAF, Application Gateway, DDoS Protection) for all internet-facing APIs and services
Enforce Zero-Trust Network Architecture, strict IP/GEO filtering, rate-limiting, and modern API security protocols (OAuth2, OIDC, mTLS)

DevOps & CI/CD Security Governance:

Architect, standardize, and help maintain secure CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)Own automated Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployment workflows
Embed continuous security gates (SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, secret detection) into the build and release lifecycle

Azure & Hybrid Cloud Architecture:

Architect and maintain cloud infrastructure in Azure aligned with cloud security best practices and the Microsoft Well-Architected Framework
Design secure hybrid connectivity between Azure, on-premises data centers, and containerized environments using Azure Arc, ExpressRoute, and VPN gateways

Container & Kubernetes Security:

Define and enforce security controls across containerized workloads (Docker, AKS, and On-Prem Kubernetes)
Implement pod security standards, network policies (Calico/Cilium), image scanning, and container runtime threat detection

Security Operations & Governance Execution:

Coordinate and execute recurring security governance best practices, including regular user access reviews (IAM/PIM audits), cloud application security assessments, penetration testing, and automated policy compliance across all hybrid environments

Technical Requirements Ownership & Documentation:

Take ownership of translating technologically-heavy business and product goals into detailed technical requirement specifications, system design docs, and architectural decision records (ADRs)
Collaborate closely with Product Owners and Developers to define, document, and manage technical user stories and acceptance criteria

Qualifications & Requirements:

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, or a related field required (as the baseline requirement)
Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or Information Technology strongly recommended

Work Experience:
7+ years of experience in Cloud Architecture, Cybersecurity, and/or DevSecOps roles

Execution & Drive:
Self-motivated, hands-on practitioner with a "doer" mentality, taking strong personal ownership and pride in the quality, security, and elegance of technical deliverables

Technical Leadership:
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and inspire engineering teams to continuously raise the bar and strive for excellence

Public Internet Exposure:
Hands-on experience defending public-facing, internet-exposed applications against threats (e.g., volumetric DDoS, credential stuffing, API abuse, SQLi)

Azure Technical Stack:
Strong practical knowledge of Microsoft Azure services and security tools (Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault, Azure Policy, Network Security Groups, Private Endpoints)

DevOps Architecture & Infrastructure as Code (IaC):
Experience in driving automated infrastructure provisioning, continuous deployment, and telemetry across hybrid Azure, on-premises, and Kubernetes environments, ensuring zero-downtime deployments, high availability, and operational resilience

Software & Distributed Architecture Expertise:
Strong background in software architecture with proven experience designing and securing microservices architectures. Solid understanding of distributed systems, event-driven messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus), data persistence patterns, and API gateway integrations

Certifications (Associate & Expert level welcome)

Microsoft Azure Associate Certifications (Preferred/Targeted): Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500), Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204), Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700)
Expert / Industry Certifications (A plus): Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100), Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS) or CISSP

A position that enables you to have an impact on 1'000s of people, and the whole company's growth

Description

Xe is a cross-border payments platform. We help SMEs and consumers in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand collect, convert, hold, and send money across markets. Each year, over 300 million people use Xe for currency information and over 350,000 use us to send money overseas.

Today, we're rebuilding the platform layer behind cross-border payments for corporate and consumer clients. We're small enough that your code ships fast and your decisions matter, and Euronet Worldwide (Nasdaq: EEFT) backs us so the problems stay real-scale.

About This Role

We're hiring a senior back-end engineer who owns real problems end-to-end and shapes how the team builds, from API design and data modeling through to service implementation, production reliability, and launch. You already use AI as part of how you think, build, test, and ship.

You'll write code that moves money in production, design and modernize the backend services the platform runs on, and lead delivery of new capability as Xe rebuilds its platform layer. You'll work in a small team with direct access to product, compliance, and operations, own architecture in your domain, lead design reviews, mentor mid-level engineers, and partner with architects and team leads on cross-domain decisions.

Design and own backend services that move money and manage multi-currency balances across a range of domains, including onboarding, KYC and KYB, payment initiation, FX, settlement, and other supporting services.

Lead the build of the partner integrations and settlement infrastructure your domain depends on.
Own production health for your domain, including reliability, observability, on-call, and incident response.
Lead design reviews, set technical direction for your domain, and mentor mid-level engineers.
Use agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) daily across the SDLC, and lead modernization from legacy services into the modern stack alongside architects and team leads in your domain.

What We're Looking For

Must-have

6 to 10+ years building production backend services, end-to-end.
Strong backend proficiency in C# / .NET preferred; other OOP languages welcome (Java, Kotlin, Go, or equivalent).
SQL and relational database fundamentals.
Writing and maintaining tests.
Daily use of agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) across the SDLC.
Production experience with AWS, including hands-on deployment, CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices, and native services such as SQS, DynamoDB, S3, ECS, and Lambda.
Strong system design and architecture experience, including service-oriented or microservices and event-driven patterns.
Payments, FX, or regulated-industry experience.
Track record of technical leadership: mentoring engineers, leading design reviews, and making architecture decisions in your domain.
Strong written and verbal communication.

Nice-to-have

Experience with ledgers, double-entry accounting, or other financial-data systems.
Experience hiring, interviewing, or onboarding engineers.
Experience leading modernization or platform migrations.
Experience with caching solutions like Memcached or Redis.
Experience using project management and documentation tools like Jira and Confluence.
Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman or Bruno.
Writing automated tests alongside development with AI tools (Claude Code or equivalent).

Senior Software Engineer – (Full Stack)

Manchester/Hybrid

Slalom is a global, human-centric business and technology consulting firm. We specialise in partnering with organisations that aspire to excellence, helping them tackle complex challenges and achieve transformative results through strategy, technology and business transformation services. By prioritising people, Slalom creates a unique consulting experience, with a team of strategists and engineers delivering practical, end-to-end solutions that drive impactful outcomes for our clients. We empower people and organisations to dream bigger, move faster and build better tomorrows for all.
Our Software Engineering team builds the core applications and services that power our products and deliver value to users around the world. We focus on creating scalable, secure, and high-performance systems that enable rapid innovation and seamless user experiences. By leveraging modern engineering practices and cloud-native technologies, we aim to reduce complexity, accelerate delivery, and continuously improve our platforms.
We’re excited to welcome a Senior Software Engineer to join our Manchester team to help drive forward our mission of building world-class software.
Life as a Senior Engineer

A Senior Engineer plays a fundamental role in shaping and delivering amazing software solutions to client challenges during discovery and delivery. You will partner with teams to understand the challenges they are facing as well as develop implementation and delivery plans that take advantage of emerging technologies at scale. During client delivery you will collaborate with Platform Engineers, Quality Engineers and AI Consultants to ensure that world class user experiences are understood, validation procedures are aligned and automation components are delivered.
Within our capability you'll be seeking to develop and grow your skills whilst advocating for progression of our capability on exciting frontiers such as Machine Learning and Generative AI.
Specifically, you will:

Design, develop and maintain robust backend services and APIs using EITHER C#/.NET, Python or Java, applying clean code principles, design patterns, and modern software engineering practices.
Build modern, responsive and accessible frontend applications using EITHER React or TypeScript, focusing on exceptional user experiences and performance.
Build quality, reliable and performant applications, with a strong focus on maintainability, security and scalability.

Developed and maintained AI assisted development practices, utilising tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and other coding assistants to accelerate software delivery while maintaining code quality standards.

Implement containerisation using Docker and support scalable deployments using orchestration tools where appropriate.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable efficient, automated and reliable software delivery.
Foster a culture of inclusion and engineering excellence while promoting well-being, diversity and collaboration across the organisation.

What You'll Bring

Experience developing production applications using EITHER C#/.NET, Python or Java.
Commercial experience building modern web applications using EITHER React or TypeScript.
Experience designing and developing scalable APIs, microservices and distributed systems.

Integrated generative AI solutions into existing applications, leveraging APIs and prompt engineering techniques to deliver intelligent, context-aware functionality.

Hands-on experience working with cloud platforms (e.g. Azure or AWS), including deployment and infrastructure concepts.
An understanding of DevOps practices, including CI/CD, containerisation, observability and testing.
A collaborative mindset, passionate about sharing knowledge and driving engineering best practices.

But what do we really mean when we talk about loving your life and your work? Let’s look at the ways in which we help our team members to achieve this – and the ‘how’.
Deep connections, better outcome 

We have deep relationships with leading technology partners and they love us for our innovative and outcome based approach. Our people are passionate about solving our clients problems using the tech that’s the best solution for them. What’s more, we’re there to work side-by-side with our client teams to enable them for success long after we’ve gone. We’re all about momentum that outlasts us.
Flexibility 

Life is busy, and we understand that. Our team often juggles work, family, personal commitments, and crucial client obligations. We prioritise supporting our people in balancing what matters to them while ensuring we meet our client commitments. Flexibility is key, as we sometimes need to adapt to meet client needs. This way, our team can work on high-impact projects they’ll love, knowing they have the flexibility to manage their personal and professional lives effectively.
People-first 

Great solutions start with great people and those great people are at their best when they’re empowered to be their true authentic selves through leading with kindness, empathy and striving for equity we’re able to create better experiences for our people and our clients. Our culture is central to everything we do - encouraging passion, adventure, adaptiveness and diversity of thought. Inclusion, diversity and equity is at the top of our agenda, we have created a community where we empower our team to be the best version of themselves.
Rewards 

There’s no shying away from it - the compensation and benefits on offer have to be competitive too, right? We know that. That’s why we have a dedicated team working with our leaders to ensure our packages are fair, competitive, and rewarding!
Who are we... We are Slalom!

Slalom is a next-generation professional services company creating value at the intersection of business, technology, and humanity. With our fiercely human approach, we deeply understand our customers—and their customers—to deliver practical, end-to-end solutions that drive meaningful impact. Supported by over 400 technology partners, our 10,000+ team members in 12 countries and 52 offices we Inspire people and organisations to envision greater possibilities, accelerate progress, and shape a brighter future for everyone.
We’re honoured to be consistently recognised as a great place to work, including being one of Fortune’s 100 Best Companies to Work for nine years running. Read about us at slalom.com. 
Want to learn more? 

Why not apply??

The Team

You will be joining our Data & AI team during an exciting transition from business analytics into cutting-edge GenAI application delivery. Working closely alongside senior leaders and tech experts across the business, you’ll have plenty of room to develop your skills, experiment with emerging tech, and grow your career while building real-world AI solutions.

Job Purpose

This role covers the design, delivery, engineering and support of AI applications and agents. It has a strong focus on AI both in terms of the tools and techniques used to deliver solutions and embedding AI in those solutions.
The role is required to stay abreast of the developments in the field while maintaining control of the portfolio of technologies required to support and deliver solutions.
The role will require great team cooperation and business analysis skills and to form tight and effective relationships within IT and with our customer base.

Role and Responsibilities

Design of software, AI, BI and Data Integration solutions which result in High- and Low-Level Documents and test plans. Ensure designs deliver maintainable solutions which comply with our technical strategies, architecture principles, “definition of done”, change management and compliance frameworks. Operational monitoring, after-care and contribution to continual service improvement.
Managing contracted workers and third parties and ensuring that delivery is in accordance with LLD and architecture principles.
Governance of applications and automations to ensure they align with Mundipharma standards, are supportable and fit for purpose
Research, assess and justify new tools and solutions to fulfil business and IT needs, where requirements need an innovative design with emerging technologies. Provide advice on technical strategy, the role will have a specific focus on technical excellence, architecture and lifecycle.
Assess internal processes, architecture and solutions for simplification and develop data and AI solutions with a view to increasing efficiency and reducing support overheads.

What you’ll bring

AI-Accelerated Development:
Around 2+ years of software delivery experience, with hands-on practice using AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to write, review, and refactor production-ready code.
Agentic AI & Automation:

Flexible benefits package
Opportunities for learning & development through our varied programme
Collaborative, inclusive work environment

Building an inclusive environment where people can thrive, grow and achieve their full potential is a priority. We believe this isn’t just the right thing, but also the smart thing to do. We are on a journey and will seek to move forward together through education and awareness to build a culture that welcomes and celebrates diversity and uniqueness. We will create a workplace environment where everyone can, every day, bring their authentic selves and is treated with dignity and respect.

We're looking for a Software Architect

to join our engineering team and play a pivotal role in shaping the technical direction of our platform. This is not just a hands-on engineering role, it's a leadership position where you'll be expected to bridge the gap between product vision and technical execution.

Our engineering team sits at the centre of everything we do at Plentific and is constantly tackling challenging problems, such as online payments, quoting, invoicing, booking, search and scoring algorithms, ETL, data pipelines, in-app messaging, real-time notifications, and fraud prevention. Our backend engineers mostly work with Python and Django on a service-oriented architecture deployed at scale on Kubernetes. The rest of the tech stack includes Django REST Framework, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, AWS, React.js, Docker, Redis, Celery, Pandas, NumPy, Git, Jenkins, and Elasticsearch.
We put significant emphasis on design patterns, code readability, automated testing, maintainability, and extensibility. As Software Architect, you'll be the standard-bearer for these values.

We expect our Software Architect to be fluent in AI-assisted development practices, leveraging AI tools across the entire engineering lifecycle: from spec-driven development and architectural design, to coding, code review, and delivery.

Lead the design of APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems with a strong focus on performance, reliability, and maintainability
Define and enforce best practices around database design, query optimisation, and data modelling across relational databases (PostgreSQL)
Evaluate emerging technologies and architectural patterns, making evidence-based recommendations to the broader engineering organisation

Build and maintain APIs, microservices, and data pipelines
Write complex SQL queries and optimise database performance
Debug and resolve issues across our applications, including production incidents
Review, maintain, and refactor existing code to support improved or new features

Champion and embed AI-assisted practices across the full development lifecycle, including spec generation, architectural design, coding, and delivery, ensuring the team operates at the frontier of modern, AI-augmented engineering

Remove technical blockers and proactively surface risks to delivery, proposing pragmatic solutions

Special focus is placed on maintaining data consistency, performance, and regulatory compliance throughout the transition. new_jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Appgate · Core Team · Gothenburg, Sweden

Want to build software where you can see the difference your work makes?
At Appgate, we develop IT security software that helps organizations control access to their applications and infrastructure. We're looking for a senior fullstack developer with strong C# experience to join our Core team, building the Appgate SDP client with C# and React/TypeScript. You'll also contribute to the Java REST backend that the same team works on.
We offer a balance that can be hard to find: a company large enough to surround you with experienced engineers, and small enough for your individual contribution to matter. Here, you can take ownership of substantial features and entire subsystems, help shape technical decisions, and follow your work from the first idea through to customers using it. Why Appgate? The people around you make a difference.
At Appgate, you'll work with colleagues who bring deep experience in software development, networking and security. There are people to learn from, discuss difficult problems with, and help you explore unfamiliar areas.
At the same time, there is room to make your own mark. We value developers who ask questions, suggest improvements and take responsibility for moving things forward. As your knowledge of the product grows, so does your opportunity to influence it.
Appgate is growing, with major customer contracts driving expansion across our engineering teams. We're also developing new capabilities in areas such as operational technology (OT), helping secure access to industrial systems. Joining now means contributing as those capabilities take shape.
We're also developing AI-related capabilities in Appgate SDP. As a client and controller developer, you may contribute to how these features connect with the rest of the product, bringing new functionality into the applications and services you work on.

Requirements

Your role in the Core team

The Core team develops the client and controller at the heart of Appgate SDP.
The client is the software users interact with to connect securely. The controller manages the policies and access decisions that determine what they can reach.
This is a fullstack role:
your work will span the client, its C# logic and React/TypeScript interface, and the Java REST backend that powers it. You'll move across this boundary regularly, understanding how a feature connects from backend logic through to what the user sees. 1 Appgate | Core Team We use agentic AI tools as part of our development workflow and continue to explore where they can help us build, test and improve software. You'll have the opportunity to help shape how we use these tools, applying the same engineering judgment and attention to quality that we bring to the rest of our work.
You'll help us:

• Develop features for the Appgate client, using C#, React/TypeScript and Electron.
• Develop features for the Java REST backend.
• Investigate and resolve problems across applications, operating systems and networks.
• Improve automated testing, developer tooling and build and release workflows.
• Shape technical solutions through design discussions, code reviews and collaboration across teams.
What you bring

You enjoy building software, understanding how things work, and seeing a solution through. You're comfortable taking initiative, while knowing when to involve others and work through a problem together.
We're looking for:

• Strong professional experience with C#. • Backend development experience, ideally with Java.
• Experience with, or working knowledge of, React, TypeScript and Electron. • Confidence supporting and debugging software across Windows, macOS and Linux.
• A working understanding of Unix systems. • An interest in writing maintainable code and improving how it is tested and delivered.
• Good communication skills in English.

Benefits

Build something, you can put your name to If you're looking for room to grow, experienced colleagues to learn from, and the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of a security product, we'd like to hear from you.
Join Appgate's Core team and help shape what comes next.

We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

About The Team

Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.

At Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG), a core division of Fanatics' mission to establish the ultimate end-to-end digital sports platform, we're crafting a world where every aspect of a sports fan's passion is catered to. As a Staff Engineer with Trading Engineering, you'll be thrust into the innovative heart of our risk and trading domain, where the technical challenges are as diverse as they are complex. Experience great learning opportunities where you'll engage with cutting-edge technologies and methodologies to build and enhance real-time systems that not only support FBG's operations but are integral to Fanatics' broader goal of revolutionizing sports fan engagement, in an environment that fosters innovation and personal development.

In this dynamic and supportive environment, your work will directly impact the development of sophisticated systems, driving innovation in how sports fans engage with the Fanatics ecosystem and deliver FBG product. You'll tackle unique technical challenges within our real-time decision-making systems, ensuring our platform remains at the forefront of the industry. Here, your professional growth is as vital as our platform's evolution, ensuring you develop alongside our mission to revolutionize the sports experience for fans worldwide.

8+ years of experience with C# and cloud platforms (Azure a plus).
Effective communication skills, capable of demystifying complex technical topics for diverse audiences.

At DraftKings, AI is becoming an integral part of both our present and future, powering how work gets done today, guiding smarter decisions, and sparking bold ideas.
